Lemma sub_ren_bwd : forall x y E A B,
  sub (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) A) (ren (swp x y) B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros x y E A B H.
  pose proof (@sub_ren_fwd x y (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) A) (ren (swp x y) B) H) as H2.
  rewrite ren_env_invol in H2. rewrite ren_invol in H2. rewrite ren_invol in H2.
  exact H2.
Qed.



(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 2 * n + 2
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.



Lemma we_pos : forall Sig T, 1 <= we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; simpl.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - pose proof IHT; lia.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_leaf : forall Sig T U K,
  we Sig U = 1 -> we Sig (open_tt_rec K U T) = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; intros U K HU; simpl.
  - auto.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; [assumption|auto].
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl.
    + auto.
    + rewrite IHT; auto.
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_fvar : forall Sig T X,
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma we_open_opaque_label : forall Sig T l P,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_label l P)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; rewrite H; auto. Qed.


(* atoms used as typ_label labels *)
Fixpoint tlabs (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_label l P => AtomSetImpl.add l (tlabs P)
  | typ_arrow A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_all A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_mu A => tlabs A
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

Lemma mem_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x l,
  AtomSetImpl.mem x (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true <-> x = l \/ AtomSetImpl.mem x s = true.
Proof.
  intros s x l. split; intro E.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E. apply in_add_iff in E. destruct E as [->|H]; auto.
    right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1; auto.
  - destruct E as [->|H].
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. left; auto.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tlabs_add_notin : forall l a P, l \notin tlabs (typ_label a P) -> l <> a.
Proof.
  intros l a P H. apply (@notin_add_1' (tlabs P) a l); auto.
Qed.
Lemma tlabs_add_rest : forall l a P, l \notin tlabs (typ_label a P) -> l \notin tlabs P.
Proof.
  intros l a P H. apply (@notin_add_2' (tlabs P) a l); auto.
Qed.

Lemma mem_add_neq : forall (s : atoms) a l,
  a <> l -> AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = AtomSetImpl.mem a s.
Proof.
  intros s a l Hne. destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a s) eqn:E.
  - assert (Hadd : AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true).
    { apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right.
      apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto. }
    exact Hadd.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s)) eqn:E2; auto.
    exfalso. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E2. apply in_add_iff in E2.
    destruct E2 as [e|Hin].
    + apply Hne; auto.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in Hin. rewrite E in Hin. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma we_add_fresh : forall Sig l T,
  l \notin tlabs T -> we (AtomSetImpl.add l Sig) T = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig l T. induction T as [| | n | a | T1 T2 IHT1 IHT2 | T1 T2 IHT1 IHT2 | T1 IHT1 | a P IHT | | i T1 T2 IHT1 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - (* nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* top *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
  - (* all *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
  - (* mu *)
    rewrite (IHT H); auto.
  - (* label *)
    assert (Hne : a <> l)
      by (intro e; subst; apply (@tlabs_add_notin l l P); auto).
    rewrite (@mem_add_neq Sig a l Hne).
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; auto.
    f_equal. apply IHT. apply tlabs_add_rest in H; auto.
  - (* rcd_nil *) reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
Qed.

Theorem decidability : forall A B E,
{sub E A B} + {~ sub E A B}.

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* all *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* mu *) f_equal.
    apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* label *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* rcd_cons *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma ren_swap_fixes : forall x y T,
  x \notin fv_tt T -> y \notin fv_tt T -> x \notin fl_tt T -> y \notin fl_tt T ->
  ren (swp x y) T = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T Hfx Hfy Hgx Hgy. apply ren_fix.
  - intros X HX. assert (X <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfx; auto).
    assert (X <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
  - intros l Hl. assert (l <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgx; auto).
    assert (l <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
Qed.

(* commutation of renaming with opening *)
Lemma ren_open_gen : forall pi T,
  (forall K U, ren pi (open_tt_rec K U T) = open_tt_rec K (ren pi U) (ren pi T)).
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; intros K U; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl; auto.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* all *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* mu *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* label *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* rcd_cons *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
Qed.

Lemma ren_open : forall pi T U,
  ren pi (open_tt T U) = open_tt (ren pi T) (ren pi U).
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply ren_open_gen. Qed.

(* ---------- renaming environments ---------- *)
Definition ren_b (pi : atom -> atom) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (ren pi T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (ren pi T)
  end.

Definition ren_env (pi : atom -> atom) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => match p with (x, b) => (pi x, ren_b pi b) end) E.

Lemma ren_env_cons : forall pi y c E,
  ren_env pi (y ~ c ++ E) = (pi y, ren_b pi c) :: ren_env pi E.
Proof. intros; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros x y [T|T]; simpl; f_equal; apply ren_invol. Qed.

Lemma ren_env_invol : forall x y E, ren_env (swp x y) (ren_env (swp x y) E) = E.
Proof.
  intros x y E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  f_equal.
  - apply pair_equal_spec; split; [apply swp_invol | apply ren_b_invol].
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_fwd : forall pi X b E,
  binds X b E -> binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E).
Proof.
  intros pi X b E H. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl in *; auto.
  destruct H as [Heq|Hin]; [left | right].
  - inversion Heq; subst; auto.
  - apply IHE'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_bwd : forall pi (Hpi : forall z, pi (pi z) = z)
  (Hb : forall b, ren_b pi (ren_b pi b) = b) X b E,
  binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E) -> binds X b E.
Proof.
  intros pi Hpi Hb X b E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  intros [Heq|Hin].
  - apply pair_equal_spec in Heq. destruct Heq as [H1 H2].
    left. apply pair_equal_spec. split.
    + apply (f_equal pi) in H1. rewrite !Hpi in H1. auto.
    + apply (f_equal (ren_b pi)) in H2. rewrite !Hb in H2. auto.
  - right. apply IHE'. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol_swp : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros; apply ren_b_invol. Qed.

(* ---------- helpers for atom sets ---------- *)
Lemma in_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \in AtomSetImpl.add x s <-> y = x \/ y \in s.
Proof.
  intros s x y. split.
  - intros H. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [e|ne].
    + left; auto.
    + right. revert H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_3; auto.
  - intros [->|H]; [apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto | apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto].
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_ren : forall pi E X,
  X \in dom (ren_env pi E) <-> (exists Y, Y \in dom E /\ pi Y = X).
Proof.
  intros pi E X. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl.
  - split; [fsetdec|]. intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec.
  - rewrite in_add_iff, IHE'. split.
    + intros [->|[Y [HY HP]]].
      * exists y; split; [apply in_add_iff; left; auto | auto].
      * exists Y; split; [apply in_add_iff; right; auto | auto].
    + intros [Y [HY HP]]. apply in_add_iff in HY. destruct HY as [->|HY].
      * left. auto.
      * right. exists Y; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ren : forall x y E X,
  X \notin dom E -> swp x y X \notin dom (ren_env (swp x y) E).
Proof.
  intros x y E X Hx Hin. apply in_dom_ren in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Y [HY HP]].
  assert (Y = X) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in HP; rewrite !swp_invol in HP; auto).
  subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_add_1' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y <> x.
Proof. intros s x y H e. apply H. rewrite e. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto. Qed.
Lemma notin_add_2' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y \notin s.
Proof. intros s x y H H2. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto. Qed.

Lemma rt_type_ren : forall pi T, rt_type T -> rt_type (ren pi T).
Proof. intros pi T H. destruct H; simpl; constructor. Qed.

Lemma in_union_iff : forall (s t : atoms) x,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.union s t <-> x \in s \/ x \in t.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma in_singleton_iff : forall x y,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.singleton y <-> x = y.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_ren : forall pi T l,
  l \in collectLabel (ren pi T) <-> (exists l', l' \in collectLabel T /\ pi l' = l).
Proof.
  intros pi T. induction T; intros l; cbn [ren collectLabel];
    try (split; [intros H; fsetdec | intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec]).
  (* rcd_cons *)
  rewrite in_union_iff, in_singleton_iff, IHT2. split.
  + intros [->|[l' [Hl' HP]]].
    * exists a; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; left; rewrite in_singleton_iff; auto | auto].
    * exists l'; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; right; auto | auto].
  + intros [l' [Hl' HP]]. rewrite in_union_iff in Hl'. destruct Hl' as [Hl'|Hl'].
    * rewrite in_singleton_iff in Hl'. subst. left. auto.
    * right. exists l'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_notin_ren : forall x y T i,
  i \notin collectLabel T -> swp x y i \notin collectLabel (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.
  intros x y T i Hi Hc. apply collectLabel_ren in Hc.
  destruct Hc as [l' [Hl' Heq]].
  assert (l' = i) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in Heq; rewrite !swp_invol in Heq; auto).
  subst; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- equivariance of WF under swapping ---------- *)
Lemma WF_ren_fwd : forall x y E T,
  WF E T -> WF (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.
  intros x y E T H.
  induction H as [E | E | U E X Hb | E A B HA IHA HB IHB
    | L E T1 T2 HT1 IHT1 Hall IHall | L E A H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | E A X HA IHA | E | E i T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hrt Hi].

(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 2 * n + 2
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.

(* atoms used as typ_label labels *)
Fixpoint tlabs (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_label l P => AtomSetImpl.add l (tlabs P)
  | typ_arrow A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_all A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_mu A => tlabs A
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

  AtomSetImpl.mem x (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true <-> x = l \/ AtomSetImpl.mem x s = true.
Proof.
  intros s x l. split; intro E.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E. apply in_add_iff in E. destruct E as [->|H]; auto.
    right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1; auto.
  - destruct E as [->|H].
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. left; auto.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.
Qed.

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* all *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* mu *) f_equal.
    apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* label *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* rcd_cons *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma ren_swap_fixes : forall x y T,
  x \notin fv_tt T -> y \notin fv_tt T -> x \notin fl_tt T -> y \notin fl_tt T ->
  ren (swp x y) T = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T Hfx Hfy Hgx Hgy. apply ren_fix.
  - intros X HX. assert (X <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfx; auto).
    assert (X <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
  - intros l Hl. assert (l <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgx; auto).
    assert (l <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
Qed.

(* commutation of renaming with opening *)
Lemma ren_open_gen : forall pi T,
  (forall K U, ren pi (open_tt_rec K U T) = open_tt_rec K (ren pi U) (ren pi T)).
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; intros K U; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl; auto.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* all *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* mu *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* label *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* rcd_cons *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
Qed.

Lemma ren_open : forall pi T U,
  ren pi (open_tt T U) = open_tt (ren pi T) (ren pi U).
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply ren_open_gen. Qed.

(* ---------- renaming environments ---------- *)
Definition ren_b (pi : atom -> atom) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (ren pi T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (ren pi T)
  end.

Definition ren_env (pi : atom -> atom) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => match p with (x, b) => (pi x, ren_b pi b) end) E.

Lemma ren_env_cons : forall pi y c E,
  ren_env pi (y ~ c ++ E) = (pi y, ren_b pi c) :: ren_env pi E.
Proof. intros; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros x y [T|T]; simpl; f_equal; apply ren_invol. Qed.

Lemma ren_env_invol : forall x y E, ren_env (swp x y) (ren_env (swp x y) E) = E.
Proof.
  intros x y E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  f_equal.
  - apply pair_equal_spec; split; [apply swp_invol | apply ren_b_invol].
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_fwd : forall pi X b E,
  binds X b E -> binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E).
Proof.
  intros pi X b E H. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl in *; auto.
  destruct H as [Heq|Hin]; [left | right].
  - inversion Heq; subst; auto.
  - apply IHE'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_bwd : forall pi (Hpi : forall z, pi (pi z) = z)
  (Hb : forall b, ren_b pi (ren_b pi b) = b) X b E,
  binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E) -> binds X b E.
Proof.
  intros pi Hpi Hb X b E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  intros [Heq|Hin].
  - apply pair_equal_spec in Heq. destruct Heq as [H1 H2].
    left. apply pair_equal_spec. split.
    + apply (f_equal pi) in H1. rewrite !Hpi in H1. auto.
    + apply (f_equal (ren_b pi)) in H2. rewrite !Hb in H2. auto.
  - right. apply IHE'. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol_swp : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros; apply ren_b_invol. Qed.

(* ---------- helpers for atom sets ---------- *)
Lemma in_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \in AtomSetImpl.add x s <-> y = x \/ y \in s.
Proof.
  intros s x y. split.
  - intros H. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [e|ne].
    + left; auto.
    + right. revert H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_3; auto.
  - intros [->|H]; [apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto | apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto].
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_ren : forall pi E X,
  X \in dom (ren_env pi E) <-> (exists Y, Y \in dom E /\ pi Y = X).
Proof.
  intros pi E X. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl.
  - split; [fsetdec|]. intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec.
  - rewrite in_add_iff, IHE'. split.
    + intros [->|[Y [HY HP]]].
      * exists y; split; [apply in_add_iff; left; auto | auto].
      * exists Y; split; [apply in_add_iff; right; auto | auto].
    + intros [Y [HY HP]]. apply in_add_iff in HY. destruct HY as [->|HY].
      * left. auto.
      * right. exists Y; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ren : forall x y E X,
  X \notin dom E -> swp x y X \notin dom (ren_env (swp x y) E).
Proof.
  intros x y E X Hx Hin. apply in_dom_ren in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Y [HY HP]].
  assert (Y = X) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in HP; rewrite !swp_invol in HP; auto).
  subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_add_1' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y <> x.
Proof. intros s x y H e. apply H. rewrite e. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto. Qed.
Lemma notin_add_2' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y \notin s.
Proof. intros s x y H H2. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto. Qed.

Lemma rt_type_ren : forall pi T, rt_type T -> rt_type (ren pi T).
Proof. intros pi T H. destruct H; simpl; constructor. Qed.

Lemma in_union_iff : forall (s t : atoms) x,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.union s t <-> x \in s \/ x \in t.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma in_singleton_iff : forall x y,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.singleton y <-> x = y.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_ren : forall pi T l,
  l \in collectLabel (ren pi T) <-> (exists l', l' \in collectLabel T /\ pi l' = l).
Proof.
  intros pi T. induction T; intros l; cbn [ren collectLabel];
    try (split; [intros H; fsetdec | intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec]).
  (* rcd_cons *)
  rewrite in_union_iff, in_singleton_iff, IHT2. split.
  + intros [->|[l' [Hl' HP]]].
    * exists a; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; left; rewrite in_singleton_iff; auto | auto].
    * exists l'; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; right; auto | auto].
  + intros [l' [Hl' HP]]. rewrite in_union_iff in Hl'. destruct Hl' as [Hl'|Hl'].
    * rewrite in_singleton_iff in Hl'. subst. left. auto.
    * right. exists l'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_notin_ren : forall x y T i,
  i \notin collectLabel T -> swp x y i \notin collectLabel (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.
  intros x y T i Hi Hc. apply collectLabel_ren in Hc.
  destruct Hc as [l' [Hl' Heq]].
  assert (l' = i) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in Heq; rewrite !swp_invol in Heq; auto).
  subst; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- equivariance of WF under swapping ---------- *)
Lemma WF_ren_fwd : forall x y E T,
  WF E T -> WF (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.
  intros x y E T H.
  induction H as [E | E | U E X Hb | E A B HA IHA HB IHB
    | L E T1 T2 HT1 IHT1 Hall IHall | L E A H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | E A X HA IHA | E | E i T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hrt Hi].
  - simpl; apply WF_top.
  - simpl; apply WF_nat.
  - simpl. eapply WF_var. eapply binds_ren_fwd with (b := bind_sub U). auto.
  - simpl. apply WF_arrow; auto.
  - (* all *) simpl. eapply WF_all with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + apply IHT1.
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
        by (intro Hc; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Yx : Y <> x) by (intro e; apply HY; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (Yy : Y <> y) by (intro e; apply Hy'; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (HL : Y \notin L) by (intro Hc; apply Hy'; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Heq : swp x y Y = Y) by (apply (@swp_other x y Y Yx Yy)).
      specialize (IHall Y HL).
      rewrite ren_open in IHall. cbn [ren] in IHall.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IHall. rewrite Heq in IHall.
      exact IHall.
  - (* rec *) simpl. eapply WF_rec with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
        by (intro Hc; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Yx : Y <> x) by (intro e; apply HY; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (Yy : Y <> y) by (intro e; apply Hy'; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (HL : Y \notin L) by (intro Hc; apply Hy'; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Heq : swp x y Y = Y) by (apply (@swp_other x y Y Yx Yy)).
      specialize (IH1 Y HL). rewrite ren_open in IH1. cbn [ren] in IH1.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IH1. rewrite Heq in IH1.
      exact IH1.
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
        by (intro Hc; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Yx : Y <> x) by (intro e; apply HY; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (Yy : Y <> y) by (intro e; apply Hy'; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (HL : Y \notin L) by (intro Hc; apply Hy'; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Heq : swp x y Y = Y) by (apply (@swp_other x y Y Yx Yy)).
      specialize (IH2 Y HL).
      rewrite ren_open in IH2. cbn [ren] in IH2.
      rewrite ren_open in IH2. cbn [ren] in IH2.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IH2. rewrite !Heq in IH2.
      exact IH2.
  - (* label *) simpl. apply WF_label; auto.
  - (* rcd_nil *) simpl; apply WF_rcd_nil.
  - (* rcd_cons *) simpl. eapply WF_rcd_cons.
    + apply IH1.
    + apply IH2.
    + apply rt_type_ren; auto.
    + apply collectLabel_notin_ren; auto.
Qed.

(* ---------- equivariance of wf_env ---------- *)
Lemma wf_env_ren_fwd : forall x y E, wf_env E -> wf_env (ren_env (swp x y) E).
Proof.
  intros x y E H. induction H as [| E X T Hwf IH HWF Hnotin | E X T Hwf IH HWF Hnotin].
  - simpl. constructor.
  - rewrite ren_env_cons. eapply wf_env_sub.
    + apply IH.
    + apply WF_ren_fwd. auto.
    + apply notin_dom_ren. auto.
  - rewrite ren_env_cons. eapply wf_env_typ.
    + apply IH.
    + apply WF_ren_fwd. auto.
    + apply notin_dom_ren. auto.
Qed.

Lemma swp_eq_iff : forall x y a b, swp x y a = swp x y b <-> a = b.
Proof.
  intros; split; intro e.
  - apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in e. rewrite !swp_invol in e. auto.
  - subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Tlookup_ren : forall x y i T,
  Tlookup (swp x y i) (ren (swp x y) T) = option_map (ren (swp x y)) (Tlookup i T).
Proof.
  intros x y i T. induction T; simpl; try reflexivity.
  (* rcd_cons *) destruct (a == i) as [e|ne].
  - subst i.
    destruct ((swp x y a) == (swp x y a)) as [e2|n2]; [|exfalso; auto].
    destruct (a == a) as [e1|n1]; [|exfalso; auto].
    simpl. reflexivity.
  - destruct ((swp x y a) == (swp x y i)) as [e2|n2].
    + exfalso. apply ne. exact (proj1 (@swp_eq_iff x y a i) e2).
    + simpl. apply IHT2.
Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_ren_subset : forall x y T1 T2,
  collectLabel T2 [<=] collectLabel T1 ->
  collectLabel (ren (swp x y) T2) [<=] collectLabel (ren (swp x y) T1).
Proof.
  intros x y T1 T2 H l Hl. apply collectLabel_ren in Hl.
  destruct Hl as [l' [Hl' HP]]. apply collectLabel_ren.
  exists l'; split; auto.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_add_extract : forall x y L Y,
  Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L) ->
  Y <> x /\ Y <> y /\ Y \notin L /\ swp x y Y = Y.
Proof.
  intros x y L Y H. split; [|split; [|split]].
  - intro e. apply H. rewrite <- e. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto.
  - assert (Hy : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
    intro e. apply Hy. rewrite <- e. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto.
  - assert (Hy : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
      by (intro Hc; apply H; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
    intro Hc. apply Hy. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto.
  - apply (@swp_other x y Y); auto.
Qed.

Lemma option_map_some_inv : forall (f : typ -> typ) o t,
  option_map f o = Some t -> exists s, o = Some s /\ f s = t.
Proof.
  intros f o t H. destruct o as [s|]; simpl in *.
  - exists s; split; auto. injection H as H; auto.
  - discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma sub_ren_fwd : forall x y E A B,
  sub E A B -> sub (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) A) (ren (swp x y) B).
Proof.
  intros x y E A B H.
  induction H as [E Hwf | E X Hwf HWF | E A Hwf HWF | U E T X Hb Hsub IHsub
    | E A1 A2 B1 B2 H12 IH12 H34 IH34
    | L E S1 S2 T1 T2 H12 IH12 H21 IH21 Hall IHall
    | L A1 A2 E Hwf1 Hwf2 Hsub IHallsub
    | E X A B Hsub IHsub
    | A1 A2 E Hwf Hrt1 Hrt2 HsubL HWF1 HWF2 Hlook IHlook].
  - simpl. apply sa_nat. apply wf_env_ren_fwd. auto.
  - simpl. apply sa_fvar. apply wf_env_ren_fwd; auto.
    exact (@WF_ren_fwd x y E (typ_fvar X) HWF).
  - simpl. apply sa_top. apply wf_env_ren_fwd; auto.
    exact (@WF_ren_fwd x y E A HWF).
  - simpl. eapply sa_trans_tvar.
    + eapply binds_ren_fwd with (b := bind_sub U); auto.
    + apply IHsub.
  - simpl. apply sa_arrow; auto.
  - simpl. eapply sa_all with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + apply IH12.
    + apply IH21.
    + intros Y HY. destruct (fresh_add_extract HY) as [Yx [Yy [HL Heq]]].
      specialize (IHall Y HL).
      rewrite !ren_open in IHall. cbn [ren] in IHall.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IHall. rewrite Heq in IHall.
      exact IHall.
  - simpl. eapply sa_rec with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + intros Y HY. destruct (fresh_add_extract HY) as [Yx [Yy [HL Heq]]].
      specialize (Hwf1 Y HL).
      pose proof (@WF_ren_fwd x y (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 Y) Hwf1) as H.
      rewrite !ren_open in H. cbn [ren] in H.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in H. rewrite Heq in H.
      exact H.
    + intros Y HY. destruct (fresh_add_extract HY) as [Yx [Yy [HL Heq]]].
      specialize (Hwf2 Y HL).
      pose proof (@WF_ren_fwd x y (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 Y) Hwf2) as H.
      rewrite !ren_open in H. cbn [ren] in H.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in H. rewrite Heq in H.
      exact H.
    + intros Y HY. destruct (fresh_add_extract HY) as [Yx [Yy [HL Heq]]].
      specialize (IHallsub Y HL).
      rewrite !ren_open in IHallsub. cbn [ren] in IHallsub.
      rewrite !ren_open in IHallsub. cbn [ren] in IHallsub.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IHallsub. rewrite !Heq in IHallsub.
      exact IHallsub.
  - simpl. apply sa_label; auto.
  - simpl. eapply sa_rcd.
    + apply wf_env_ren_fwd; auto.
    + apply rt_type_ren; auto.
    + apply rt_type_ren; auto.
    + apply collectLabel_ren_subset; auto.
    + exact (@WF_ren_fwd x y E A1 HWF1).
    + exact (@WF_ren_fwd x y E A2 HWF2).
    + intros i' t1' t2' H1 H2.
      assert (H1eq : option_map (ren (swp x y)) (Tlookup (swp x y i') A1) = Some t1').
      { rewrite <- Tlookup_ren. rewrite swp_invol. exact H1. }
      assert (H2eq : option_map (ren (swp x y)) (Tlookup (swp x y i') A2) = Some t2').
      { rewrite <- Tlookup_ren. rewrite swp_invol. exact H2. }
      destruct (@option_map_some_inv (ren (swp x y)) (Tlookup (swp x y i') A1) t1' H1eq) as [s1 [Hs1 Hr1]].
      destruct (@option_map_some_inv (ren (swp x y)) (Tlookup (swp x y i') A2) t2' H2eq) as [s2 [Hs2 Hr2]].
      specialize (IHlook (swp x y i') s1 s2 Hs1 Hs2).
      rewrite Hr1, Hr2 in IHlook. exact IHlook.
Qed.

(* backward direction via involution *)
Lemma sub_ren_bwd : forall x y E A B,
  sub (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) A) (ren (swp x y) B) -> sub E A B.
Proof.
  intros x y E A B H.
  pose proof (@sub_ren_fwd x y (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) A) (ren (swp x y) B) H) as H2.
  rewrite ren_env_invol in H2. rewrite ren_invol in H2. rewrite ren_invol in H2.
  exact H2.
Qed.



(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 2 * n + 2
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.



Lemma we_pos : forall Sig T, 1 <= we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; simpl.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - pose proof IHT; lia.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_leaf : forall Sig T U K,
  we Sig U = 1 -> we Sig (open_tt_rec K U T) = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; intros U K HU; simpl.
  - auto.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; [assumption|auto].
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl.
    + auto.
    + rewrite IHT; auto.
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_fvar : forall Sig T X,
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma we_open_opaque_label : forall Sig T l P,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_label l P)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; rewrite H; auto. Qed.


(* atoms used as typ_label labels *)
Fixpoint tlabs (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_label l P => AtomSetImpl.add l (tlabs P)
  | typ_arrow A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_all A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | typ_mu A => tlabs A
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => AtomSetImpl.union (tlabs A) (tlabs B)
  | _ => AtomSetImpl.empty
  end.

Lemma mem_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x l,
  AtomSetImpl.mem x (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true <-> x = l \/ AtomSetImpl.mem x s = true.
Proof.
  intros s x l. split; intro E.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E. apply in_add_iff in E. destruct E as [->|H]; auto.
    right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1; auto.
  - destruct E as [->|H].
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. left; auto.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma tlabs_add_notin : forall l a P, l \notin tlabs (typ_label a P) -> l <> a.
Proof.
  intros l a P H. apply (@notin_add_1' (tlabs P) a l); auto.
Qed.
Lemma tlabs_add_rest : forall l a P, l \notin tlabs (typ_label a P) -> l \notin tlabs P.
Proof.
  intros l a P H. apply (@notin_add_2' (tlabs P) a l); auto.
Qed.

Lemma mem_add_neq : forall (s : atoms) a l,
  a <> l -> AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = AtomSetImpl.mem a s.
Proof.
  intros s a l Hne. destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a s) eqn:E.
  - assert (Hadd : AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true).
    { apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right.
      apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto. }
    exact Hadd.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s)) eqn:E2; auto.
    exfalso. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E2. apply in_add_iff in E2.
    destruct E2 as [e|Hin].
    + apply Hne; auto.
    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in Hin. rewrite E in Hin. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma we_add_fresh : forall Sig l T,
  l \notin tlabs T -> we (AtomSetImpl.add l Sig) T = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig l T. induction T as [| | n | a | T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2 | T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2 | T1 IHT1 | a P IHT | | i T1 IHT1 T2 IHT2]; simpl; intros H.
  - (* nat *) reflexivity.
  - (* top *) reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) reflexivity.
  - (* arrow *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
  - (* all *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
  - (* mu *)
    rewrite (IHT1 H); auto.
  - (* label *)
    assert (Hne : a <> l)
      by (intro e; subst; apply (@tlabs_add_notin l l P); auto).
    rewrite (@mem_add_neq Sig a l Hne).
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; auto.
    f_equal. apply IHT. apply tlabs_add_rest in H; auto.
  - (* rcd_nil *) reflexivity.
  - (* rcd_cons *)
    assert (H1 : l \notin tlabs T1) by fsetdec.
    assert (H2 : l \notin tlabs T2) by fsetdec.
    rewrite (IHT1 H1), (IHT2 H2); auto.
Qed.

Theorem decidability : forall A B E,
{sub E A B} + {~ sub E A B}.

319	  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
320	      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
321	.
322	
323	Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
324	  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
325	  | expr_var : forall x,
326	      expr (exp_fvar x)
327	  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
328	      type T ->
329	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
330	      expr (exp_abs T e1)
331	  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
332	      expr e1 ->
333	      expr e2 ->
334	      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
335	  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
336	      type T ->
337	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
338	      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
339	  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
340	      expr e1 ->
341	      type V ->
342	      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
343	  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
344	     type T ->
345	     expr e ->
346	     expr (exp_unfold T e)
347	  | expr_fold: forall T e,
348	     type T ->
349	     expr e ->
350	     expr (exp_fold T e)
351	  | expr_rcd_nil :
352	     expr exp_rcd_nil
353	  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
354	     expr e1 ->
355	     expr e2 ->
356	     rt_expr e2 ->
357	     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
358	  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
359	     expr e ->
360	     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
361	.
362	
363	Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
364	  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).
365	
366	Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
367	  match Er with
368	  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
369	      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
370	  | _ => None
371	  end.
372	
373	Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
374	  | typing_nat: forall G,
375	    wf_env G ->
376	    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
377	  | typing_var : forall E x T,
378	      wf_env E ->
379	      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
380	      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
381	  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
382	      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
383	        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
384	      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
385	  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
386	      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
387	      typing E e2 T1 ->
388	      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
389	  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
390	      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
391	        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
392	      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
393	  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
394	      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
395	      sub E T T1 ->
396	      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
397	  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
398	      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
399	      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
400	      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
401	  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
402	     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
403	     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
404	  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
405	      typing E e S ->
406	      sub E S T ->
407	      typing E e T
408	  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
409	      typing G e T ->
410	      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
411	      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
412	  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
413	      wf_env G ->
414	      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
415	  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
416	      typing G e1 T1 ->
417	      typing G e2 T2 ->
418	      rt_type T2 ->
419	      rt_expr e2 ->
420	      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
421	      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
422	.
423	
424	Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
425	  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
426	      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
427	      value (exp_abs T t1)
428	  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
429	      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
430	      value (exp_tabs T t1)
431	  | value_nat:
432	      value exp_nat
433	  | value_fold: forall T e,
434	      type T ->
435	      value e ->
436	      value (exp_fold T e)
437	  | value_rcd_nil:
438	      value exp_rcd_nil
439	 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
440	      value e1 ->
441	      value e2 ->
442	      rt_expr e2 ->
443	      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
444	.
445	
446	Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
447	 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
448	     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
449	     value e2 ->
450	     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
451	 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
452	     expr e2 ->
453	     step e1 e1' ->
454	     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
455	 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
456	     value v1 ->
457	     step e2 e2' ->
458	     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
459	 | step_tapp : forall e1 e1' V,
460	      type V ->
461	      step e1 e1' ->
462	      step (exp_tapp e1 V) (exp_tapp e1' V)
463	 | step_tabs : forall T1 e1 T2,
464	      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
465	      type T2 ->
466	      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)
467	 | step_fld: forall S T v,
468	     value v ->
469	     type T ->
470	     type S ->
471	     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
472	 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
473	     step e e' ->
474	     type T ->
475	     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
476	 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
477	     step e e' ->
478	     type T ->
479	     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e')
480	 | step_projrcd: forall e i vi ,
481	     value e ->
482	     tlookup i e = Some vi->
483	     step (exp_rcd_proj e i) vi
484	 | step_proj: forall e1 e2 i,
485	     step e1 e2 ->
486	     step (exp_rcd_proj e1 i) (exp_rcd_proj e2 i)
487	 | step_rcd_head: forall e1 e2 e i,
488	     step e1 e2 ->
489	     step (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e) (exp_rcd_cons i e2 e)
490	 | step_rcd_cons: forall v1 e1 e2 i,
491	     value v1 ->
492	     step e1 e2 ->
493	     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)
494	.
495	
496	Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
497	  match e with
498	  | exp_nat => {}
499	  | exp_bvar i => {}
500	  | exp_fvar x => {}
501	  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
502	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
503	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
504	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
505	  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
506	  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
507	  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
508	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
509	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
510	  end.
511	
512	Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
513	  match e with
514	  | exp_nat => {}
515	  | exp_bvar i => {}
516	  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
517	  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
518	  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
519	  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
520	  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
521	  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
522	  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
523	  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
524	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
525	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
526	  end.
527	
528	Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
529	  match e with
530	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
531	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
532	  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
533	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
534	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
535	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
536	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
537	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
538	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
539	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
540	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
541	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
542	  end.
543	
544	Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
545	  match e with
546	  | exp_nat => exp_nat
547	  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
548	  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
549	  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
550	  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
551	  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
552	  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
553	  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
554	  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
555	  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
556	  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
557	  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
558	  end.
559	
560	Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.
561	
562	Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
563	  match m with
564	  | Pos => C
565	  | Neg => D
566	  end.
567	
568	Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
569	  match m with
570	  | Pos => Neg
571	  | Neg => Pos
572	  end.
573	
574	Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
  | expr_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e)
  | expr_rcd_nil :
     expr exp_rcd_nil
  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     rt_expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e)
  | value_rcd_nil:
      value exp_rcd_nil
 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_tapp : forall e1 e1' V,
      type V ->
      step e1 e1' ->
      step (exp_tapp e1 V) (exp_tapp e1' V)
 | step_tabs : forall T1 e1 T2,
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e')
 | step_projrcd: forall e i vi ,
     value e ->
     tlookup i e = Some vi->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e i) vi
 | step_proj: forall e1 e2 i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e1 i) (exp_rcd_proj e2 i)
 | step_rcd_head: forall e1 e2 e i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e) (exp_rcd_cons i e2 e)
 | step_rcd_cons: forall v1 e1 e2 i,
     value v1 ->
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)
.

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].

  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)

  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].

{"command": "cat > /workspace/.scratch/we.v <<'EOF'
Require Import Rules.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 2 * n + 2
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.
EOF

Lemma fresh_add_extract : forall x y L Y,

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* all *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* mu *) f_equal.
    apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* label *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* rcd_cons *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
Qed.

Lemma ren_swap_fixes : forall x y T,
  x \notin fv_tt T -> y \notin fv_tt T -> x \notin fl_tt T -> y \notin fl_tt T ->
  ren (swp x y) T = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T Hfx Hfy Hgx Hgy. apply ren_fix.
  - intros X HX. assert (X <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfx; auto).
    assert (X <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
  - intros l Hl. assert (l <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgx; auto).
    assert (l <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
Qed.

(* commutation of renaming with opening *)
Lemma ren_open_gen : forall pi T,
  (forall K U, ren pi (open_tt_rec K U T) = open_tt_rec K (ren pi U) (ren pi T)).
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; intros K U; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl; auto.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* all *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* mu *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* label *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* rcd_cons *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
Qed.

Lemma ren_open : forall pi T U,
  ren pi (open_tt T U) = open_tt (ren pi T) (ren pi U).
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply ren_open_gen. Qed.

(* ---------- renaming environments ---------- *)
Definition ren_b (pi : atom -> atom) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (ren pi T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (ren pi T)
  end.

Definition ren_env (pi : atom -> atom) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => match p with (x, b) => (pi x, ren_b pi b) end) E.

Lemma ren_env_cons : forall pi y c E,
  ren_env pi (y ~ c ++ E) = (pi y, ren_b pi c) :: ren_env pi E.
Proof. intros; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros x y [T|T]; simpl; f_equal; apply ren_invol. Qed.

Lemma ren_env_invol : forall x y E, ren_env (swp x y) (ren_env (swp x y) E) = E.
Proof.
  intros x y E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  f_equal.
  - apply pair_equal_spec; split; [apply swp_invol | apply ren_b_invol].
  - auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_fwd : forall pi X b E,
  binds X b E -> binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E).
Proof.
  intros pi X b E H. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl in *; auto.
  destruct H as [Heq|Hin]; [left | right].
  - inversion Heq; subst; auto.
  - apply IHE'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_bwd : forall pi (Hpi : forall z, pi (pi z) = z)
  (Hb : forall b, ren_b pi (ren_b pi b) = b) X b E,
  binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E) -> binds X b E.
Proof.
  intros pi Hpi Hb X b E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  intros [Heq|Hin].
  - apply pair_equal_spec in Heq. destruct Heq as [H1 H2].
    left. apply pair_equal_spec. split.
    + apply (f_equal pi) in H1. rewrite !Hpi in H1. auto.
    + apply (f_equal (ren_b pi)) in H2. rewrite !Hb in H2. auto.
  - right. apply IHE'. auto.
Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol_swp : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros; apply ren_b_invol. Qed.

(* ---------- helpers for atom sets ---------- *)
Lemma in_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \in AtomSetImpl.add x s <-> y = x \/ y \in s.
Proof.
  intros s x y. split.
  - intros H. destruct (KeySetFacts.eq_dec y x) as [e|ne].
    + left; auto.
    + right. revert H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_3; auto.
  - intros [->|H]; [apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto | apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto].
Qed.

Lemma in_dom_ren : forall pi E X,
  X \in dom (ren_env pi E) <-> (exists Y, Y \in dom E /\ pi Y = X).
Proof.
  intros pi E X. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl.
  - split; [fsetdec|]. intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec.
  - rewrite in_add_iff, IHE'. split.
    + intros [->|[Y [HY HP]]].
      * exists y; split; [apply in_add_iff; left; auto | auto].
      * exists Y; split; [apply in_add_iff; right; auto | auto].
    + intros [Y [HY HP]]. apply in_add_iff in HY. destruct HY as [->|HY].
      * left. auto.
      * right. exists Y; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_dom_ren : forall x y E X,
  X \notin dom E -> swp x y X \notin dom (ren_env (swp x y) E).
Proof.
  intros x y E X Hx Hin. apply in_dom_ren in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Y [HY HP]].
  assert (Y = X) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in HP; rewrite !swp_invol in HP; auto).
  subst; auto.
Qed.

Lemma notin_add_1' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y <> x.
Proof. intros s x y H e. apply H. rewrite e. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto. Qed.
Lemma notin_add_2' : forall (s : atoms) x y, y \notin AtomSetImpl.add x s -> y \notin s.
Proof. intros s x y H H2. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto. Qed.

Lemma rt_type_ren : forall pi T, rt_type T -> rt_type (ren pi T).
Proof. intros pi T H. destruct H; simpl; constructor. Qed.

Lemma in_union_iff : forall (s t : atoms) x,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.union s t <-> x \in s \/ x \in t.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.
Lemma in_singleton_iff : forall x y,
  x \in AtomSetImpl.singleton y <-> x = y.
Proof. intros; split; intros; fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma collectLabel_ren : forall pi T l,
  l \in collectLabel (ren pi T) <-> (exists l', l' \in collectLabel T /\ pi l' = l).
Proof.
  intros pi T. induction T; intros l; cbn [ren collectLabel];
    try (split; [intros H; fsetdec | intros [? [? ?]]; fsetdec]).
  (* rcd_cons *)
  rewrite in_union_iff, in_singleton_iff, IHT2. split.
  + intros [->|[l' [Hl' HP]]].
    * exists a; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; left; rewrite in_singleton_iff; auto | auto].
    * exists l'; split; [rewrite in_union_iff; right; auto | auto].
  + intros [l' [Hl' HP]]. rewrite in_union_iff in Hl'. destruct Hl' as [Hl'|Hl'].
    * rewrite in_singleton_iff in Hl'. subst. left. auto.
    * right. exists l'; auto.
Qed.

  i \notin collectLabel T -> swp x y i \notin collectLabel (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.
  intros x y T i Hi Hc. apply collectLabel_ren in Hc.
  destruct Hc as [l' [Hl' Heq]].
  assert (l' = i) by (apply (f_equal (swp x y)) in Heq; rewrite !swp_invol in Heq; auto).

Qed.

(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 2 * n + 2
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.
