Definition lookup_check (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool) (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  forallb
    (fun i =>
       match Tlookup i A with
       | Some t1 =>
           match Tlookup i B with
           | Some t2 => chk E t1 t2
           | None => false
           end
       | None => true
       end)
    (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)).

Lemma lookup_check_sound : forall chk E A B,
  lookup_check chk E A B = true ->
  forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A = Some t1 -> Tlookup i B = Some t2 -> chk E t1 t2 = true.
Proof.
  intros chk E A B H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  unfold lookup_check in H. rewrite forallb_forall in H.
  assert (Hin : i \in collectLabel B) by (apply (@Tlookup_collect i B t2); auto).
  assert (HinList : In i (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B))) by (apply In_elements; auto).
  specialize (H i HinList). simpl in H.
  rewrite H1, H2 in H. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_check_complete : forall chk E A B,
  (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A = Some t1 -> Tlookup i B = Some t2 -> chk E t1 t2 = true) ->
  lookup_check chk E A B = true.
Proof.
  intros chk E A B H. unfold lookup_check. rewrite forallb_forall.
  intros i Hin. simpl.
  destruct (Tlookup i A) as [t1|] eqn:E1; [|reflexivity].
  destruct (Tlookup i B) as [t2|] eqn:E2; [|].
  - apply (H i t1 t2); auto.
  - assert (HinL : i \in collectLabel B) by (apply In_elements_bwd; auto).
    destruct (@collect_Tlookup i B HinL) as [t Ht]. rewrite Ht in E2. discriminate.
Qed.

Fixpoint lookup_all_chk (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool)
    (E : env) (A Bfull Bstruct : typ) {struct Bstruct} : bool :=
  match Bstruct with
  | typ_rcd_cons i _ B2 =>
      andb
        (match Tlookup i A with
         | Some t1 =>
             match Tlookup i Bfull with
             | Some t2 => chk E t1 t2
             | None => false
             end
         | None => true
         end)
        (lookup_all_chk chk E A Bfull B2)
  | _ => true
  end.

Definition fresh3 (E : env) (A B : typ) : atom :=
  fresh_atom (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E)
    (AtomSetImpl.union (allT A) (allT B))).

Lemma fresh3_E : forall E A B, fresh3 E A B \notin allE E.
Proof.
  intros. unfold fresh3.
  pose proof (@fresh_atom_notin (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E)
    (AtomSetImpl.union (allT A) (allT B)))).
  fsetdec.
Qed.
Lemma fresh3_A : forall E A B, fresh3 E A B \notin allT A.
Proof.
  intros. unfold fresh3.
  pose proof (@fresh_atom_notin (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E)
    (AtomSetImpl.union (allT A) (allT B)))).
  fsetdec.
Qed.
Lemma fresh3_B : forall E A B, fresh3 E A B \notin allT B.
Proof.
  intros. unfold fresh3.
  pose proof (@fresh_atom_notin (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E)
    (AtomSetImpl.union (allT A) (allT B)))).

Qed.






(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 8 * n + 8
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.

Definition rt_type_b (T : typ) : bool :=
  match T with
  | typ_rcd_nil => true
  | typ_rcd_cons _ _ _ => true
  | _ => false
  end.

Lemma rt_type_b_spec : forall T, rt_type_b T = true <-> rt_type T.
Proof.
  intros T. destruct T as [| | j | a | A B | A B | A | l A | | i A B]; simpl.
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; [discriminate|inversion H].
  - split; intro H; constructor.
  - split; intro H; constructor.
Qed.

Fixpoint LC_b (d : nat) (E : env) (T : typ) : bool :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => true
  | typ_top => true
  | typ_bvar J => Nat.ltb J d
  | typ_fvar X => subbound_b E X
  | typ_arrow A B => andb (LC_b d E A) (LC_b d E B)
  | typ_all A B => andb (LC_b d E A) (LC_b (S d) E B)
  | typ_mu A => LC_b (S d) E A
  | typ_label _ A => LC_b d E A
  | typ_rcd_nil => true
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B =>
      andb (LC_b d E A)
        (andb (LC_b d E B)
          (andb (rt_type_b B) (negb (AtomSetImpl.mem i (collectLabel B)))))
  end.

Lemma LC_b_spec : forall T d E, LC_b d E T = true <-> LC d E T.
Proof.
  induction T as [| | n | a | A IHA B IHB | A IHA B IHB | A IHA | l A IHA | | i A IHA B IHB];
    simpl; intros d E.
  - tauto.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite Nat.ltb_lt. tauto.
  - apply subbound_b_spec.
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, IHA, IHB. tauto.
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, IHA, IHB. tauto.
  - apply IHA.
  - apply IHA.
  - tauto.
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, IHA, andb_true_iff, IHB, andb_true_iff, rt_type_b_spec.
    rewrite negb_true_iff.
    assert (Hm : AtomSetImpl.mem i (collectLabel B) = false <-> i \notin collectLabel B).
    { split; intro H.
      - intro Hin. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in Hin. rewrite H in Hin. discriminate.
      - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem i (collectLabel B)) eqn:Em; auto.
        exfalso. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto. }
    rewrite Hm. tauto.
Qed.

Definition WF_dec (E : env) (T : typ) : bool := LC_b 0 E T.

Lemma WF_dec_spec : forall E T, WF_dec E T = true <-> WF E T.
Proof.
  intros. unfold WF_dec. rewrite LC_b_spec. split; [apply LC_to_WF|apply WF_to_LC].
Qed.

Definition binding_ty (b : binding) : typ :=
  match b with bind_sub T => T | bind_typ T => T end.

Fixpoint wf_env_b (E : env) : bool :=
  match E with
  | nil => true
  | (X, b) :: E' =>
      andb (wf_env_b E')
        (andb (WF_dec E' (binding_ty b))
              (negb (AtomSetImpl.mem X (dom E'))))
  end.

Lemma wf_env_b_spec : forall E, wf_env_b E = true <-> wf_env E.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[X b] E']; simpl.
  - split; intro H; [constructor|reflexivity].
  - rewrite andb_true_iff, andb_true_iff, negb_true_iff, IHE'.
    assert (Hm : AtomSetImpl.mem X (dom E') = false <-> X \notin dom E').
    { split; intro H.
      - intro Hin. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1 in Hin. rewrite H in Hin. discriminate.
      - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem X (dom E')) eqn:Em; auto.
        exfalso. apply H. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto. }
    rewrite Hm, WF_dec_spec.
    destruct b; simpl.
    + split.
      * intros [Hwf [HWF Hnot]]. eapply wf_env_sub; eauto.
      * intro H. inversion H as [| E0 Y T Hwf HWF Hnot | E0 y T Hwf HWF Hnot]; subst.
        repeat split; auto.
    + split.
      * intros [Hwf [HWF Hnot]]. eapply wf_env_typ; eauto.
      * intro H. inversion H as [| E0 Y T Hwf HWF Hnot | E0 y T Hwf HWF Hnot]; subst.
        repeat split; auto.
Qed.

(* atoms used as typ_label labels *)
Fixpoint tlabs (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_label l P => AtomSetImpl.add l (tlabs P)

Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=

  | 0 => (false, nil)

      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top =>
            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
        | _ =>
            match A with

            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
                else

            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with

                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
                | _ => (false,nil)

            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with

                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      let Sig' := AtomSetImpl.add X Sig in
                      let C := 3 * (we Sig' P1 + we Sig' P2) in
                      let Cr' := (X, C) :: Cr in
                      let active' := AtomSetImpl.add X active in
                      match sub_b f Sig' Cr' active' E2 U1 U2 with
                      | (false, _) => (false,nil)
                      | (true, needs) =>
                          let (okc, rest) :=
                            check_obl (fun Eo C0 D0 =>
                                         let (ok,nn) :=
                                           sub_b f Sig' (remove_credit X Cr')
                                             AtomSetImpl.empty Eo C0 D0 in
                                         andb ok (null_needs nn)) X needs in
                          if okc then (true, rest) else (false,nil)

                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then
                      if AtomSetImpl.mem l active then
                        (true, (l,E,A0,B0) :: nil)
                      else sub_b f Sig Cr active E A0 B0
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_nil => (true,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then

                        E A B (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) in
                      if ok then (true,n) else (false,nil)

                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_bvar _ => (false,nil)
            | typ_top => (false,nil) (* B top handled above *)
            end
        end
      else (false,nil)
  end.

Lemma WF_ren_fwd : forall x y E T,
  WF E T -> WF (ren_env (swp x y) E) (ren (swp x y) T).
Proof.

  induction H as [E | E | U E X Hb | E A B HA IHA HB IHB
    | L E T1 T2 HT1 IHT1 Hall IHall | L E A H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | E A X HA IHA | E | E i T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hrt Hi].
  - simpl; apply WF_top.
  - simpl; apply WF_nat.
  - simpl. eapply WF_var. eapply binds_ren_fwd with (b := bind_sub U). auto.
  - simpl. apply WF_arrow; auto.
  - (* all *) simpl. eapply WF_all with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + apply IHT1.
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
        by (intro Hc; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Yx : Y <> x) by (intro e; apply HY; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).

  - (* rec *) simpl. eapply WF_rec with (L := AtomSetImpl.add x (AtomSetImpl.add y L)).
    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)
        by (intro Hc; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Yx : Y <> x) by (intro e; apply HY; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (Yy : Y <> y) by (intro e; apply Hy'; rewrite <- e; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
      assert (HL : Y \notin L) by (intro Hc; apply Hy'; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; auto).
      assert (Heq : swp x y Y = Y) by (apply (@swp_other x y Y Yx Yy)).
      specialize (IH1 Y HL). rewrite ren_open in IH1. cbn [ren] in IH1.
      rewrite ren_env_cons in IH1. rewrite Heq in IH1.

    + intros Y HY.
      assert (Hy' : Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add y L)

      assert (Heq : swp x y Y = Y) by (apply (@swp_other x y Y Yx Yy)).
      specialize (IH2 Y HL).
      rewrite ren_open in IH2. cbn [ren] in IH2.

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ============ Small helpers on the atom sets used by fresh3 ============ *)

Lemma notin_allT_all_l : forall (X:atom) A B,
  X \notin allT (typ_all A B) -> X \notin allT A.
Proof. intros X A B H. unfold allT in *. simpl in *. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma notin_allT_all_r : forall (X:atom) A B,
  X \notin allT (typ_all A B) -> X \notin allT B.
Proof. intros X A B H. unfold allT in *. simpl in *. fsetdec. Qed.

Lemma notin_allT_mu : forall (X:atom) A,
  X \notin allT (typ_mu A) -> X \notin allT A.
Proof. intros X A H. unfold allT in *. simpl in *. exact H. Qed.

(* ============ Generalising the mu WF premise from a fresh variable ============ *)

Lemma WF_mu_body_generalize : forall E A (X:atom),
  X \notin allE E -> X \notin allT A ->
  WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X) ->
  forall Y,
    Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add X
      (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E) (allT A)) ->
    WF (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A Y).
Proof.
  intros E A X HXE HXA HW Y HY.
  assert (HYX : Y <> X) by (intro e; subst Y; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
  assert (HYE : Y \notin allE E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HYA : Y \notin allT A) by fsetdec.
  pose proof (@WF_ren_fwd X Y (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X) HW) as Hr.
  rewrite ren_env_cons in Hr.
  cbn [ren_b] in Hr.
  rewrite (swp_eq_l X Y) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_env X Y E HXE HYE) in Hr.
  rewrite !ren_open in Hr.
  cbn [ren] in Hr.
  rewrite (swp_eq_l X Y) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_typ X Y A HXA HYA) in Hr.
  exact Hr.
Qed.

(* ============ Soundness of the boolean transposition search ============ *)

Lemma try_trans_b_sound_gen : forall f Sig E (X:atom) Us B,
  try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E Us B = true ->
  (forall U, In U Us -> binds X (bind_sub U) E) ->
  (forall U, In U Us -> sub_plain f Sig E U B = true -> sub E U B) ->

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* Reflexivity of subsumption for well-formed types in well-formed envs.

   We prove a slightly stronger auxiliary statement simultaneously: every
   type looked up inside A is also reflexive.  This is exactly what the
   [sa_rcd] rule needs for its componentwise premise.  The auxiliary is
   phrased with a redundant copy of the WF hypothesis, which lets us keep
   [WF E A -> ...] as the induction motive so that every constructor case
   still has access to its WF premises (notably in the [WF_all] and
   [WF_rec] cases). *)

Lemma sub_refl_aux : forall E A,
  WF E A -> wf_env E ->
  sub E A A /\
  (forall i t, Tlookup i A = Some t -> sub E t t).
Proof.
  intros E A H Hwf.
  assert (Hcopy : WF E A) by exact H.
  revert Hcopy Hwf.
  induction H.
  - (* WF_top *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + apply sa_top; auto.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_nat *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + apply sa_nat; auto.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_var *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + apply sa_fvar; auto.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_arrow *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + apply sa_arrow.
      * destruct (IHWF1 H Hwf) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
      * destruct (IHWF2 H0 Hwf) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_all *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + eapply sa_all with (L := AtomSetImpl.union L (dom E)).
      * destruct (IHWF H Hwf) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
      * destruct (IHWF H Hwf) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
      * intros X HX.
        assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
        assert (HXdom : X \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
        assert (Hwfe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E)).
        { eapply wf_env_sub; eauto. }
        destruct (H1 X HXL (H0 X HXL) Hwfe) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_rec *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + eapply sa_rec with (L := AtomSetImpl.union L (dom E)).
      * intros X HX. apply H. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX. apply H1. fsetdec.
      * intros X HX.
        assert (HXL : X \notin L) by fsetdec.
        assert (HXdom : X \notin dom E) by fsetdec.
        assert (Hwfe : wf_env (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)).
        { eapply wf_env_sub.
          - exact Hwf.
          - apply WF_top.
          - exact HXdom. }
        destruct (H2 X HXL (H1 X HXL) Hwfe) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_label *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + apply sa_label. destruct (IHWF H Hwf) as [Hs _]. exact Hs.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_rcd_nil *)
    intros Hw Hwf. split.
    + eapply sa_rcd with (A1 := typ_rcd_nil) (A2 := typ_rcd_nil).
      * exact Hwf.
      * apply rt_type_rcd_nil.
      * apply rt_type_rcd_nil.
      * intros z Hz. exact Hz.
      * exact Hw.
      * exact Hw.
      * intros i0 t1 t2 Ht1 Ht2. simpl in Ht1. discriminate Ht1.
    + intros i t Ht. simpl in Ht. discriminate Ht.
  - (* WF_rcd_cons *)
    intros Hw Hwf.
    destruct (IHWF1 H Hwf) as [HsubT1 HQ1].
    destruct (IHWF2 H0 Hwf) as [HsubT2 HQ2].
    split.
    + eapply sa_rcd with
        (A1 := typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) (A2 := typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).
      * exact Hwf.
      * apply rt_type_rcd_cons.
      * apply rt_type_rcd_cons.
      * intros z Hz. exact Hz.
      * exact Hw.
      * exact Hw.
      * intros i0 t1 t2 Ht1 Ht2.
        assert (Heq : t1 = t2) by
          (rewrite Ht1 in Ht2; injection Ht2; auto).
        subst t2.
        destruct (i == i0) as [eii|neii] eqn:Eii.
        -- subst i0. simpl in Ht1. injection Ht1 as Ht1. subst t1. exact HsubT1.
        -- simpl in Ht1. apply (HQ2 i0 t1 Ht1).
    + intros i0 t Ht.
      destruct (i == i0) as [eii|neii] eqn:Eii.
      * subst i0. simpl in Ht. injection Ht as Ht. subst t. exact HsubT1.
      * simpl in Ht. apply (HQ2 i0 t Ht).
Qed.

Lemma sub_refl : forall E A, wf_env E -> WF E A -> sub E A A.
Proof.
  intros E A Hwf H.
  exact (proj1 (sub_refl_aux H Hwf)).
Qed.

content.text:
Implemented and tested the content-credit experiment in `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credits.py` and the driver scripts under `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_*.py`. No changes were made to `/workspace/Rules.v` or `/workspace/Task.v`, and no `.md` report files were written.

## Main result

For the plain algorithm

```python
mk_alg(mu_variant='rec', label_variant='rec',
       trans_variant='lhs', rcd_variant='full', use_mode=False)
```

the following lexicographic measure strictly decreases on every recursive call edge:

```text
M(E,Sig,L,R) = ( C(E,Sig,L,R), szS(Sig,L) + szS(Sig,R) )
```

where `C` is a natural-valued content-credit count and `szS` is the prior size measure:

```text
szS(Nat/Top/Nil/BVar/FVar) = 1
szS(Arr A B)               = 1 + szS(A) + szS(B)
szS(All S T)               = 1 + szS(S) + szS(T)
szS(Mu A)                  = 1 + szS(A)
szS(Lab l A)               = if l in Sig then 1 else 1 + szS(A)
szS(Cons i A B)            = 1 + szS(A) + szS(B)
```

The multiset version, with ranked tokens, also works and in fact satisfies the stronger property `C(child) <= C(parent)` as a multiset. The natural-count version is simpler and directly Coq-ready.

## Credit definition

`C` mirrors the algorithm’s actual-goal recursion. The child orientations below were checked against `run.trace` and are exact for both `run` and `run_neg`.

```python
def C(E, Sig, L, R):
    # terminal cases, same priority as step()
    if R == TOP or L == NAT:
        return 0

    # trans: one fvar token plus all possible binding expansions
    if L[0] == 'v':
        if L == R:
            return 0
        Us = [U for (Y, k, U) in E if Y == L[1] and k == 'sub']
        if not Us:
            return 0
        return 1 + sum(C(E, Sig, U, R) for U in Us)

    # arrow: domain child is (R1,L1), codomain child is (L2,R2)
    if L[0] == 'arr' and R[0] == 'arr':
        L1, L2 = L[1], L[2]
        R1, R2 = R[1], R[2]
        return C(E, Sig, R1, L1) + C(E, Sig, L2, R2)

    # all: two domain children plus body child under X ~ SR
    if L[0] == 'all' and R[0] == 'all':
        SL, TL = L[1], L[2]
        SR, TR = R[1], R[2]
        X = fresh(atoms_env(E) | atoms_of(L) | atoms_of(R))
        E2 = [(X, 'sub', SR)] + E
        return (C(E, Sig, SL, SR) +
                C(E, Sig, SR, SL) +
                C(E2, Sig, open_tt(TL, v(X)), open_tt(TR, v(X))))

    # mu: one mu token plus the unfolded child credits
    if L[0] == 'mu' and R[0] == 'mu':
        AL, AR = L[1], R[1]
        X = fresh(atoms_env(E) | atoms_of(L) | atoms_of(R))
        E2 = [(X, 'sub', TOP)] + E
        PL = open_tt(AL, v(X))
        PR = open_tt(AR, v(X))
        UL = open_tt(AL, lab(X, PL))
        UR = open_tt(AR, lab(X, PR))
        return 1 + C(E2, Sig | {X}, UL, UR)

    # active label: one label token; inactive label: no token
    if L[0] == 'lab' and R[0] == 'lab' and L[1] == R[1]:
        return (1 if L[1] in Sig else 0) + C(E, Sig, L[2], R[2])

    # records: sum over the compared fields
    if is_record(L) and is_record(R):
        return sum(C(E, Sig, Tlookup(i, L), Tlookup(i, R))
                   for i in labels(R))

    return 0
```

The implementation with memoization and the multiset/token version is in:

- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credits.py`

The multiset token ranks are:

- fvar/label token rank: `rankE(E,X) = len(E) - index_X(E)`, head binding highest;
- mu token: any fixed rank; the Python experiments used `10**9`, and a rerun with rank `0` on all closed size-4 goals also gave 0 failures.

Because the proof only needs multiset inclusion, the actual rank values are immaterial. The token multiset is a proof device; its cardinality is the `nat` measure.

## Resource-passing interpretation

`C(parent)` is exactly the disjoint union of the child shares plus consumed unfolding tokens:

| rule | parent credit share | child share | residual token | size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `trans` | `1 + Σ_U C(U,R)` | `C(U,R)` | one fvar token | may increase |
| `mu_rec` | `1 + C(child)` | `C(child)` | one mu token | decreases |
| active `lab` | `1 + C(child)` | `C(child)` | one label token | may increase |
| inactive `lab` | `C(child)` | `C(child)` | none | decreases |
| `arrow` | `C(dom)+C(cod)` | one summand | none | decreases |
| `all` | `C(dom1)+C(dom2)+C(body)` | one summand | none | decreases |
| `rcd` | `Σ_fields C(field)` | one summand | none | decreases |

This is a disjoint-share discipline, not literally “carry the parent credits unchanged to every child”. That distinction matters at `all_body`.

With `occ_binder(T)` defined binder-depth-aware as the number of free occurrences of the constructor’s own binder:

- at `all_body`, the body child share `C(E2,Sig,open T1 X,open T2 X)` contains one rank/content token for each nonterminal occurrence of `b0` in `T1` and `T2`, and the binding content `C(E2,Sig,SR)`;
- at `mu_rec`, the child share contains one label token plus one fvar token/content for each unfolded binder occurrence;
- at `trans`, the parent’s extra `1` is the fvar token consumed by the expansion, while the child already receives the content tokens of the binding type.

The allocation is demand-driven: if an opened body occurrence is already terminal, e.g. the body child is `X <: X`, it needs no credit.

## First counterexample for the literal “allocate on the edge” reading

If `all_body` is interpreted as “child gets the parent credits plus newly allocated `occ_binder` tokens”, the credits increase.

First WF counterexample:

```text
goal: mu(all(nat,b0)) <: mu(all(nat,b0))
edge: all_body
parent C = 0, child C = 0, sz 6 -> 2
occ_binder(T1) + occ_binder(T2) = 1 + 1 = 2
```

Adding the allocation only on the child edge changes credits `0 -> 2`, so `(credits,size)` increases at the first component and fails. If the allocation is preallocated in the parent and the child receives its share, the edge is non-increasing; in the demand-driven `C` above it is `0 -> 0` with size `6 -> 2`. If the domains of the `all` have credits, the body edge is a strict credit decrease because the parent also contains the domain shares.

This example is reproduced by `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_allbody_demo.py`.

## First counterexample for the wrong lexicographic order

`(size, credits)` fails, as expected, at active label and trans edges where size increases while credits are consumed.

First failure:

```text
goal: mu(lab 1 b0) <: mu(lab 1 b0)
edge: active label after mu_rec
parent C = 1, child C = 0
parent sz = 2, child sz = 4
```

Thus:

```text
(credits,size): (1,2) -> (0,4)   decreases
(size,credits): (2,1) -> (4,0)   increases at the first component
```

A trans example is:

```text
E = [(100, sub, arr(nat,nat))]
goal: v100 <: nat
edge: trans
C 1 -> 0, sz 2 -> 4
```

These are reproduced by `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_examples.py`.

## Test settings and results

All runs use the plain algorithm above. No step/expansion/depth aborts occurred.

- Closed WF types, size <= 4:
  - 437 types; 190,969 ordered pairs; 381,938 runs; 91,158 trace edges.
  - `M=(C,sz)` failures: 0.
  - `|C|`-sum failures: 0.
  - Multiset-subset failures: 0.
  - Max `C`: 7.
  - Runtime: 2.18 s.

- Nine WF environments, types size <= 4:
  - 5,343,825 goals; 10,687,650 runs; 2,966,272 trace edges.
  - `M=(C,sz)` failures: 0.
  - `|C|`-sum failures: 0.
  - Max `C`: 11.
  - Runtime: 72.07 s.
  - The size <= 3 subset alone was 126,537 goals / 253,074 runs / 72,498 edges, 0 failures, 1.57 s.

- Combined closed size-4 + 9-env size-3 edge distribution (163,656 edges):
  - `mu_rec`: 35,472/35,472 credit-strict.
  - `trans`: 16,132/16,132 credit-strict.
  - `lab`: 41,182 edges; 378 active-label credit-strict, 40,804 equal-credit + size decrease.
  - `all_body`: 4,878 edges; 138 credit-strict, 4,740 equal-credit + size decrease; no increases.
  - `all_dom1` 29,422; `all_dom2` 10,274; `arrow_dom` 18,298; `arrow_cod` 6,474; `rcd` 1,524. All are either credit-strict or equal-credit with size decrease.

- Random depth-6, 2–3 env bindings:
  - 250 goals; 500 runs; 394 edges; 0 failures.
  - Max `C` 56; max calls 34.

- Random depth-8, 2–4 env bindings:
  - 120 goals; 240 runs; 825 edges; 0 failures.
  - Max `C` 51; max calls 79.

- Stress self-comparisons, depth 10:
  - 400 generated types, 800 runs; 5,206 edges; 0 failures.
  - Hardest trace: 659 calls, depth 67, max `C` 1,386.

No credit-computation cycles occurred: `CREDIT_CYCLES = 0` in all suites.

Drivers:

- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_exhaustive.py`
- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_env.py`
- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_random.py`
- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_stress.py`
- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_stats.py`
- `/workspace/.scratch/agent2/credit_count_test.py`

## Coq-ready sketch

Use the natural-count version as the measure:

```coq
Definition credits (E : env) (Sig : labels) (L R : typ) : nat := ...
Definition sizepair (Sig : labels) (L R : typ) : nat :=
  szS Sig L + szS Sig R.
Definition M E Sig L R : nat * nat :=
  (credits E Sig L R, sizepair Sig L R).
```

`M` is compared with the lexicographic product of `Nat.lt`.

Needed lemmas:

1. `credits_trans`:
   `credits E Sig (v X) R = 1 + Σ_{E(X)=sub U} credits E Sig U R`.
2. `credits_mu`:
   for fresh `X`,
   `credits E Sig (mu A) (mu B) = 1 + credits ((X,sub,top)::E) (Sig ∪ {X}) U1 U2`,
   where `U1/U2` are the labeled unfoldings.
3. `credits_label_active` and `credits_label_inactive`:
   `X ∈ Sig -> C = 1 + C(payload)` and `X ∉ Sig -> C = C(payload)`.
4. `credits_arrow`, `credits_all`, `credits_rcd`: the parent credit is exactly the sum of the child shares.
5. `sz_open`: opening the outer binder with an fvar preserves `szS` because both `bvar` and `fvar` have size 1.
6. `sz_arrow`, `sz_all`, `sz_rcd`, `sz_label_inactive`: strict size decrease on every edge where credits are equal.
7. `plain_call_decreases`: case analysis on the rule. If the residual token is present, `credits child < credits parent`; otherwise credits are equal and `sizepair child < sizepair parent`.
8. `plain_terminates`: well-founded induction on `M`. Memo hits and the `INPROG -> false` cycle check return immediately, so they add no recursive calls and do not affect termination.

For the definition of `credits` itself, use `Program Fixpoint`/`Equations` with a well-founded auxiliary measure, e.g. lexicographically:

```text
(multiset of expandable fvar ranks, number of mu/all/label/rcd redexes, size L + size R)
```

At fvar expansion, the rank of `X` is replaced by fvars of strictly smaller rank; at `mu`/`all`/`label`/`rcd`, a redex or structural size decreases. These are the same rank-decrease and structural-decrease lemmas used for `plain_call_decreases`. Alternatively, carry the credit list operationally and prove by induction that the carried list is exactly `credits` at each state.


1	"""Content-credit measure for the plain mode-less algorithm.
2	
3	Credits are a multiset of natural ranks.  C(E,Sig,L,R) is defined by the
4	same case analysis as the algorithm and, by construction, is the disjoint
5	union of the credits of every recursive child plus residual unfolding
6	tokens.  Consequently the lexicographic pair (C, sz) should strictly
7	decrease on every recursive edge.
8	"""
9	import sys
10	sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/.scratch/agent2')
11	import common as C
12	from core import (NAT, TOP, NIL, b, v, arr, allt, mu, lab, cons,
13	                  open_tt, fv_tt, fl_tt, atoms_env, atoms_of, fresh,
14	                  collectLabel, Tlookup, rt_type)
15	from alg import szS
16	
17	MAXR = 10 ** 9          # rank used for a mu-unfolding token
18	
19	
20	def rankE(E, X):
21	    for i, (Y, k, T) in enumerate(E):
22	        if Y == X:
23	            return len(E) - i
24	    return 0
25	
26	
27	def _sum(ms):
28	    out = []
29	    for m in ms:
30	        out.extend(m)
31	    return tuple(out)
32	
33	
34	def credits(E, Sig, L, R):
35	    """Multiset of ranks, represented as a sorted tuple (descending)."""
36	    return tuple(sorted(_credits(tuple(E), frozenset(Sig), L, R), reverse=True))
37	
38	
39	def _credits(E, Sig, L, R, memo=None, active=None):
40	    if memo is None:
41	        memo = {}
42	    key = (E, Sig, L, R)
43	    if key in memo:
44	        return memo[key]
45	    if active is None:
46	        active = set()
47	    if key in active:
48	        # fallback for a cyclic measure computation; report via global flag
49	        CREDIT_CYCLES.append(key)
50	        return ()
51	    active.add(key)
52	    try:
53	        res = _credits_body(E, Sig, L, R, memo, active)
54	    finally:
55	        active.discard(key)
56	    memo[key] = res
57	    return res
58	
59	
60	CREDIT_CYCLES = []
61	
62	
63	def _credits_body(E, Sig, L, R, memo, active):
64	    # terminal cases, mirroring step()
65	    if R == TOP or L == NAT:
66	        return ()
67	    if L[0] == 'v':
68	        if L == R:
69	            return ()
70	        X = L[1]
71	        Us = [U for (Y, k, U) in E if Y == X and k == 'sub']
72	        if not Us:
73	            return ()
74	        children = [_credits(E, Sig, U, R, memo, active) for U in Us]
75	        return (rankE(E, X),) + _sum(children)
76	
77	    # arrow: domain child is (R1,L1), codomain child is (L2,R2)
78	    if L[0] == 'arr' and R[0] == 'arr':
79	        L1, L2 = L[1], L[2]; R1, R2 = R[1], R[2]
80	        return (_sum([_credits(E, Sig, R1, L1, memo, active),
81	                      _credits(E, Sig, L2, R2, memo, active)]))
82	
83	    # all: two domain children plus body child under binding SR
84	    if L[0] == 'all' and R[0] == 'all':
85	        SL, TL = L[1], L[2]; SR, TR = R[1], R[2]
86	        Z = fresh(set(atoms_env(E)) | set(atoms_of(L)) | set(atoms_of(R)) | set(Sig))
87	        E2 = ((Z, 'sub', SR),) + E
88	        PL = open_tt(TL, v(Z)); PR = open_tt(TR, v(Z))
89	        return _sum([_credits(E, Sig, SL, SR, memo, active),
90	                     _credits(E, Sig, SR, SL, memo, active),
91	                     _credits(E2, Sig, PL, PR, memo, active)])
92	
93	    # mu: child credits plus one high-rank unfolding token
94	    if L[0] == 'mu' and R[0] == 'mu':
95	        AL, AR = L[1], R[1]
96	        Z = fresh(set(atoms_env(E)) | set(atoms_of(L)) | set(atoms_of(R)) | set(Sig))
97	        E2 = ((Z, 'sub', TOP),) + E
98	        Sig2 = Sig | {Z}
99	        PL = open_tt(AL, v(Z)); PR = open_tt(AR, v(Z))
100	        UL = open_tt(AL, lab(Z, PL)); UR = open_tt(AR, lab(Z, PR))
101	        return (MAXR,) + _credits(E2, Sig2, UL, UR, memo, active)
102	
103	    # label: payload plus a label token iff the label is active
104	    if L[0] == 'lab' and R[0] == 'lab' and L[1] == R[1]:
105	        base = _credits(E, Sig, L[2], R[2], memo, active)
106	        if L[1] in Sig:
107	            return (rankE(E, L[1]),) + base
108	        return base
109	
110	    # records: disjoint union over the compared fields
111	    if rt_type(L) and rt_type(R):
112	        out = ()
113	        for i in collectLabel(R):
114	            t1 = Tlookup(i, L); t2 = Tlookup(i, R)
115	            if t1 is not None and t2 is not None:
116	                out = out + _credits(E, Sig, t1, t2, memo, active)
117	        return out
118	
119	    return ()
120	
121	
122	def credits_pair(E, Sig, L, R):
123	    return credits(E, Sig, L, R)
124	
125	
126	def size_pair(Sig, L, R):
127	    return szS(Sig, L) + szS(Sig, R)
128	
129	
130	def multiset_lt(cchild, cparent):
131	    """Dershowitz-Manna multiset order on natural ranks (descending)."""
132	    a = list(cchild); bb = list(cparent)
133	    n = max(len(a), len(bb))
134	    a += [-1] * (n - len(a)); bb += [-1] * (n - len(bb))
135	    for x, y in zip(a, bb):
136	        if x != y:
137	            return x < y
138	    return False
139	
140	
141	def multiset_subset(cchild, cparent):
142	    from collections import Counter
143	    cc = Counter(cchild); cp = Counter(cparent)
144	    return all(v <= cp[k] for k, v in cc.items())
145	
146	
147	def check_edge(Ep, Sp, Lp, Rp, Ec, Sc, Lc, Rc, memo=None):
148	    if memo is None:
149	        memo = {}
150	    cp = _credits(tuple(Ep), frozenset(Sp), Lp, Rp, memo)
151	    cc = _credits(tuple(Ec), frozenset(Sc), Lc, Rc, memo)
152	    sp = size_pair(Sp, Lp, Rp); sc = size_pair(Sc, Lc, Rc)
153	    credit_lt = multiset_lt(tuple(sorted(cc, reverse=True)),
154	                            tuple(sorted(cp, reverse=True)))
155	    subset = multiset_subset(cc, cp)
156	    strict_subset = subset and sorted(cc) != sorted(cp)
157	    size_lt = sc < sp
158	    ok_credit_size = credit_lt or (sorted(cc) == sorted(cp) and size_lt)
159	    ok_sum_size = (len(cc) < len(cp)) or (len(cc) == len(cp) and size_lt)
160	    ok_size_credit = size_lt or (sp == sc and credit_lt)
161	    return {
162	        'cp': cp, 'cc': cc, 'sp': sp, 'sc': sc,
163	        'credit_lt': credit_lt, 'subset': subset,
164	        'strict_subset': strict_subset,
165	        'size_lt': size_lt,
166	        'ok_credit_size': ok_credit_size,
167	        'ok_sum_size': ok_sum_size,
168	        'ok_size_credit': ok_size_credit,
169	    }
170	
171	
172	# ---------- numeric (unit-sum) version, for the Coq measure ----------
173	def credit_count(E, Sig, L, R):
174	    return len(credits(E, Sig, L, R))
175	
176	
177	def check_edge_count(Ep, Sp, Lp, Rp, Ec, Sc, Lc, Rc, memo=None):
178	    if memo is None:
179	        memo = {}
180	    cp = _credits(tuple(Ep), frozenset(Sp), Lp, Rp, memo)
181	    cc = _credits(tuple(Ec), frozenset(Sc), Lc, Rc, memo)
182	    sp = size_pair(Sp, Lp, Rp); sc = size_pair(Sc, Lc, Rc)
183	    ok = len(cc) < len(cp) or (len(cc) == len(cp) and sc < sp)
184	    return ok, len(cp), len(cc), sp, sc

(* ===== Environment ranks used by occurrence-token termination attempts ===== *)

Fixpoint index_of (E : env) (X : atom) : option nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => None
  | (Y, _) :: E' =>
      if X == Y then Some 0
      else match index_of E' X with
           | Some i => Some (S i)
           | None => None
           end

Definition rank (E : env) (X : atom) : option nat :=
  match index_of E X with
  | Some i => Some (length E - i)
  | None => None

Lemma sub_fvar_binds_step : forall E X U B,
  binds X (bind_sub U) E -> sub E U B -> sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof. intros; eapply sa_trans_tvar; eauto. Qed.


Lemma resolve_step_sound : forall E X U B,
  lookup_sub E X = Some U -> sub E U B -> sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros E X U B Ho Hsub.
  apply sub_fvar_binds_step with U; auto.
  apply lookup_sub_some_binds; auto.
Qed.


(* ===== Simpler memo/cycle-free declarative search (fueled) ===== *)

Fixpoint try_trans_b (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool)
    (E : env) (Us : list typ) (B : typ) {struct Us} : bool :=
  match Us with
  | nil => false
  | U :: Us' => if chk E U B then true else try_trans_b chk E Us' B
  end.

Fixpoint sub_plain (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ)
    {struct fuel} : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => false
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top => WF_dec E A
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat => match B with typ_nat => true | _ => false end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  if WF_dec E A then true
                  else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
                else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E B1 A1) (sub_plain f Sig E A2 B2)
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E S1 S2)
                      (andb (sub_plain f Sig E S2 S1)
                            (sub_plain f Sig (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)
                                      (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)))
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      sub_plain f (AtomSetImpl.add X Sig) E2 U1 U2
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then sub_plain f Sig E A0 B0 else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with typ_rcd_nil => true | _ => false end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      lookup_check (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_plain f Sig E0 t1 t2) E A B
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_top => false
            | typ_bvar _ => false
            end
        end
      else false
  end.

(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 8 * n + 8
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.



Lemma we_pos : forall Sig T, 1 <= we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; simpl.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - pose proof IHT; lia.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_leaf : forall Sig T U K,
  we Sig U = 1 -> we Sig (open_tt_rec K U T) = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; intros U K HU; simpl.
  - auto.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; [assumption|auto].
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl.
    + auto.
    + rewrite IHT; auto.
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_fvar : forall Sig T X,
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma we_open_opaque_label : forall Sig T l P,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_label l P)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; rewrite H; auto. Qed.


(* ===== Candidate obligation/credit measure for sub termination ===== *)

Fixpoint sum_env_w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (l : list atom) : nat :=
  match l with
  | nil => 0
  | X :: l' => w Sig E X + sum_env_w Sig E l'
  end.

Definition envw (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  sum_env_w Sig E (AtomSetImpl.elements
    (AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tt A) (fv_tt B))).

Fixpoint credits_sum (Cr : list (atom * nat)) : nat :=
  match Cr with
  | nil => 0
  | (_, c) :: Cr' => c + credits_sum Cr'
  end.

Definition M (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat)) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  we Sig A + we Sig B + envw Sig E A B + credits_sum Cr.


(* ===== Size measure for LC -> WF ===== *)

Definition sz (T : typ) : nat := we AtomSetImpl.empty T.

Lemma mem_atomset_empty : forall a, AtomSetImpl.mem a AtomSetImpl.empty = false.
Proof.

  apply (@AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a). apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sz_pos : forall T, 1 <= sz T.
Proof. intro; apply we_pos. Qed.

Lemma sz_open_fvar : forall T (X:atom), sz (open_tt T X) = sz T.
Proof. intros; apply we_open_fvar. Qed.

Proof. intros. unfold sz; simpl. pose proof (we_pos AtomSetImpl.empty A). lia. Qed.
Lemma sz_all_r : forall A B, sz B < sz (typ_all A B).
Proof. intros. unfold sz; simpl. pose proof (we_pos AtomSetImpl.empty B). lia. Qed.
Lemma sz_mu : forall A, sz A < sz (typ_mu A).
Proof. intros. unfold sz; simpl. pose proof (we_pos AtomSetImpl.empty A). lia. Qed.

Lemma AllNeedsSub_single : forall X E C D,
  sub E C D -> AllNeedsSub ((X,E,C,D)::nil).
Proof.
  intros X E C D H X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. simpl in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin]; [inversion Heq; subst; auto|contradiction].
Qed.

Lemma AllNeedsSub_nil : AllNeedsSub nil.
Proof. intros X E C D Hin. simpl in Hin. contradiction. Qed.
Lemma AllNeedsSub_cons_inv : forall X E C D l,
  AllNeedsSub ((X,E,C,D)::l) -> sub E C D /\ AllNeedsSub l.
Proof.
  intros X E C D l H. split.
  - apply (H X E C D). simpl; left; auto.
  - intros X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. apply (H X0 E0 C0 D0). simpl; right; auto.
Qed.



Definition combine2 (p q : BRes) : BRes :=
  match p with
  | (false, _) => (false, nil)
  | (true, n1) =>
      match q with
      | (false, _) => (false, nil)
      | (true, n2) => (true, append_needs n1 n2)
      end
  end.

Definition combine3 (p q r : BRes) : BRes :=
  combine2 (combine2 p q) r.


Lemma false_pair_contra : forall (n1 n2 : Needs) ok needs,
  (false, n1) = (ok, needs) -> ok = true -> False.
Proof.
  intros n1 n2 ok needs H Hok. injection H as Hv _. rewrite <- Hv in Hok. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma combine2_true_inv : forall p q ok needs,
  combine2 p q = (ok, needs) -> ok = true ->
  exists n1 n2, p = (true, n1) /\ q = (true, n2) /\
                needs = append_needs n1 n2.
Proof.
  intros p q ok needs H Hok.
  destruct p as [b1 n1]. destruct b1; simpl in H.
  - destruct q as [b2 n2]. destruct b2; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hv Hn. rewrite <- Hn. exists n1, n2. auto.
    + exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
  - exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma combine3_true_inv : forall p q r ok needs,
  combine3 p q r = (ok, needs) -> ok = true ->
  exists n1 n2 n3, p = (true,n1) /\ q = (true,n2) /\ r = (true,n3) /\
                   needs = append_needs (append_needs n1 n2) n3.
Proof.
  intros p q r ok needs H Hok. unfold combine3 in H.
  destruct (combine2 p q) as [b12 n12] eqn:H12.
  destruct b12; simpl in H.
  - destruct r as [br nr]. destruct br; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hv Hn3. rewrite <- Hn3.
      destruct (@combine2_true_inv p q true n12 H12 eq_refl)
        as [n1 [n2 [Hp [Hq Hn12]]]].
      destruct (@combine2_true_inv (true,n12) (true,nr) true
                  (append_needs n12 nr) eq_refl eq_refl)
        as [n12' [n2' [Heq [Hr Hn12r]]]].
      injection Heq as Hn12'. subst n12'.
      exists n1, n2, n2'. repeat split; auto.
      rewrite Hn12r, Hn12. auto.
    + exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
  - exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
Qed.

Fixpoint remove_credit (X : atom) (Cr : list (atom * nat)) : list (atom * nat) :=

  | nil => nil

Fixpoint check_obl (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool) (X : atom)

Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (false, nil)
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top =>
            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat =>
                match B with typ_nat => (true,nil) | _ => (false,nil) end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
                else
                  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X)
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E in
                    combine3 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S1 S2)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S2 S1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      let Sig' := AtomSetImpl.add X Sig in
                      let C := 3 * (we Sig' P1 + we Sig' P2) in
                      let Cr' := (X, C) :: Cr in
                      let active' := AtomSetImpl.add X active in
                      match sub_b f Sig' Cr' active' E2 U1 U2 with
                      | (false, _) => (false,nil)
                      | (true, needs) =>
                          let (okc, rest) :=
                            check_obl (fun Eo C0 D0 =>
                                         let (ok,nn) :=
                                           sub_b f Sig' (remove_credit X Cr')
                                             AtomSetImpl.empty Eo C0 D0 in
                                         andb ok (null_needs nn)) X needs in
                          if okc then (true, rest) else (false,nil)
                      end
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then
                      if AtomSetImpl.mem l active then
                        (true, (l,E,A0,B0) :: nil)
                      else sub_b f Sig Cr active E A0 B0
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_nil => (true,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      let (ok,n) := check_labels
                        (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_b f Sig Cr active E0 t1 t2)
                        E A B (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) in
                      if ok then (true,n) else (false,nil)
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_bvar _ => (false,nil)
            | typ_top => (false,nil) (* B top handled above *)
            end
        end
      else (false,nil)
  end.

Lemma sub_b_fvar_trans_sound : forall f Sig Cr active E (X:atom) B ok needs,
  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X) = (ok,needs) ->

  AllNeedsSub needs ->

  (forall E U B, chk E U B = true -> chk' E U B = true) ->

(* Termination / completeness infrastructure for the plain declarative search
   sub_plain (defined in dev3.v).  This file proves:

     - monotonicity of sub_plain in its fuel argument (all recursive calls
       of the algorithm are made on the predecessor fuel, so success at fuel
       n implies success at any larger fuel);

     - monotonicity of the two higher-order search combinators used by the
       algorithm (try_trans_b and lookup_check).

   The intended use is: once one exhibits *any* fuel on which sub_plain
   succeeds, monotonicity upgrades it to a bound of the form "for all fuel
   >= N".  The construction of such a fuel from a declarative derivation is
   the content of the credit/measure argument (see credits.py) and is not
   completed here; see the final report. *)

Require Import dev3.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ======================= Monotonicity of try_trans_b =================== *)

Lemma try_trans_b_mono : forall chk chk',
  (forall E U B, chk E U B = true -> chk' E U B = true) ->
  forall E Us B,
    try_trans_b chk E Us B = true -> try_trans_b chk' E Us B = true.
Proof.
  intros chk chk' Hpt E Us.
  induction Us as [|a Us IH]; intros B H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. simpl.
    destruct (chk E a B) eqn:Ea.
    + apply Hpt in Ea. rewrite Ea. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

(* ======================= Monotonicity of lookup_check ================== *)

Lemma lookup_check_mono : forall chk chk',
  (forall E t1 t2, chk E t1 t2 = true -> chk' E t1 t2 = true) ->
  forall E A B,
    lookup_check chk E A B = true -> lookup_check chk' E A B = true.
Proof.
  intros chk chk' Hpt E A B H.
  apply lookup_check_complete.
  intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  apply Hpt.
  eapply lookup_check_sound; eauto.
Qed.

(* ======================= Fuel monotonicity of sub_plain ================ *)

(* sub_plain's every recursive call is made at fuel f where the enclosing
   call is at fuel (S f).  Hence the result is monotone in the fuel. *)

Lemma sub_plain_mono : forall n m, n <= m ->
  forall Sig E A B,
    sub_plain n Sig E A B = true -> sub_plain m Sig E A B = true.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros m Hle Sig E A B H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - destruct m as [|m]; [inversion Hle|].
    assert (Hle' : n <= m) by lia.
    simpl in H. simpl.
    destruct (wf_env_b E) eqn:Ewf; [|discriminate H].
    destruct B as [| |nB|Y|B1 B2|S2 T2|M2|l' B0| |j B1 B2].
    + (* B = typ_nat *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X : transposition search *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
    + (* B = typ_top *)
      simpl in H. simpl. exact H.
    + (* B = typ_bvar nB *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      (* A = typ_fvar X *)
      eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
      intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
    + (* B = typ_fvar Y *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      (* A = typ_fvar X *)
      destruct (X == Y) as [eXY|neXY]; simpl in H.
      * subst Y.
        destruct (WF_dec E (typ_fvar X)) eqn:EWF; simpl in H; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
           intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
    + (* B = typ_arrow B1 B2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_arrow A1 A2 *)
        rewrite andb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
        rewrite andb_true_iff. split.
        -- exact (IH m Hle' Sig E B1 A1 H1).
        -- exact (IH m Hle' Sig E A2 B2 H2).
    + (* B = typ_all S2 T2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_all S1 T1 *)
        rewrite andb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H1 H2].
        rewrite andb_true_iff in H2. destruct H2 as [H2 H3].
        rewrite andb_true_iff. split.
        -- exact (IH m Hle' Sig E S1 S2 H1).
        -- rewrite andb_true_iff. split.
           ++ exact (IH m Hle' Sig E S2 S1 H2).
           ++ eapply IH; eauto.
    + (* B = typ_mu M2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_mu M1 *)
        destruct (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu M1))
                  (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu M2))
                     (andb (WF_dec (fresh3 E (typ_mu M1) (typ_mu M2)
                                       ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
                              (open_tt M1 (fresh3 E (typ_mu M1) (typ_mu M2))))
                        (WF_dec (fresh3 E (typ_mu M1) (typ_mu M2)
                                    ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E)
                              (open_tt M2 (fresh3 E (typ_mu M1) (typ_mu M2)))))))
          eqn:Ec; simpl in H; [|discriminate H].
        simpl.
        rewrite Ec. simpl.
        eapply IH; eauto.
    + (* B = typ_label l' B0 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_label l A0 *)
        destruct (l == l') as [ell|nll]; simpl in H; simpl.
        -- rewrite ell in H. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E A0 B0 H).
        -- discriminate H.
    + (* B = typ_rcd_nil *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_rcd_nil *) reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in H; try discriminate H.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 U C Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 U C Hc).
      * (* A = typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 *)
        destruct (andb
                    (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2))
                       (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2)))
                    (andb (WF_dec E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2))
                       (WF_dec E (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2))))
          eqn:Ec; simpl in H; [|discriminate H].
        simpl. rewrite Ec. simpl.
        eapply lookup_check_mono; [|exact H].
        intros E0 t1 t2 Hc. exact (IH m Hle' Sig E0 t1 t2 Hc).
Qed.

(* The "for all sufficiently large fuel" form, convenient for combining
   several sub-search calls that must share one fuel. *)

Lemma sub_plain_mono_ge : forall n m, n <= m ->
  forall Sig E A B,
    sub_plain n Sig E A B = true -> sub_plain m Sig E A B = true.
Proof. intros; eapply sub_plain_mono; eauto. Qed.

(* ===== Simpler memo/cycle-free declarative search (fueled) ===== *)

Fixpoint try_trans_b (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool)
    (E : env) (Us : list typ) (B : typ) {struct Us} : bool :=
  match Us with
  | nil => false
  | U :: Us' => if chk E U B then true else try_trans_b chk E Us' B
  end.


Lemma try_trans_b_sound : forall (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool) E Us B,
  try_trans_b chk E Us B = true ->
  (forall U, In U Us -> chk E U B = true -> sub E U B) ->
  forall X, (forall U, In U Us -> binds X (bind_sub U) E) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros chk E Us. induction Us as [|a Us']; intros B H Hchk X Hbinds.
  - simpl in H. discriminate.
  - simpl in H. destruct (chk E a B) eqn:Hc.
    + apply sa_trans_tvar with a.
      * apply (Hbinds a); simpl; left; auto.
      * apply (Hchk a); [simpl; left; auto|exact Hc].
    + eapply IHUs'.
      * exact H.
      * intros U HU HcU. apply (Hchk U); [simpl; right; auto|exact HcU].
      * intros U HU. apply (Hbinds U); simpl; right; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint sub_plain (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ)
    {struct fuel} : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => false
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top => WF_dec E A
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat => match B with typ_nat => true | _ => false end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  if WF_dec E A then true
                  else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
                else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E B1 A1) (sub_plain f Sig E A2 B2)

(* =====================================================================
   Content-credit function C for the plain declarative search.

   This file formalises the *credit count* of /workspace/.scratch/agent2/
   credits.py:   credit_count(E,Sig,L,R) = length(credits(E,Sig,L,R)).

   Because the Python measure is recursively defined along exactly the
   same edges as the search algorithm, a *fuel-free* Coq definition
   requires a termination measure that is not yet available here.  We
   therefore:
     - define `creditsF n` by structural recursion on the fuel `n`
       (this is the one-step-unfolding of the credit recursion: `n`
       bounds the depth of credit unfolding);
     - prove the unfolding equations for every case, including the
       exact fresh atom / extended environment / opened types used by
       sub_plain (all, mu), active/inactive labels and records.

   These equations are the interface needed by a subsequent
   measure-decrease proof for sub_plain's recursive calls; the
   obstruction to dropping the fuel is reported separately.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.
Require Import term.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* =====================================================================
   Generic summation over the transposition candidates `binds_sub_list E X`
   and over record fields.
   ===================================================================== *)

Definition sum_binds (f : nat -> env -> typ -> typ -> nat)
    (n : nat) (E : env) (Us : list typ) (R : typ) : nat :=
  match Us with
  | nil => 0
  | U :: Us' => f n E U R + sum_binds f n E Us' R
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   The fueled credit count.

   Definitional shape, mirroring credits.py:
     R = top                              -> 0
     L = nat                              -> 0
     L = fvar X, L = R                    -> 0
     L = fvar X                           -> 1 + sum over trans candidates
     L = arrow L1 L2, R = arrow R1 R2     -> child(R1,L1) + child(L2,R2)
     L = all SL TL, R = all SR TR         -> three children (fresh Z, E2)
     L = mu AL, R = mu AR                 -> 1 + child (fresh Z, E2, Sig+Z, U1,U2)
     L = label l A0, R = label l' B0      -> child + (l active ? 1 : 0)
     record pair                          -> sum over compared fields
     otherwise                            -> 0
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint creditsF (n : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (L R : typ) {struct n} : nat :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 0
  | S n' =>
      match R with
      | typ_top => 0
      | _ =>
          match L with
          | typ_nat => 0
          | typ_fvar X =>
              if eq_fvar_b X R then 0
              else S ((fix go (Us : list typ) : nat :=
                         match Us with
                         | nil => 0
                         | U :: Us' => creditsF n' Sig E U R + go Us'
                         end) (binds_sub_list E X))
          | typ_arrow L1 L2 =>
              match R with
              | typ_arrow R1 R2 =>
                  creditsF n' Sig E R1 L1 + creditsF n' Sig E L2 R2
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_all SL TL =>
              match R with
              | typ_all SR TR =>
                  let Z := fresh3 E L R in
                  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub SR ++ E in
                  creditsF n' Sig E SL SR
                  + creditsF n' Sig E SR SL
                  + creditsF n' Sig E2 (open_tt TL Z) (open_tt TR Z)
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_mu AL =>
              match R with
              | typ_mu AR =>
                  let Z := fresh3 E L R in
                  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
                  let PL := open_tt AL Z in
                  let PR := open_tt AR Z in
                  let UL := open_tt AL (typ_label Z PL) in
                  let UR := open_tt AR (typ_label Z PR) in
                  S (creditsF n' Sig2 E2 UL UR)
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_label l A0 =>
              match R with
              | typ_label l' B0 =>
                  if l == l' then
                    (if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig
                     then S (creditsF n' Sig E A0 B0)
                     else creditsF n' Sig E A0 B0)
                  else 0
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_rcd_nil =>
              match R with typ_rcd_nil => 0 | _ => 0 end
          | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
              match R with
              | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                  (fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
                     match ls with
                     | nil => 0
                     | k :: ls' =>
                         match Tlookup k L with
                         | Some t1 =>
                             match Tlookup k R with
                             | Some t2 => creditsF n' Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
                             | None => go ls'
                             end
                         | None => go ls'
                         end
                     end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel R))
              | _ => 0
              end
          | _ => 0
          end
      end
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   Unfolding equations.
   ===================================================================== *)

Lemma creditsF_zero : forall Sig E L R,
  creditsF 0 Sig E L R = 0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_top : forall n Sig E L,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E L typ_top = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_nat : forall n Sig E R,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_nat R = 0.
Proof. intros. destruct R; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

(* fvar: either the reflexive-success case (no credit), or one trans token
   plus the credits of every candidate in binds_sub_list E X. *)
Lemma creditsF_fvar : forall n Sig E X R,
  R <> typ_top ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) R =
  (if eq_fvar_b X R then 0
   else S ((fix go (Us : list typ) : nat :=
               match Us with
               | nil => 0
               | U :: Us' => creditsF n Sig E U R + go Us'
               end) (binds_sub_list E X))).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E X R Hne.
  destruct R; simpl; try reflexivity.
  exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_fvar_refl : forall n Sig E X,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X) = 0.
Proof.
  intros. simpl. rewrite eq_fvar_b_refl. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_arrow : forall n Sig E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
  = creditsF n Sig E B1 A1 + creditsF n Sig E A2 B2.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_all : forall n Sig E S1 T1 S2 T2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
  = creditsF n Sig E S1 S2
    + creditsF n Sig E S2 S1
    + creditsF n Sig (Z ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 Z) (open_tt T2 Z).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_mu : forall n Sig E A1 A2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
  let P1 := open_tt A1 Z in
  let P2 := open_tt A2 Z in
  let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label Z P1) in
  let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label Z P2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
  = S (creditsF n Sig2 E2 U1 U2).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_active : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = S (creditsF n Sig E A0 B0).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_inactive : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = false ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = creditsF n Sig E A0 B0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_neq : forall n Sig E l A0 l' B0,
  l <> l' ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l' B0) = 0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 l' B0 Hne.
  simpl. destruct (l == l') as [e|ne]; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil : forall n Sig E,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_cons : forall n Sig E i A1 A2 j B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)
  = ((fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
        match ls with
        | nil => 0
        | k :: ls' =>
            match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) with
            | Some t1 =>
                match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2) with
                | Some t2 => creditsF n Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
                | None => go ls'
                end
            | None => go ls'
            end
        end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)))).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Mixed record shapes contribute nothing (the field sets are empty on the
   left or right), matching the Python `collectLabel(R)` loop. *)
Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil_r : forall n Sig E R,
  R <> typ_top -> ~ rt_type R ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil R = 0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E R Htop Hrt.
  destruct R; simpl; try reflexivity; try (exfalso; apply Htop; reflexivity).
  - exfalso; apply Hrt; constructor.
  - exfalso; apply Hrt; constructor.
Qed.

(* =====================================================================
   Content-credit function C for the plain declarative search.

   This file formalises the *credit count* of /workspace/.scratch/agent2/
   credits.py:   credit_count(E,Sig,L,R) = length(credits(E,Sig,L,R)).

   Because the Python measure is recursively defined along exactly the
   same edges as the search algorithm, a *fuel-free* Coq definition
   requires a termination measure that is not yet available here.  We
   therefore:
     - define `creditsF n` by structural recursion on the fuel `n`
       (this is the one-step-unfolding of the credit recursion: `n`
       bounds the depth of credit unfolding);
     - prove the unfolding equations for every case, including the
       exact fresh atom / extended environment / opened types used by
       sub_plain (all, mu), active/inactive labels and records.

   These equations are the interface needed by a subsequent
   measure-decrease proof for sub_plain's recursive calls; the
   obstruction to dropping the fuel is reported separately.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.
Require Import term.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* =====================================================================
   Generic summation over the transposition candidates `binds_sub_list E X`
   and over record fields.
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint sum_binds (f : nat -> env -> typ -> typ -> nat)
    (n : nat) (E : env) (Us : list typ) (R : typ) {struct Us} : nat :=
  match Us with
  | nil => 0
  | U :: Us' => f n E U R + sum_binds f n E Us' R
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   The fueled credit count.

   Definitional shape, mirroring credits.py:
     R = top                              -> 0
     L = nat                              -> 0
     L = fvar X, L = R                    -> 0
     L = fvar X                           -> 1 + sum over trans candidates
     L = arrow L1 L2, R = arrow R1 R2     -> child(R1,L1) + child(L2,R2)
     L = all SL TL, R = all SR TR         -> three children (fresh Z, E2)
     L = mu AL, R = mu AR                 -> 1 + child (fresh Z, E2, Sig+Z, U1,U2)
     L = label l A0, R = label l' B0      -> child + (l active ? 1 : 0)
     record pair                          -> sum over compared fields
     otherwise                            -> 0
   ===================================================================== *)

Fixpoint creditsF (n : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (L R : typ) {struct n} : nat :=
  match n with
  | 0 => 0
  | S n' =>
      match R with
      | typ_top => 0
      | _ =>
          match L with
          | typ_nat => 0
          | typ_fvar X =>
              if eq_fvar_b X R then 0
              else S ((fix go (Us : list typ) : nat :=
                         match Us with
                         | nil => 0
                         | U :: Us' => creditsF n' Sig E U R + go Us'
                         end) (binds_sub_list E X))
          | typ_arrow L1 L2 =>
              match R with
              | typ_arrow R1 R2 =>
                  creditsF n' Sig E R1 L1 + creditsF n' Sig E L2 R2
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_all SL TL =>
              match R with
              | typ_all SR TR =>
                  let Z := fresh3 E L R in
                  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub SR ++ E in
                  creditsF n' Sig E SL SR
                  + creditsF n' Sig E SR SL
                  + creditsF n' Sig E2 (open_tt TL Z) (open_tt TR Z)
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_mu AL =>
              match R with
              | typ_mu AR =>
                  let Z := fresh3 E L R in
                  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
                  let PL := open_tt AL Z in
                  let PR := open_tt AR Z in
                  let UL := open_tt AL (typ_label Z PL) in
                  let UR := open_tt AR (typ_label Z PR) in
                  S (creditsF n' Sig2 E2 UL UR)
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_label l A0 =>
              match R with
              | typ_label l' B0 =>
                  if l == l' then
                    (if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig
                     then S (creditsF n' Sig E A0 B0)
                     else creditsF n' Sig E A0 B0)
                  else 0
              | _ => 0
              end
          | typ_rcd_nil =>
              match R with typ_rcd_nil => 0 | _ => 0 end
          | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
              match R with
              | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                  (fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
                     match ls with
                     | nil => 0
                     | k :: ls' =>
                         match Tlookup k L with
                         | Some t1 =>
                             match Tlookup k R with
                             | Some t2 => creditsF n' Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
                             | None => go ls'
                             end
                         | None => go ls'
                         end
                     end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel R))
              | _ => 0
              end
          | _ => 0
          end
      end
  end.

(* =====================================================================
   Unfolding equations.
   ===================================================================== *)

Lemma creditsF_zero : forall Sig E L R,
  creditsF 0 Sig E L R = 0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_top : forall n Sig E L,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E L typ_top = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_nat : forall n Sig E R,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_nat R = 0.
Proof. intros. destruct R; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

(* fvar: either the reflexive-success case (no credit), or one trans token
   plus the credits of every candidate in binds_sub_list E X. *)
Lemma creditsF_fvar : forall n Sig E X R,
  R <> typ_top ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) R =
  (if eq_fvar_b X R then 0
   else S ((fix go (Us : list typ) : nat :=
               match Us with
               | nil => 0
               | U :: Us' => creditsF n Sig E U R + go Us'
               end) (binds_sub_list E X))).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E X R Hne.
  destruct R; simpl; try reflexivity.
  exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_fvar_refl : forall n Sig E X,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X) = 0.
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  destruct (X == X) as [e|ne]; [simpl; reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_arrow : forall n Sig E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
  = creditsF n Sig E B1 A1 + creditsF n Sig E A2 B2.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_all : forall n Sig E S1 T1 S2 T2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
  = creditsF n Sig E S1 S2
    + creditsF n Sig E S2 S1
    + creditsF n Sig (Z ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 Z) (open_tt T2 Z).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_mu : forall n Sig E A1 A2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
  let P1 := open_tt A1 Z in
  let P2 := open_tt A2 Z in
  let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label Z P1) in
  let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label Z P2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
  = S (creditsF n Sig2 E2 U1 U2).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_active : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = S (creditsF n Sig E A0 B0).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_inactive : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = false ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = creditsF n Sig E A0 B0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_neq : forall n Sig E l A0 l' B0,
  l <> l' ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l' B0) = 0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 l' B0 Hne.
  simpl. destruct (l == l') as [e|ne]; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil : forall n Sig E,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_cons : forall n Sig E i A1 A2 j B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)
  = ((fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
        match ls with
        | nil => 0
        | k :: ls' =>
            match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) with
            | Some t1 =>
                match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2) with
                | Some t2 => creditsF n Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
                | None => go ls'
                end
            | None => go ls'
            end
        end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)))).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

(* Mixed record shapes contribute nothing (the field sets are empty on the
   left or right), matching the Python `collectLabel(R)` loop. *)
Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil_r : forall n Sig E R,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil R = 0.
Proof.
