Lemma creditsF_zero : forall Sig E L R,
  creditsF 0 Sig E L R = 0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_top : forall n Sig E L,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E L typ_top = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_nat : forall n Sig E R,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_nat R = 0.
Proof. intros. destruct R; simpl; reflexivity. Qed.

(* fvar: either the reflexive-success case (no credit), or one trans token
   plus the credits of every candidate in binds_sub_list E X. *)
Lemma creditsF_fvar : forall n Sig E X R,
  R <> typ_top ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) R =
  (if eq_fvar_b X R then 0
   else S ((fix go (Us : list typ) : nat :=
               match Us with
               | nil => 0
               | U :: Us' => creditsF n Sig E U R + go Us'
               end) (binds_sub_list E X))).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E X R Hne.
  destruct R; simpl; try reflexivity.
  exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_fvar_refl : forall n Sig E X,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X) = 0.
Proof.
  intros. simpl.
  destruct (X == X) as [e|ne]; [simpl; reflexivity|exfalso; auto].
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_arrow : forall n Sig E A1 A2 B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
  = creditsF n Sig E B1 A1 + creditsF n Sig E A2 B2.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_all : forall n Sig E S1 T1 S2 T2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
  = creditsF n Sig E S1 S2
    + creditsF n Sig E S2 S1
    + creditsF n Sig (Z ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 Z) (open_tt T2 Z).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_mu : forall n Sig E A1 A2,
  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
  let P1 := open_tt A1 Z in
  let P2 := open_tt A2 Z in
  let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label Z P1) in
  let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label Z P2) in
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
  = S (creditsF n Sig2 E2 U1 U2).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_active : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = S (creditsF n Sig E A0 B0).
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_inactive : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = false ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
  = creditsF n Sig E A0 B0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_label_neq : forall n Sig E l A0 l' B0,
  l <> l' ->
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l' B0) = 0.
Proof.
  intros n Sig E l A0 l' B0 Hne.
  simpl. destruct (l == l') as [e|ne]; [|reflexivity].
  exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil : forall n Sig E,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil = 0.
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma creditsF_rcd_cons : forall n Sig E i A1 A2 j B1 B2,
  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)
  = ((fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
        match ls with
        | nil => 0
        | k :: ls' =>
            match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) with
            | Some t1 =>
                match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2) with
                | Some t2 => creditsF n Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
                | None => go ls'
                end
            | None => go ls'
            end
        end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)))).
Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)

(* ===== Fueled checked-obligation sub procedure (algorithm only) ===== *)

Definition Needs := list (atom * env * typ * typ)%type.
Definition BRes := (bool * Needs)%type.




Definition null_needs (n : Needs) : bool :=
  match n with nil => true | _ => false end.

Definition append_needs (n1 n2 : Needs) : Needs := n1 ++ n2.

Definition AllNeedsSub (n : Needs) : Prop :=
  forall X E C D, In (X,E,C,D) n -> sub E C D.

Lemma AllNeedsSub_app_l : forall n1 n2,
  AllNeedsSub (append_needs n1 n2) -> AllNeedsSub n1.
Proof.
  intros n1 n2 H X E C D Hin.
  apply (H X E C D). unfold append_needs. apply in_or_app. left; auto.
Qed.
Lemma AllNeedsSub_app_r : forall n1 n2,
  AllNeedsSub (append_needs n1 n2) -> AllNeedsSub n2.
Proof.
  intros n1 n2 H X E C D Hin.
  apply (H X E C D). unfold append_needs. apply in_or_app. right; auto.
Qed.
Lemma AllNeedsSub_single : forall X E C D,
  sub E C D -> AllNeedsSub ((X,E,C,D)::nil).
Proof.
  intros X E C D H X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. simpl in Hin.
  destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin]; [inversion Heq; subst; auto|contradiction].
Qed.

Lemma AllNeedsSub_nil : AllNeedsSub nil.
Proof. intros X E C D Hin. simpl in Hin. contradiction. Qed.
Lemma AllNeedsSub_cons_inv : forall X E C D l,
  AllNeedsSub ((X,E,C,D)::l) -> sub E C D /\ AllNeedsSub l.
Proof.
  intros X E C D l H. split.
  - apply (H X E C D). simpl; left; auto.
  - intros X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. apply (H X0 E0 C0 D0). simpl; right; auto.
Qed.



Definition combine2 (p q : BRes) : BRes :=
  match p with
  | (false, _) => (false, nil)
  | (true, n1) =>
      match q with
      | (false, _) => (false, nil)
      | (true, n2) => (true, append_needs n1 n2)
      end
  end.

Definition combine3 (p q r : BRes) : BRes :=
  combine2 (combine2 p q) r.


Lemma false_pair_contra : forall (n1 n2 : Needs) ok needs,
  (false, n1) = (ok, needs) -> ok = true -> False.
Proof.
  intros n1 n2 ok needs H Hok. injection H as Hv _. rewrite <- Hv in Hok. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma combine2_true_inv : forall p q ok needs,
  combine2 p q = (ok, needs) -> ok = true ->
  exists n1 n2, p = (true, n1) /\ q = (true, n2) /\
                needs = append_needs n1 n2.
Proof.
  intros p q ok needs H Hok.
  destruct p as [b1 n1]. destruct b1; simpl in H.
  - destruct q as [b2 n2]. destruct b2; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hv Hn. rewrite <- Hn. exists n1, n2. auto.
    + exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
  - exfalso; eapply false_pair_contra; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma combine3_true_inv : forall p q r ok needs,
  combine3 p q r = (ok, needs) -> ok = true ->
  exists n1 n2 n3, p = (true,n1) /\ q = (true,n2) /\ r = (true,n3) /\
                   needs = append_needs (append_needs n1 n2) n3.
Proof.
  intros p q r ok needs H Hok. unfold combine3 in H.
  destruct (combine2 p q) as [b12 n12] eqn:H12.
  destruct b12; simpl in H.
  - destruct r as [br nr]. destruct br; simpl in H.
    + injection H as Hv Hn3. rewrite <- Hn3.
      destruct (@combine2_true_inv p q true n12 H12 eq_refl)
        as [n1 [n2 [Hp [Hq Hn12]]]].
      destruct (@combine2_true_inv (true,n12) (true,nr) true
                  (append_needs n12 nr) eq_refl eq_refl)
        as [n12' [n2' [Heq [Hr Hn12r]]]].
      injection Heq as Hn12'. subst n12'.
      exists n1, n2, n2'. repeat split; auto.

Fixpoint remove_credit (X : atom) (Cr : list (atom * nat)) : list (atom * nat) :=
  match Cr with
  | nil => nil
  | (Y,c) :: Cr' =>
      if X == Y then remove_credit X Cr'

Fixpoint check_obl (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool) (X : atom)
    (l : Needs) {struct l} : bool * Needs :=
  match l with
  | nil => (true, nil)
  | (Y,E,C,D) :: l' =>
      let (okr, rest) := check_obl chk X l' in
      if Y == X then (andb (chk E C D) okr, rest)
      else (okr, (Y,E,C,D) :: rest)
  end.

Lemma check_obl_sound : forall chk (X:atom) l ok rest,
  check_obl chk X l = (ok, rest) ->
  ok = true ->
  (forall E C D, chk E C D = true -> sub E C D) ->
  AllNeedsSub rest ->
  AllNeedsSub l.
Proof.
  intros chk X l. induction l as [|h l'].
  - simpl. intros ok rest H _ _ _. inversion H; subst. apply AllNeedsSub_nil.
  - destruct h as [h0 D]. destruct h0 as [h1 C]. destruct h1 as [Y E].
    simpl. intros ok rest H Hok Hchk Hrest.
    destruct (check_obl chk X l') as [okr restr] eqn:Hr.
    destruct (Y == X) as [e|ne].
    + simpl in H. injection H as Hend HrestEq.
      assert (Hand : andb (chk E C D) okr = true) by (rewrite Hend; exact Hok).
      rewrite andb_true_iff in Hand. destruct Hand as [Hc Hokr].
      assert (HrestR : AllNeedsSub restr) by (rewrite HrestEq; auto).
      assert (HrestL : AllNeedsSub l') by (eapply IHl'; eauto).
      intros X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * injection Heq as HY HE HC HD. subst X0 E0 C0 D0. apply Hchk; auto.
      * apply (HrestL X0 E0 C0 D0); auto.
    + simpl in H. injection H as HokEq HconsEq.
      assert (Hokr : okr = true) by (rewrite HokEq; auto).
      assert (HrestCons : AllNeedsSub ((Y,E,C,D)::restr)) by (rewrite HconsEq; auto).
      destruct (@AllNeedsSub_cons_inv Y E C D restr HrestCons) as [Hhead Htail].
      assert (HrestL : AllNeedsSub l') by (eapply IHl'; eauto).
      intros X0 E0 C0 D0 Hin. simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * injection Heq as HY HE HC HD. subst X0 E0 C0 D0. auto.
      * apply (HrestL X0 E0 C0 D0); auto.
Qed.



Fixpoint check_labels (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> BRes)
    (E : env) (A B : typ) (labels : list atom) {struct labels} : BRes :=
  match labels with
  | nil => (true, nil)
  | i :: l =>
      match Tlookup i A with
      | None => check_labels chk E A B l
      | Some t1 =>
          match Tlookup i B with
          | None => (false, nil)
          | Some t2 =>
              let (ok1,n1) := chk E t1 t2 in
              if ok1 then
                let (ok2,n2) := check_labels chk E A B l in
                if ok2 then (true, append_needs n1 n2) else (false, nil)
              else (false, nil)
          end
      end
  end.

Lemma check_labels_sound : forall (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> BRes)
    (E : env) (A B : typ) labels ok needs,
  check_labels chk E A B labels = (ok, needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  (forall E0 t1 t2 n0,
      chk E0 t1 t2 = (true, n0) -> AllNeedsSub n0 -> sub E0 t1 t2) ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  forall i, In i labels ->
    forall t1 t2, Tlookup i A = Some t1 -> Tlookup i B = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2.
Proof.
  intros chk E A B labels. induction labels as [|a l].
  - simpl. intros ok needs H _ _ _ i Hin. contradiction.
  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok Hchk Hneeds i Hin t1 t2 H1 H2.
    destruct (Tlookup a A) as [ta1|] eqn:EA.
    + destruct (Tlookup a B) as [ta2|] eqn:EB.
      * destruct (chk E ta1 ta2) as [ok1 n1] eqn:Hc.
        destruct ok1.
        -- destruct (check_labels chk E A B l) as [ok2 n2] eqn:Htail.
           destruct ok2.
           ++ injection H as Htrue HneedsEq.
              assert (Happ : AllNeedsSub (append_needs n1 n2))
                by (rewrite <- HneedsEq in Hneeds; exact Hneeds).
              assert (Hn1 : AllNeedsSub n1) by (apply (@AllNeedsSub_app_l n1 n2); auto).
              assert (Hn2 : AllNeedsSub n2) by (apply (@AllNeedsSub_app_r n1 n2); auto).
              simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
              ** subst a.
                 assert (Et1 : t1 = ta1) by (rewrite H1 in EA; injection EA; auto).
                 assert (Et2 : t2 = ta2) by (rewrite H2 in EB; injection EB; auto).
                 subst t1 t2. apply (Hchk E ta1 ta2 n1); auto.
              ** eapply IHl; eauto.
           ++ injection H as Hfalse _; rewrite <- Hfalse in Hok; discriminate Hok.
        -- injection H as Hfalse _; rewrite <- Hfalse in Hok; discriminate Hok.
      * injection H as Hfalse _; rewrite <- Hfalse in Hok; discriminate Hok.
    + simpl in Hin. destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
      * subst a. rewrite EA in H1. discriminate.
      * eapply IHl; eauto.
Qed.


Definition eq_fvar_b (X : atom) (B : typ) : bool :=
  match B with
  | typ_fvar Y => if X == Y then true else false
  | _ => false
  end.


Fixpoint try_trans (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> BRes) (E : env) (X : atom)
    (B : typ) (Us : list typ) {struct Us} : BRes :=
  match Us with
  | nil => (false, nil)
  | U :: Us' =>
      match chk E U B with
      | (true, n) => (true, n)
      | (false, _) => try_trans chk E X B Us'
      end
  end.


Lemma try_trans_sound : forall chk E X B Us ok needs,
  try_trans chk E X B Us = (ok, needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  (forall U n, chk E U B = (true, n) -> AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
  (forall U, In U Us -> binds X (bind_sub U) E) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros chk E X B Us. induction Us as [|a Us'].
  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok _ _ _. injection H as Hv _.
    rewrite <- Hv in Hok. discriminate Hok.
  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok Hneeds Hchk Hbinds.
    destruct (chk E a B) as [oka na] eqn:Ha.
    destruct oka.
    + injection H as Hv Hn. rewrite <- Hn in Hneeds.
      eapply sa_trans_tvar.
      * apply Hbinds. simpl; left; auto.
      * apply (Hchk a na); auto.
    + eapply IHUs'; eauto.
Qed.




Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (false, nil)
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top =>
            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat =>
                match B with typ_nat => (true,nil) | _ => (false,nil) end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
                else
                  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X)
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E in
                    combine3 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S1 S2)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S2 S1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      let Sig' := AtomSetImpl.add X Sig in
                      let C := 3 * (we Sig' P1 + we Sig' P2) in
                      let Cr' := (X, C) :: Cr in
                      let active' := AtomSetImpl.add X active in
                      match sub_b f Sig' Cr' active' E2 U1 U2 with
                      | (false, _) => (false,nil)
                      | (true, needs) =>
                          let (okc, rest) :=
                            check_obl (fun Eo C0 D0 =>
                                         let (ok,nn) :=
                                           sub_b f Sig' (remove_credit X Cr')
                                             AtomSetImpl.empty Eo C0 D0 in
                                         andb ok (null_needs nn)) X needs in
                          if okc then (true, rest) else (false,nil)
                      end
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then
                      if AtomSetImpl.mem l active then
                        (true, (l,E,A0,B0) :: nil)
                      else sub_b f Sig Cr active E A0 B0
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_nil => (true,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      let (ok,n) := check_labels
                        (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_b f Sig Cr active E0 t1 t2)
                        E A B (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) in
                      if ok then (true,n) else (false,nil)
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_bvar _ => (false,nil)
            | typ_top => (false,nil) (* B top handled above *)
            end
        end
      else (false,nil)
  end.

Lemma sub_b_fvar_trans_sound : forall f Sig Cr active E (X:atom) B ok needs,
  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X) = (ok,needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  (forall U n, sub_b f Sig Cr active E U B = (true,n) ->
               AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply try_trans_sound with
    (chk := sub_b f Sig Cr active) (Us := binds_sub_list E X); eauto.
  intros U HU. apply binds_sub_list_spec; auto.
Qed.

Definition sub_top_b (fuel:nat) (Sig:atoms) (Cr:list (atom*nat))
    (E:env) (A B:typ) : bool :=
  let (ok,needs) := sub_b fuel Sig Cr AtomSetImpl.empty E A B in
  andb ok (null_needs needs).

  M AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

Definition sub_dec (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  sub_top_b (fuel0 E A B) AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

import sys, random, time
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
import measure_checked as M
NAT,TOP,NIL=M.NAT,M.TOP,M.NIL
b,v,arr,allt,mu,lab,cons=M.b,M.v,M.arr,M.allt,M.mu,M.lab,M.cons
wf_dec,wf_env=M.wf_dec,M.wf_env
import harness
from measure_run import enum_terms, hasb

def build(maxsize=3,nrandom=500,seed=11,d=4,nenv=2):
    terms=enum_terms(maxsize)
    keep=[T for T in terms if hasb(T) and wf_dec([],mu(T))]
    cases=[]
    for T1 in keep:
        for T2 in keep:
            cases.append(([],mu(T1),mu(T2)))
    for T in terms:
        if wf_dec([],T):
            cases.append(([],T,mu(T))); cases.append(([],mu(T),T))
    random.seed(seed); got=0; tried=0
    while got<nrandom and tried<nrandom*100:
        tried+=1
        c=harness.gen_random_case(d=d,nenv=nenv)
        if c is None: continue
        E,A,B=c
        if wf_dec(E,A) and wf_dec(E,B):
            cases.append(c); got+=1
    return terms,keep,cases,got,tried

def run(cases,cands,oblig_modes=('mu','handler')):
    for name,p in cands:
        for om in oblig_modes:
            tot,viol=M.check_measures(cases,p,oblig_mode=om)
            bad=sum(len(v) for v in viol.values())
            print('CAND',name,'om',om,'edges',sum(tot.values()),'bad',bad)
            for k in sorted(viol):
                v=viol[k]
                print('   %-14s %6d/%6d'%(k,len(v),tot[k]))
                for (e,pm,cm) in v[:2]:
                    print('      par',pm,'ch',cm,'E',e['E'],'A',e['A'],'B',e['B'])
                    print('        ->',e['cE'],e['cA'],e['cB'],'sig',e['sig'])

if __name__=='__main__':
    ms=int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv)>1 else 3
    nr=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 300
    dd=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 4
    ne=int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv)>4 else 2
    terms,keep,cases,got,tried=build(ms,nr,11,dd,ne)
    print('cases',len(cases),'random got/tried',got,tried,'mu bodies',len(keep),flush=True)
    cands=[
      ('A unit mu1 env1 pb0',dict(fvar='unit',mu=1,label='sig',envw=1,per_binding=0)),
      ('A2 unit mu1 env1 pb0 pend1',dict(fvar='unit',mu=1,label='sig',envw=1,per_binding=0,pendw=1)),
      ('B bind mu1 env0 pend1',dict(fvar='binding',mu=1,label='sig',envw=0,pendw=1)),
      ('B2 bind mu1 env1 pb0 pend1',dict(fvar='binding',mu=1,label='sig',envw=1,per_binding=0,pendw=1)),
      ('B3 bind mu2 env0 pend1',dict(fvar='binding',mu=2,label='sig',envw=0,pendw=1)),
      ('C bind mu1 env0 pend0',dict(fvar='binding',mu=1,label='sig',envw=0)),
    ]
    run(cases,cands)

import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/.scratch/agent2')
import common as C, alg as A, credits as CR
from alg import szS, envw, fv_occ
run=A.mk_alg('rec','rec','lhs','full',use_mode=False, step_cap=200000, expansion_cap=100000, depth_cap=2000)

def M_old(Sig,E,L,R):
    return szS(Sig,L)+szS(Sig,R)+envw(Sig,E,L,R)

def active_count(Sig,T):
    t=T[0]
    if t in ('nat','top','nil','b','v'): return 0
    if t in ('arr','all'): return active_count(Sig,T[1])+active_count(Sig,T[2])
    if t=='mu': return active_count(Sig,T[1])
    if t=='lab': return (1 if T[1] in Sig else 0)+active_count(Sig,T[2])
    return active_count(Sig,T[2])+active_count(Sig,T[3])

def cands(Sig,E,L,R):
    s=szS(Sig,L)+szS(Sig,R)
    a=active_count(Sig,L)+active_count(Sig,R)
    fc=len(fv_occ(L))+len(fv_occ(R))
    return {
      'old': s+envw(Sig,E,L,R),
      'size': s,
      'size_active': (s,a),
      'size_fc': (s,fc),
      'sum_active': s+a,
      'sum_fc': s+fc,
      'credit_size': (len(CR.credits(E,Sig,L,R)), s),
      'credit_count_size': (CR.credit_count(E,Sig,L,R), s),
    }

def check_goals(goals,label,limit=50):
    t0=time.time(); bad={}; edges=0; succ=0
    for gi,(E,a,b) in enumerate(goals):
        if time.time()-t0>limit: print(label,'TIME CUT',gi); break
        # only positive true goals? run anyway
        res=run(E,a,b)
        if run.state['aborted']: continue
        memo=run.memo
        for par,ch,kind in run.trace:
            Ep,Lp,Rp,Sp=par; Ec,Lc,Rc,Sc=ch
            key=(Ec,Lc,Rc,Sc)
            okc=memo.get(key)
            if okc is not True: continue
            succ+=1
            mp=cands(Sp,Ep,Lp,Rp); mc=cands(Sc,Ec,Lc,Rc)
            for name in mp:
                if not (mc[name] < mp[name]):
                    bad.setdefault(name,[]).append((kind,par,ch,mp[name],mc[name]))
            edges+=1
        if (gi+1)%100==0: print(label,'progress',gi+1,'edges',edges,'succ',succ,'time',round(time.time()-t0,2))
    print(label,'DONE goals',len(goals),'edges',edges,'succ',succ,'time',round(time.time()-t0,2))
    for k,v in bad.items():
        print(' BAD',k,len(v))
        for x in v[:3]: print('   ',str(x)[:500])
    return bad

random.seed(98765)

import sys, time, math, random
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)
import algs
from algs import NAT,TOP,NIL,b,v,arr,allt,mu,lab,cons,wf_dec,wf_env,size
from algs import alg_top, alg_fast_top, decl_search_top

def tree_size_case(E,A,B):
    return size(A)+size(B)+sum(size(T)+1 for (_,_,T) in E)

def run_case(name,E,A,B,maxsteps=3000000):
    t0=time.time()
    r,st,exc=alg_top(E,A,B,maxsteps)
    t1=time.time()
    rf,stf,excf=alg_fast_top(E,A,B,maxsteps)
    t2=time.time()
    n=tree_size_case(E,A,B)
    print('%-32s size %6d | alg %8d%s %.3fs | fast %8d%s %.3fs | r=%s/%s'%(
        name,n,st,' EXC' if exc else '',t1-t0,stf,' EXC' if excf else '',t2-t1,r,rf),flush=True)
    return n,st,stf,exc,excf

def tower(d, k=2):
    # body has k free b0 occurrences followed by an inner mu; size linear in d
    T=mu(b(0))
    for i in range(d):
        body=T
        for j in range(k):
            body=arr(b(0),body)
        T=mu(body)
    return T

def tower_wide(n):
    # n independent mu(b0) pairs in an arrow chain
    T=mu(b(0))
    for i in range(n):
        T=arr(T,mu(b(0)))
    return T

def nested_shared(d):
    # T_d = mu(arr(b0,arr(b0,T_{d-1}))) both sides same; compare T_d <: T_d
    return tower(d,2)

if __name__=='__main__':
    print('=== nested-mu duplication tower, k=2 free b0 per level ===')
    rows=[]
    for d in range(0,13):
        T=tower(d,2)
        if not wf_dec([],T): print('not wf',d); continue
        try:
            rows.append((d,)+run_case('tower k2 d=%d'%d,[],T,T,3000000))
        except Exception as e:
            print('d',d,'EXC',e)
        if time.time()>0:
            pass
    print('\n=== nested-mu tower, k=4 ===')
    for d in range(0,9):
        T=tower(d,4)
        if not wf_dec([],T): print('not wf',d); continue
        run_case('tower k4 d=%d'%d,[],T,T,3000000)
    print('\n=== wide independent mu pairs ===')
    for n in (1,2,4,8,16,32):
        T=tower_wide(n)
        if wf_dec([],T): run_case('wide n=%d'%n,[],T,T,3000000)

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

content.content:
Require Export Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export String.

Inductive typ : Set :=
  | typ_nat : typ
  | typ_top : typ
  | typ_bvar : nat -> typ
  | typ_fvar : var -> typ
  | typ_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_all : typ -> typ -> typ
  | typ_mu : typ -> typ
  | typ_label : var -> typ -> typ
  | typ_rcd_nil : typ
  | typ_rcd_cons : var -> typ -> typ -> typ
.

Coercion typ_bvar : nat >-> typ.

Coercion typ_fvar : atom >-> typ.

Inductive exp : Set :=
  | exp_bvar : nat -> exp
  | exp_fvar : atom -> exp
  | exp_abs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_app : exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tabs : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_tapp : exp -> typ -> exp
  | exp_nat : exp
  | exp_unfold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_fold : typ -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_nil : exp
  | exp_rcd_cons : var -> exp -> exp -> exp
  | exp_rcd_proj : exp -> var -> exp
.

Coercion exp_bvar : nat >-> exp.

Coercion exp_fvar : atom >-> exp.

Fixpoint open_tt_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat         => typ_nat
  | typ_top         => typ_top
  | typ_bvar J      => if K === J then U else (typ_bvar J)
  | typ_fvar X      => typ_fvar X
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec (S K) U T2)
  | typ_mu T        => typ_mu (open_tt_rec (S K) U T)
  | typ_label l T        => typ_label l (open_tt_rec K U T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (open_tt_rec K U T1) (open_tt_rec K U T2)
  end.

Definition open_tt T U := open_tt_rec 0 U T.

Inductive rt_type : typ -> Prop :=
  | rt_type_rcd_nil :
      rt_type typ_rcd_nil
  | rt_type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      rt_type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive type : typ -> Prop :=
  | type_top :
      type typ_top
  | type_nat :
      type typ_nat
  | type_var : forall X,
      type (typ_fvar X)
  | type_arrow : forall T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      type (typ_arrow T1 T2)
  | type_mu : forall L T,
      (forall X, X \notin L -> type (open_tt T (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_mu T)
  | type_all : forall L T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      (forall X, X `notin` L -> type (open_tt T2 (typ_fvar X))) ->
      type (typ_all T1 T2)
  | type_label: forall l A,
      type A ->
      type (typ_label l A)
  | type_rcd_nil :
      type typ_rcd_nil
  | type_rcd_cons : forall i T1 T2,
      type T1 ->
      type T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      type (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2).

Fixpoint subst_tt (Z : atom) (U : typ) (T : typ) {struct T} : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => typ_top
  | typ_nat => typ_nat
  | typ_bvar J => typ_bvar J
  | typ_fvar X => if X == Z then U else (typ_fvar X)
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => typ_arrow (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_mu T => typ_mu (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_label l T => typ_label l (subst_tt Z U T)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => typ_all (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => typ_rcd_cons i (subst_tt Z U T1) (subst_tt Z U T2)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {{ X }}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fv_tt T1) `union` (fv_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_label l T => (fv_tt T)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => fv_tt T1 \u fv_tt T2
  end.

Inductive binding : Set :=
| bind_sub : typ -> binding
| bind_typ : typ -> binding.

Definition env := list (atom * binding).

Notation empty := (@nil (atom * binding)).

Fixpoint Tlookup (i':var) (Tr:typ) : option typ :=
  match Tr with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) =>
      if i == i' then Some T1 else Tlookup i' T2
  | _ => None
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabel (T : typ) : atoms :=
  match T with
  | (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2) => {{i}} \u collectLabel T2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Fixpoint collectLabele (e: exp) : atoms :=
  match e with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) => {{i}} \u collectLabele e2
  | _ => {}
  end.

Inductive WF : env -> typ -> Prop :=
| WF_top : forall E, WF E typ_top
| WF_nat : forall E, WF E typ_nat
| WF_var: forall U E (X : atom),
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      WF E (typ_fvar X)
| WF_arrow : forall E A B,
    WF E A ->
    WF E B ->
    WF E (typ_arrow A B)
| WF_all : forall L E T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      WF E (typ_all T1 T2)
| WF_rec : forall L E A,
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A X)) ->
      (forall X, X \notin L ->
                 WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A (typ_label X (open_tt A X)))) ->
      WF E (typ_mu A)
| WF_label: forall E A X,
    WF E A ->
    WF E (typ_label X A)
| WF_rcd_nil : forall E,
      WF E typ_rcd_nil
| WF_rcd_cons : forall E i T1 T2,
      WF E T1 ->
      WF E T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabel T2) ->
      WF E (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Fixpoint fl_tt (T : typ) {struct T} : atoms :=
  match T with
  | typ_top => {}
  | typ_nat => {}
  | typ_bvar J => {}
  | typ_fvar X => {}
  | typ_arrow T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) `union` (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_mu T => (fl_tt T)
  | typ_label X T => {{ X }} `union` fl_tt T
  | typ_all T1 T2 => (fl_tt T1) \u (fl_tt T2)
  | typ_rcd_nil     => {}
  | typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2  => {{i}} \u fl_tt T1 \u fl_tt T2
  end.

Fixpoint fv_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fv_tt y) \u (fv_env E')
  end.

Fixpoint fl_env (E:env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => {}
  | (x,bind_sub y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  | (x,bind_typ y)::E' => (fl_tt y) \u (fl_env E')
  end.

Inductive wf_env : env -> Prop :=
  | wf_env_empty :
      wf_env empty
  | wf_env_sub : forall (E : env) (X : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      X `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (X ~ bind_sub T ++ E)
  | wf_env_typ : forall (E : env) (x : atom) (T : typ),
      wf_env E ->
      WF E T ->
      x `notin` dom E ->
      wf_env (x ~ bind_typ T ++ E).

Inductive sub : env -> typ -> typ -> Prop :=
| sa_nat: forall E,
    wf_env E ->
    sub E typ_nat typ_nat
| sa_fvar: forall E X,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E (typ_fvar X) ->
    sub E (typ_fvar X) (typ_fvar X)
| sa_top : forall E A,
    wf_env E ->
    WF E A ->
    sub E A typ_top
| sa_trans_tvar : forall U E T X,
      binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
      sub E U T ->
      sub E (typ_fvar X) T
| sa_arrow: forall E A1 A2 B1 B2,
    sub E B1 A1 ->
    sub E A2 B2 ->
    sub E (typ_arrow A1 A2) (typ_arrow B1 B2)
| sa_all : forall L E S1 S2 T1 T2,
    sub E S1 S2 ->
    sub E S2 S1 ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
          sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)) ->
      sub E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)
| sa_rec: forall L A1 A2 E,
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        WF (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A2 X)) ->
    (forall X,
        X \notin L ->
        sub (X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E) (open_tt A1 (typ_label X (open_tt A1 X))) (open_tt A2 (typ_label X (open_tt A2 X)))) ->
    sub E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
| sa_label: forall E X A B,
    sub E A B ->
    sub E (typ_label X A) (typ_label X B)
| sa_rcd: forall A1 A2 E,
    wf_env E ->
    rt_type A1 ->
    rt_type A2 ->
    collectLabel A2 [<=] collectLabel A1 ->
    WF E A1 -> WF E A2 ->
    (forall i t1 t2, Tlookup i A1 = Some t1 ->  Tlookup i A2 = Some t2 -> sub E t1 t2) ->
    sub E A1 A2
.

Definition subst_tb (Z : atom) (P : typ) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (subst_tt Z P T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (subst_tt Z P T)
  end.

Fixpoint open_te_rec (K : nat) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec K U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (open_tt_rec K U V)  (open_te_rec (S K) U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_tt_rec K U V)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (open_tt_rec K U V) (open_te_rec K U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_te_rec K U e1) (open_te_rec K U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_te_rec K U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint open_ee_rec (k : nat) (f : exp) (e : exp)  {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => if k == i then f else (exp_bvar i)
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (open_ee_rec (S k) f e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (open_ee_rec k f e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (open_ee_rec k f e1) V
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (open_ee_rec k f e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (open_ee_rec k f e1) (open_ee_rec k f e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (open_ee_rec k f e1) i
  end.

Definition open_te e U := open_te_rec 0 U e.

Definition open_ee e1 e2 := open_ee_rec 0 e2 e1.

Inductive rt_expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | rt_expr_rcd_nil :
      rt_expr exp_rcd_nil
  | rt_expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      rt_expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive expr : exp -> Prop :=
  | expr_nat : expr exp_nat
  | expr_var : forall x,
      expr (exp_fvar x)
  | expr_abs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e1 x)) ->
      expr (exp_abs T e1)
  | expr_app : forall e1 e2,
      expr e1 ->
      expr e2 ->
      expr (exp_app e1 e2)
  | expr_tabs : forall L T e1,
      type T ->
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L -> expr (open_te e1 X)) ->
      expr (exp_tabs T e1)
  | expr_tapp : forall e1 V,
      expr e1 ->
      type V ->
      expr (exp_tapp e1 V)
  | expr_unfold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_unfold T e)
  | expr_fold: forall T e,
     type T ->
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_fold T e)
  | expr_rcd_nil :
     expr exp_rcd_nil
  | expr_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
     expr e1 ->
     expr e2 ->
     rt_expr e2 ->
     expr (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
  | expr_rcd_proj : forall i e,
     expr e ->
     expr (exp_rcd_proj e i)
.

Definition body_e (e : exp) :=
  exists L, forall x : atom, x `notin` L -> expr (open_ee e x).

Fixpoint tlookup (i':var) (Er:exp) : option exp :=
  match Er with
  | (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) =>
      if i == i' then Some e1 else tlookup i' e2
  | _ => None
  end.

Inductive typing : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
  | typing_nat: forall G,
    wf_env G ->
    typing G (exp_nat) (typ_nat)
  | typing_var : forall E x T,
      wf_env E ->
      binds x (bind_typ T) E ->
      typing E (exp_fvar x) T
  | typing_abs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall x : atom, x `notin` L ->
        typing (x ~ bind_typ V ++ E) (open_ee e1 x) T1) ->
      typing E (exp_abs V e1) (typ_arrow V T1)
  | typing_app : forall T1 E e1 e2 T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_arrow T1 T2) ->
      typing E e2 T1 ->
      typing E (exp_app e1 e2) T2
  | typing_tabs : forall L E V e1 T1,
      (forall X : atom, X `notin` L ->
        typing (X ~ bind_sub V ++ E) (open_te e1 X) (open_tt T1 X)) ->
      typing E (exp_tabs V e1) (typ_all V T1)
  | typing_tapp : forall T1 E e1 T T2,
      typing E e1 (typ_all T1 T2) ->
      sub E T T1 ->
      typing E (exp_tapp e1 T) (open_tt T2 T)
  | typing_fold : forall G A T e ,
      sub G (typ_mu A) T ->
      typing G e (open_tt A T)  ->
      typing G (exp_fold T e) T
  | typing_unfold : forall G A T e,
     typing G e A -> sub G A (typ_mu T) ->
     typing G (exp_unfold A e)  (open_tt T A)
  | typing_sub : forall S E e T,
      typing E e S ->
      sub E S T ->
      typing E e T
  | typing_proj : forall G e T i Ti,
      typing G e T ->
      Tlookup i T = Some Ti ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_proj e i) Ti
  | typing_rcd_nil : forall G,
      wf_env G ->
      typing G exp_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil
  | typing_rcd_cons: forall G e1 e2 T1 T2 i,
      typing G e1 T1 ->
      typing G e2 T2 ->
      rt_type T2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      i \notin (collectLabele e2) ->
      typing G (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2) (typ_rcd_cons i T1 T2)
.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
  | value_abs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_abs T t1) ->
      value (exp_abs T t1)
  | value_tabs : forall t1 T,
      expr (exp_tabs T t1) ->
      value (exp_tabs T t1)
  | value_nat:
      value exp_nat
  | value_fold: forall T e,
      type T ->
      value e ->
      value (exp_fold T e)
  | value_rcd_nil:
      value exp_rcd_nil
 | value_rcd_cons : forall i e1 e2,
      value e1 ->
      value e2 ->
      rt_expr e2 ->
      value (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2)
.

Inductive step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_beta : forall (e1 e2:exp) T,
     expr (exp_abs T e1) ->
     value e2 ->
     step (exp_app  (exp_abs T e1) e2)  (open_ee e1 e2)
 | step_app1 : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     expr e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (exp_app e1 e2) (exp_app e1' e2)
 | step_app2 : forall v1 e2 e2',
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (exp_app v1 e2) (exp_app v1 e2')
 | step_tapp : forall e1 e1' V,
      type V ->
      step e1 e1' ->
      step (exp_tapp e1 V) (exp_tapp e1' V)
 | step_tabs : forall T1 e1 T2,
      expr (exp_tabs T1 e1) ->
      type T2 ->
      step (exp_tapp (exp_tabs T1 e1) T2) (open_te e1 T2)
 | step_fld: forall S T v,
     value v ->
     type T ->
     type S ->
     step (exp_unfold S (exp_fold T v)) v
 | step_fold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_fold T e) (exp_fold T e')
 | step_unfold: forall e e' T,
     step e e' ->
     type T ->
     step (exp_unfold T e) (exp_unfold T e')
 | step_projrcd: forall e i vi ,
     value e ->
     tlookup i e = Some vi->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e i) vi
 | step_proj: forall e1 e2 i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_proj e1 i) (exp_rcd_proj e2 i)
 | step_rcd_head: forall e1 e2 e i,
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i e1 e) (exp_rcd_cons i e2 e)
 | step_rcd_cons: forall v1 e1 e2 i,
     value v1 ->
     step e1 e2 ->
     step (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e1) (exp_rcd_cons i v1 e2)
.

Fixpoint fv_te (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {}
  | exp_abs V e1  => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_tt V) `union` (fv_te e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_tt V \u fv_te e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_te e1) `union` (fv_te e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_te e1)
  end.

Fixpoint fv_ee (e : exp) {struct e} : atoms :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => {}
  | exp_bvar i => {}
  | exp_fvar x => {{ x }}
  | exp_abs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => (fv_ee e1)
  | exp_fold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_unfold V e => fv_ee e
  | exp_rcd_nil => {}
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => (fv_ee e1) `union` (fv_ee e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => (fv_ee e1)
  end.

Fixpoint subst_te (Z : atom) (U : typ) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => exp_fvar x
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs  (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app  (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs (subst_tt Z U V)  (subst_te Z U e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_tt Z U V)
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold (subst_tt Z U V) (subst_te Z U e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_te Z U e1) (subst_te Z U e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_te Z U e1) i
  end.

Fixpoint subst_ee (z : atom) (u : exp) (e : exp) {struct e} : exp :=
  match e with
  | exp_nat => exp_nat
  | exp_bvar i => exp_bvar i
  | exp_fvar x => if x == z then u else e
  | exp_abs V e1 => exp_abs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_app e1 e2 => exp_app (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_tabs V e1 => exp_tabs V (subst_ee z u e1)
  | exp_tapp e1 V => exp_tapp (subst_ee z u e1) V
  | exp_fold V e => exp_fold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_unfold V e => exp_unfold V (subst_ee z u e)
  | exp_rcd_nil => exp_rcd_nil
  | exp_rcd_cons i e1 e2 => exp_rcd_cons i (subst_ee z u e1) (subst_ee z u e2)
  | exp_rcd_proj e1 i => exp_rcd_proj (subst_ee z u e1) i
  end.

Inductive Mode := Pos | Neg.

Definition choose (m : Mode)  (C : typ) (D : typ) :=
  match m with
  | Pos => C
  | Neg => D
  end.

Definition flip (m : Mode) : Mode :=
  match m with
  | Pos => Neg
  | Neg => Pos
  end.

Definition equiv E A B := sub E A B /\ sub E B A.

48	   Definitional shape, mirroring credits.py:
49	     R = top                              -> 0

51	     L = fvar X, L = R                    -> 0
52	     L = fvar X                           -> 1 + sum over trans candidates
53	     L = arrow L1 L2, R = arrow R1 R2     -> child(R1,L1) + child(L2,R2)
54	     L = all SL TL, R = all SR TR         -> three children (fresh Z, E2)
55	     L = mu AL, R = mu AR                 -> 1 + child (fresh Z, E2, Sig+Z, U1,U2)
56	     L = label l A0, R = label l' B0      -> child + (l active ? 1 : 0)

61	Fixpoint creditsF (n : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (L R : typ) {struct n} : nat :=
62	  match n with
63	  | 0 => 0
64	  | S n' =>
65	      match R with
66	      | typ_top => 0
67	      | _ =>
68	          match L with
69	          | typ_nat => 0
70	          | typ_fvar X =>

77	          | typ_arrow L1 L2 =>

80	                  creditsF n' Sig E R1 L1 + creditsF n' Sig E L2 R2
81	              | _ => 0

87	                  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub SR ++ E in

191	    + creditsF n Sig (Z ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 Z) (open_tt T2 Z).
192	Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.
193	
194	Lemma creditsF_mu : forall n Sig E A1 A2,
195	  let Z := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
196	  let E2 := Z ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
197	  let Sig2 := AtomSetImpl.add Z Sig in
198	  let P1 := open_tt A1 Z in
199	  let P2 := open_tt A2 Z in
200	  let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label Z P1) in
201	  let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label Z P2) in
202	  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2)
203	  = S (creditsF n Sig2 E2 U1 U2).
204	Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

206	Lemma creditsF_label_active : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
207	  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
208	  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
209	  = S (creditsF n Sig E A0 B0).
210	Proof.
211	  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
212	  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
213	  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
214	Qed.
215	
216	Lemma creditsF_label_inactive : forall n Sig E l A0 B0,
217	  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = false ->
218	  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l B0)
219	  = creditsF n Sig E A0 B0.
220	Proof.
221	  intros n Sig E l A0 B0 Hmem.
222	  simpl. destruct (l == l) as [e|ne]; [|exfalso; auto].
223	  rewrite Hmem. reflexivity.
224	Qed.

226	Lemma creditsF_label_neq : forall n Sig E l A0 l' B0,
227	  l <> l' ->
228	  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_label l A0) (typ_label l' B0) = 0.
229	Proof.
230	  intros n Sig E l A0 l' B0 Hne.
231	  simpl. destruct (l == l') as [e|ne]; [|reflexivity].
232	  exfalso; apply Hne; auto.
233	Qed.
234	
235	Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil : forall n Sig E,
236	  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil typ_rcd_nil = 0.
237	Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.
238	
239	Lemma creditsF_rcd_cons : forall n Sig E i A1 A2 j B1 B2,
240	  creditsF (S n) Sig E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)
241	  = ((fix go (ls : list atom) : nat :=
242	        match ls with
243	        | nil => 0
244	        | k :: ls' =>
245	            match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2) with
246	            | Some t1 =>
247	                match Tlookup k (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2) with
248	                | Some t2 => creditsF n Sig E t1 t2 + go ls'
249	                | None => go ls'
250	                end
251	            | None => go ls'
252	            end
253	        end) (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)))).
254	Proof. intros. simpl. reflexivity. Qed.

256	(* Mixed record shapes contribute nothing (the field sets are empty on the
257	   left or right), matching the Python `collectLabel(R)` loop. *)
258	Lemma creditsF_rcd_nil_r : forall n Sig E R,
259	  creditsF (S n) Sig E typ_rcd_nil R = 0.
260	Proof.
261	  intros. destruct R; simpl; reflexivity.
262	Qed.

1755	Lemma mem_add_iff : forall (s : atoms) x l,
1756	  AtomSetImpl.mem x (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true <-> x = l \/ AtomSetImpl.mem x s = true.
1757	Proof.
1758	  intros s x l. split; intro E.
1759	  - apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2 in E. apply in_add_iff in E. destruct E as [->|H]; auto.
1760	    right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1; auto.
1761	  - destruct E as [->|H].
1762	    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. left; auto.
1763	    + apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right. apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.

1779	  - assert (Hadd : AtomSetImpl.mem a (AtomSetImpl.add l s) = true).
1780	    { apply AtomSetImpl.mem_1. apply in_add_iff. right.
1781	      apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto. }
1782	    exact Hadd.

1794	  - (* nat *) reflexivity.

1945	  ok = true ->
1946	  (forall E C D, chk E C D = true -> sub E C D) ->
1947	  AllNeedsSub rest ->
1948	  AllNeedsSub l.

1951	  - simpl. intros ok rest H _ _ _. inversion H; subst. apply AllNeedsSub_nil.
1952	  - destruct h as [h0 D]. destruct h0 as [h1 C]. destruct h1 as [Y E].
1953	    simpl. intros ok rest H Hok Hchk Hrest.

1977	    (E : env) (A B : typ) (labels : list atom) {struct labels} : BRes :=

1979	  | nil => (true, nil)
1980	  | i :: l =>
1981	      match Tlookup i A with
1982	      | None => check_labels chk E A B l
1983	      | Some t1 =>
1984	          match Tlookup i B with
1985	          | None => (false, nil)
1986	          | Some t2 =>
1987	              let (ok1,n1) := chk E t1 t2 in
1988	              if ok1 then
1989	                let (ok2,n2) := check_labels chk E A B l in
1990	                if ok2 then (true, append_needs n1 n2) else (false, nil)

1996	Lemma check_labels_sound : forall (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> BRes)
1997	    (E : env) (A B : typ) labels ok needs,
1998	  check_labels chk E A B labels = (ok, needs) ->
1999	  ok = true ->
2000	  (forall E0 t1 t2 n0,
2001	      chk E0 t1 t2 = (true, n0) -> AllNeedsSub n0 -> sub E0 t1 t2) ->
2002	  AllNeedsSub needs ->

2008	  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok Hchk Hneeds i Hin t1 t2 H1 H2.
2009	    destruct (Tlookup a A) as [ta1|] eqn:EA.
2010	    + destruct (Tlookup a B) as [ta2|] eqn:EB.

2012	        destruct ok1.
2013	        -- destruct (check_labels chk E A B l) as [ok2 n2] eqn:Htail.
2014	           destruct ok2.
2015	           ++ injection H as Htrue HneedsEq.
2016	              assert (Happ : AllNeedsSub (append_needs n1 n2))

2018	              assert (Hn1 : AllNeedsSub n1) by (apply (@AllNeedsSub_app_l n1 n2); auto).

2023	                 assert (Et2 : t2 = ta2) by (rewrite H2 in EB; injection EB; auto).
2024	                 subst t1 t2. apply (Hchk E ta1 ta2 n1); auto.

2030	      * subst a. rewrite EA in H1. discriminate.
2031	      * eapply IHl; eauto.

2043	    (B : typ) (Us : list typ) {struct Us} : BRes :=

2046	  | U :: Us' =>
2047	      match chk E U B with

2055	  try_trans chk E X B Us = (ok, needs) ->
2056	  ok = true ->
2057	  AllNeedsSub needs ->
2058	  (forall U n, chk E U B = (true, n) -> AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
2059	  (forall U, In U Us -> binds X (bind_sub U) E) ->
2060	  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.

2063	  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok _ _ _. injection H as Hv _.
2064	    rewrite <- Hv in Hok. discriminate Hok.
2065	  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok Hneeds Hchk Hbinds.
2066	    destruct (chk E a B) as [oka na] eqn:Ha.
2067	    destruct oka.
2068	    + injection H as Hv Hn. rewrite <- Hn in Hneeds.
2069	      eapply sa_trans_tvar.

2078	Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
2079	    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=
2080	  match fuel with
2081	  | 0 => (false, nil)
2082	  | S f =>
2083	      if wf_env_b E then
2084	        match B with
2085	        | typ_top =>
2086	            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
2087	        | _ =>
2088	            match A with
2089	            | typ_nat =>
2090	                match B with typ_nat => (true,nil) | _ => (false,nil) end
2091	            | typ_fvar X =>
2092	                if eq_fvar_b X B then
2093	                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
2094	                else
2095	                  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X)
2096	            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
2097	                match B with
2098	                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
2099	                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
2100	                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
2101	                | _ => (false,nil)
2102	                end
2103	            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
2104	                match B with
2105	                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
2106	                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
2107	                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E in
2108	                    combine3 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S1 S2)
2109	                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S2 S1)
2110	                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
2111	                | _ => (false,nil)
2112	                end
2113	            | typ_mu A1 =>
2114	                match B with
2115	                | typ_mu A2 =>
2116	                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
2117	                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
2118	                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
2119	                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
2120	                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
2121	                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* all *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* mu *) f_equal.
    apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* label *) f_equal.
    + apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec.
    + apply IHT; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
  - (* rcd_cons *) f_equal.

Lemma ren_swap_fixes : forall x y T,
  x \notin fv_tt T -> y \notin fv_tt T -> x \notin fl_tt T -> y \notin fl_tt T ->
  ren (swp x y) T = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T Hfx Hfy Hgx Hgy. apply ren_fix.
  - intros X HX. assert (X <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfx; auto).
    assert (X <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hfy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
  - intros l Hl. assert (l <> x) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgx; auto).
    assert (l <> y) by (intro E; subst; apply Hgy; auto).
    apply swp_other; auto.
Qed.

(* commutation of renaming with opening *)
Lemma ren_open_gen : forall pi T,
  (forall K U, ren pi (open_tt_rec K U T) = open_tt_rec K (ren pi U) (ren pi T)).
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; intros K U; try reflexivity.
  - (* bvar *) simpl. destruct (K === n); simpl; auto.
  - (* arrow *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* all *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
  - (* mu *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* label *) simpl. f_equal; apply IHT.
  - (* rcd_cons *) simpl. f_equal; [apply IHT1 | apply IHT2].
Qed.

Lemma ren_open : forall pi T U,
  ren pi (open_tt T U) = open_tt (ren pi T) (ren pi U).
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply ren_open_gen. Qed.

(* ---------- renaming environments ---------- *)
Definition ren_b (pi : atom -> atom) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (ren pi T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (ren pi T)
  end.

Definition ren_env (pi : atom -> atom) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => match p with (x, b) => (pi x, ren_b pi b) end) E.

Lemma ren_env_cons : forall pi y c E,
  ren_env pi (y ~ c ++ E) = (pi y, ren_b pi c) :: ren_env pi E.
Proof. intros; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma ren_b_invol : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.
Proof. intros x y [T|T]; simpl; f_equal; apply ren_invol. Qed.

(* ===== Environment ranks used by occurrence-token termination attempts ===== *)

Fixpoint index_of (E : env) (X : atom) : option nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => None
  | (Y, _) :: E' =>
      if X == Y then Some 0
      else match index_of E' X with
           | Some i => Some (S i)
           | None => None
           end
  end.

Definition rank (E : env) (X : atom) : option nat :=
  match index_of E X with
  | Some i => Some (length E - i)
  | None => None
  end.



Lemma sub_fvar_binds_step : forall E X U B,
  binds X (bind_sub U) E -> sub E U B -> sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof. intros; eapply sa_trans_tvar; eauto. Qed.


Lemma resolve_step_sound : forall E X U B,
  lookup_sub E X = Some U -> sub E U B -> sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros E X U B Ho Hsub.
  apply sub_fvar_binds_step with U; auto.
  apply lookup_sub_some_binds; auto.
Qed.


(* ===== Simpler memo/cycle-free declarative search (fueled) ===== *)

Fixpoint try_trans_b (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool)
    (E : env) (Us : list typ) (B : typ) {struct Us} : bool :=
  match Us with
  | nil => false
  | U :: Us' => if chk E U B then true else try_trans_b chk E Us' B
  end.

Fixpoint sub_plain (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ)
    {struct fuel} : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => false
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top => WF_dec E A
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat => match B with typ_nat => true | _ => false end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  if WF_dec E A then true
                  else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
                else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E B1 A1) (sub_plain f Sig E A2 B2)
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E S1 S2)
                      (andb (sub_plain f Sig E S2 S1)
                            (sub_plain f Sig (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)
                                      (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)))
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      sub_plain f (AtomSetImpl.add X Sig) E2 U1 U2
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then sub_plain f Sig E A0 B0 else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with typ_rcd_nil => true | _ => false end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      lookup_check (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_plain f Sig E0 t1 t2) E A B
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_top => false
            | typ_bvar _ => false
            end
        end
      else false
  end.

(** This file provides classical logic and definite description, which is
    equivalent to providing classical logic and Church's iota operator *)

(** Classical logic and definite descriptions implies excluded-middle
    in [Set] and leads to a classical world populated with non
    computable functions. It conflicts with the impredicativity of
    [Set] *)

Set Implicit Arguments.

From Stdlib Require Export Classical.   (* Axiomatize classical reasoning *)
From Stdlib Require Export Description. (* Axiomatize constructive form of Church's iota *)
From Stdlib Require Import ChoiceFacts.

Local Notation inhabited A := A (only parsing).

(** The idea for the following proof comes from [ChicliPottierSimpson02] *)

Theorem excluded_middle_informative : forall P:Prop, {P} + {~ P}.
Proof.
apply
  (constructive_definite_descr_excluded_middle
   constructive_definite_description classic).
Qed.

Theorem classical_definite_description :
  forall (A : Type) (P : A->Prop), inhabited A ->
  { x : A | (exists! x : A, P x) -> P x }.
Proof.
intros A P i.
destruct (excluded_middle_informative (exists! x, P x)) as [Hex|HnonP].
- apply constructive_definite_description with (P:= fun x => (exists! x : A, P x) -> P x).
  destruct Hex as (x,(Hx,Huni)).
  exists x; split.
  + intros _; exact Hx.
  + firstorder.
- exists i; tauto.
Qed.

(** Church's iota operator *)

Definition iota (A : Type) (i:inhabited A) (P : A->Prop) : A
  := proj1_sig (classical_definite_description P i).

Definition iota_spec (A : Type) (i:inhabited A) (P : A->Prop) :
  (exists! x:A, P x) -> P (iota i P)
  := proj2_sig (classical_definite_description P i).

(** Axiom of unique "choice" (functional reification of functional relations) *)
Theorem dependent_unique_choice :
  forall (A:Type) (B:A -> Type) (R:forall x:A, B x -> Prop),
    (forall x:A, exists! y : B x, R x y) ->
    (exists f : (forall x:A, B x), forall x:A, R x (f x)).
Proof.
intros A B R H.
assert (Hexuni:forall x, exists! y, R x y).
- intro x. apply H.
- exists (fun x => proj1_sig (constructive_definite_description (R x) (Hexuni x))).
  intro x.
  apply (proj2_sig (constructive_definite_description (R x) (Hexuni x))).
Qed.

Theorem unique_choice :
  forall (A B:Type) (R:A -> B -> Prop),
    (forall x:A,  exists! y : B, R x y) ->
    (exists f : A -> B, forall x:A, R x (f x)).
Proof.
intros A B.
apply dependent_unique_choice with (B:=fun _:A => B).
Qed.

Fixpoint bvclosed (d : nat) (T : typ) : Prop :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => True
  | typ_top => True
  | typ_bvar J => J < d
  | typ_fvar _ => True
  | typ_arrow A B => bvclosed d A /\ bvclosed d B
  | typ_all A B => bvclosed d A /\ bvclosed (S d) B
  | typ_mu A => bvclosed (S d) A
  | typ_label _ A => bvclosed d A
  | typ_rcd_nil => True
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => bvclosed d A /\ bvclosed d B
  end.

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/.scratch/agent2')
import common as C
import gt as G
import alg as A


def trace_measure_fail(run, E, tA, tB, mnames):
    """Run candidate; for each measure return first failing call edge.
    An edge is checked by recomputing the parent goal under the child's
    label environment Sig (the only sound way at mu steps, where Sig grows).
    """
    run(E, tA, tB)
    out = {mn: None for mn in mnames}
    for (Ep, Lp, Rp, Sp), (Ec, Lc, Rc, Sc), kind in run.trace:
        for mn in mnames:
            if out[mn] is not None:
                continue
            S = Sc
            mp = A.measure(mn, S, Ep, Lp, Rp)
            mc = A.measure(mn, S, Ec, Lc, Rc)
            if not (mc < mp):
                out[mn] = (kind, Ep, Lp, Rp, Ec, Lc, Rc, Sp, Sc, mp, mc)
    return out


def first_failures(goals, run, mnames):
    first = {mn: None for mn in mnames}
    checked = 0
    for (E, tA, tB) in goals:
        checked += 1
        f = trace_measure_fail(run, E, tA, tB, mnames)
        for mn in mnames:
            if first[mn] is None and f[mn] is not None:
                first[mn] = (E, tA, tB, f[mn])
                if all(v is not None for v in first.values()):
                    return checked, first
    return checked, first


if __name__ == '__main__':
    run = A.mk_alg('rec', 'rec_drop', 'lhs', 'full', use_mode=False)
    E1 = [(1, 'sub', C.TOP), (2, 'sub', C.allt(C.lab(0, C.TOP), C.allt(C.b(0), C.TOP)))]

    Be = C.lab(1, C.arr(C.arr(C.b(0), C.b(0)), C.lab(1, C.TOP)))
    ex = [('ex1', E1, C.mu(Ae), C.mu(Be)),
          ('ex2', [], C.mu(C.arr(C.mu(C.NAT), C.TOP)), C.mu(C.TOP)),
          ('ex3', [], C.mu(C.arr(C.b(0), C.b(0))), C.mu(C.arr(C.b(0), C.b(0)))),
          ('ex4', [], C.mu(C.allt(C.b(0), C.b(0))), C.mu(C.allt(C.b(0), C.b(0))))]
    print("truth on examples:", [(nm, run(E, a, b)) for nm, E, a, b in ex])
    goals = [(E, a, b) for _, E, a, b in ex]
    n, first = A_first = None, None
    n, first = first_failures(goals, run, A.MEASURES)
    print("examples: goals", n)
    for mn in A.MEASURES:
        print("  ", mn, "OK" if first[mn] is None else ("FAIL " + str(first[mn])[:420]))

input.message:
Concrete route for total W: carry a consumed-fvar set D (only for termination; semantics ignores). Define
MD(D,E,A,B)=muDepth(A)+muDepth(B)+sum_{Y notin D, (Y,_,U) in E} muDepth(U)
RD(D,E,A,B)=raw(A)+raw(B)+sum_{Y notin D}raw(U)
EL(D,E)=number of bindings (Y,_) in E with Y notin D.
Relations on states (D,Sig,E,A,B): lex (MD, RD, EL).
W equations (roughly):
- top/nat/refl-fvar: 1
- fvar X, B not X, lookup_sub E X=Some U: 1 + W(D∪{X},Sig,E,U,B)
- arrow: 1 + W(D,Sig,E,B1,A1) + W(D,Sig,E,A2,B2)
- all: 1 + W(S1,S2)+W(S2,S1)+W(D,Sig,X~S2++E,open T1 X,open T2 X) with X=fresh3
- mu: 1 + W(D,Sig∪{X},X~top++E,U1,U2)
- label: 1 + W(payload)
- rcd: 1 + sum over compared fields W(field pair)
- otherwise 1.
Prove this is total by Program Fixpoint/well-founded recursion on lex (MD,RD,EL):
  fvar: MD/RD unchanged (U moves from env to type because X consumed; with D filtered this is equal), EL decreases;
  mu: MD strictly decreases (both roots removed; U1/U2 mu-depth <= bodies);
  all-body: MD nonincreases, RD strictly decreases (parent has S1,T1,S2,T2 + 2 constructors; child has T1,T2,S2 and loses S1+2);
  arrow/label/rcd: RD strictly decreases.
Then define sub_plainD with the same D threading (trans adds X; other rules same) and fuel W(empty,emptyEnvEnv,root). Fixpoint sub_plain (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ)
    {struct fuel} : bool :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => false
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top => WF_dec E A
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat => match B with typ_nat => true | _ => false end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  if WF_dec E A then true
                  else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
                else try_trans_b (sub_plain f Sig) E (binds_sub_list E X) B
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E B1 A1) (sub_plain f Sig E A2 B2)
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    andb (sub_plain f Sig E S1 S2)
                      (andb (sub_plain f Sig E S2 S1)
                            (sub_plain f Sig (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)
                                      (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)))
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      sub_plain f (AtomSetImpl.add X Sig) E2 U1 U2
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then sub_plain f Sig E A0 B0 else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with typ_rcd_nil => true | _ => false end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      lookup_check (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_plain f Sig E0 t1 t2) E A B
                    else false
                | _ => false
                end
            | typ_top => false
            | typ_bvar _ => false
            end
        end
      else false
  end.



Definition sub_plain_dec (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  sub_plain (M AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B) AtomSetImpl.empty E A B.

Proof. intros X A B H. unfold allT in *. simpl in *. fsetdec. Qed.
