Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (false, nil)
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top =>
            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat =>
                match B with typ_nat => (true,nil) | _ => (false,nil) end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
                else
                  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X)
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E in
                    combine3 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S1 S2)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S2 S1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      let Sig' := AtomSetImpl.add X Sig in
                      let C := 3 * (we Sig' P1 + we Sig' P2) in
                      let Cr' := (X, C) :: Cr in
                      let active' := AtomSetImpl.add X active in
                      match sub_b f Sig' Cr' active' E2 U1 U2 with
                      | (false, _) => (false,nil)
                      | (true, needs) =>
                          let (okc, rest) :=
                            check_obl (fun Eo C0 D0 =>
                                         let (ok,nn) :=
                                           sub_b f Sig' (remove_credit X Cr')
                                             AtomSetImpl.empty Eo C0 D0 in
                                         andb ok (null_needs nn)) X needs in
                          if okc then (true, rest) else (false,nil)
                      end
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then
                      if AtomSetImpl.mem l active then
                        (true, (l,E,A0,B0) :: nil)
                      else sub_b f Sig Cr active E A0 B0
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_nil => (true,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      let (ok,n) := check_labels
                        (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_b f Sig Cr active E0 t1 t2)
                        E A B (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) in
                      if ok then (true,n) else (false,nil)
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_bvar _ => (false,nil)
            | typ_top => (false,nil) (* B top handled above *)
            end
        end
      else (false,nil)
  end.

Lemma sub_b_fvar_trans_sound : forall f Sig Cr active E (X:atom) B ok needs,
  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X) = (ok,needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  (forall U n, sub_b f Sig Cr active E U B = (true,n) ->
               AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply try_trans_sound with
    (chk := sub_b f Sig Cr active) (Us := binds_sub_list E X); eauto.
  intros U HU. apply binds_sub_list_spec; auto.
Qed.

Definition sub_top_b (fuel:nat) (Sig:atoms) (Cr:list (atom*nat))
    (E:env) (A B:typ) : bool :=
  let (ok,needs) := sub_b fuel Sig Cr AtomSetImpl.empty E A B in
  andb ok (null_needs needs).



Definition fuel0 (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  M AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

Definition sub_dec (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  sub_top_b (fuel0 E A B) AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

Soundness is by induction on the outer fuel? There may be circularity: obligations checked at same f could themselves generate obligations checked at same f. But check_obl processes a list; recursive check_obl calls chk on each element with sub_b f, which may recurse... The fuel f is not decreasing for obligation checks, but the *original* fuel S f > f for the mu call, and the obligation sub_b f may generate new obligations at f? Its mu branch recursive call uses f-1, and obligation checks use f-1, so strictly decreasing. Good. But within check_obl at fuel f, each chk call is sub_b f which returns needs; then check_obl recursively processes rest with the same chk. The soundness induction on fuel S f for sub_b can use the IH for sub_b f (since f<S f) for obligations. So sub_b is sound with fuel. Definitionally it terminates.

from core import *
def wb(Sig,E,T):
    Sig=frozenset(Sig); memo={}; stack=set()
    def we(E,T):
        key=(tuple(E),frozenset(Sig),T)
        if key in memo: return memo[key]
        if key in stack: return 0
        stack.add(key); t=T[0]
        if t in ('nat','top','nil','b'): r=1
        elif t=='v':
            bb=None
            for (Y,k,U) in E:
                if Y==T[1] and k=='sub': bb=U; break
            r=1+(we(E,bb) if bb is not None else 0)
        elif t in ('arr','all'): r=1+we(E,T[1])+we(E,T[2])
        elif t=='mu': r=1+we(E,T[1])
        elif t=='lab': r=1 if T[1] in Sig else 1+we(E,T[2])
        else: r=1+we(E,T[2])+we(E,T[3])
        stack.discard(key); memo[key]=r; return r
    return we(E,T)
def szS2(Sig,T):
    Sig=frozenset(Sig); memo={}
    def sz(T):
        t=T[0]
        if t in ('nat','top','nil','b','v'): return 1
        if t in ('arr','all'): return 1+sz(T[1])+sz(T[2])
        if t=='mu': return 1+sz(T[1])
        if t=='lab': return 1 if T[1] in Sig else 1+sz(T[2])
        return 1+sz(T[2])+sz(T[3])
    return sz(T)
def fuel_B(Sig,E,A,B): return wb(Sig,E,A)+wb(Sig,E,B)+sum(wb(Sig,E,U) for (_,k,U) in E)
def F(Sig,E,A,B): return fuel_B(Sig,E,A,B)+szS2(Sig,A)+szS2(Sig,B)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Stdlib.Wellfounded.Lexicographic_Product.
Require Import Stdlib.Wellfounded.Wellfounded.
Require Import Stdlib.Program.Wf.
Require Export Stdlib.micromega.Lia.

Fixpoint wmd (T:typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 0 | typ_top => 0 | typ_bvar _ => 0 | typ_fvar _ => 0
  | typ_arrow A B => max (wmd A) (wmd B)
  | typ_all A B => max (wmd A) (wmd B)
  | typ_mu A => 1 + wmd A
  | typ_label _ A => wmd A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 0
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => max (wmd A) (wmd B)
  end.

Fixpoint wraw (T:typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1 | typ_top => 1 | typ_bvar _ => 1 | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + wraw A + wraw B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + wraw A + wraw B
  | typ_mu A => 1 + wraw A
  | typ_label _ A => 1 + wraw A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + wraw A + wraw B
  end.

Fixpoint wenv_md (D:atoms) (E:env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
      (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else
        match b with bind_sub U => wmd U | bind_typ U => wmd U end)
      + wenv_md D E'
  end.
Fixpoint wenv_raw (D:atoms) (E:env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
      (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else
        match b with bind_sub U => wraw U | bind_typ U => wraw U end)
      + wenv_raw D E'
  end.
Fixpoint wenv_len (D:atoms) (E:env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, _) :: E' => (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else 1) + wenv_len D E'
  end.

Record wst := mk_wst { wD : atoms; wSig : atoms; wE : env; wA : typ; wB : typ }.
Definition wm1 (s:wst) : nat := wmd (wA s) + wmd (wB s) + wenv_md (wD s) (wE s).
Definition wm2 (s:wst) : nat := wraw (wA s) + wraw (wB s) + wenv_raw (wD s) (wE s).
Definition wm3 (s:wst) : nat := wenv_len (wD s) (wE s).
Definition R2 (p q:wst) : Prop := wm2 p < wm2 q \/ (wm2 p = wm2 q /\ wm3 p < wm3 q).

Lemma wf_R2 : well_founded R2.
Proof.
  intros p.
  refine (well_founded_ind lt_wf (fun n => forall p, wm2 p = n -> Acc R2 p) _ (wm2 p) p eq_refl).
  intros n IH p0 Hp0.
  refine (well_founded_ind lt_wf
    (fun m => forall p, wm2 p = n -> wm3 p = m -> Acc R2 p)
    _ (wm3 p0) p0 Hp0 eq_refl).
  intros m IH2 p1 Hp1 Hm. constructor. intros q Hq.
  destruct Hq as [Hlt | [Heq H3]].
  - apply (IH (wm2 q)); [lia | reflexivity].
  - apply (IH2 (wm3 q)); [lia | lia | reflexivity].
Qed.
Definition R3 (p q:wst) : Prop := wm1 p < wm1 q \/ (wm1 p = wm1 q /\ R2 p q).
Lemma wf_R3 : well_founded R3.
Proof.
  intros p.
  refine (well_founded_ind lt_wf (fun n => forall p, wm1 p = n -> Acc R3 p) _ (wm1 p) p eq_refl).
  intros n IH p0 Hp0.
  refine (well_founded_ind wf_R2 (fun p => wm1 p = n -> Acc R3 p) _ p0 Hp0).
  intros q IH2 Hq. constructor. intros r Hr.
  destruct Hr as [Hlt | [Heq H2]].
  - apply (IH (wm1 r)); [lia | reflexivity].
  - apply (IH2 r); [exact H2 | lia].
Qed.

(* basic measure lemmas *)
Lemma wmd_open_fvar : forall T X, wmd (open_tt T X) = wmd T.
Proof. intros T; induction T; intros X; simpl; auto. Qed.
Lemma wraw_open_fvar : forall T X, wraw (open_tt T X) = wraw T.
Proof. intros T; induction T; intros X; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma wmd_open_label_le : forall T X,
  wmd (open_tt T (typ_label X (open_tt T X))) <= wmd T.
Proof.
  intros T; induction T; intros X; simpl; auto; try lia.
  - (* fvar *) auto.
  - (* arrow *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
  - (* all *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
  - (* mu *) pose proof (IHT X); lia.
  - (* label *) pose proof (IHT X); auto.
  - (* rcd *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
Qed.
Lemma wraw_open_label : forall T X,
  wraw (open_tt T (typ_label X (open_tt T X))) >= wraw T.
Proof.
  intros T; induction T; intros X; simpl; auto; try lia.
  - (* arrow *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
  - (* all *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
  - (* mu *) pose proof (IHT X); lia.
  - (* label *) pose proof (IHT X); lia.
  - (* rcd *) pose proof (IHT1 X); pose proof (IHT2 X); lia.
Qed.

Program Fixpoint W (s:wst) {wf R3 s} : nat :=
  match wB s with
  | typ_top => 1
  | _ =>
    match wA s with
    | typ_nat => 1
    | typ_fvar X =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_fvar Y => if X == Y then 1 else
            match lookup_sub (wE s) X with
            | Some U => 1 + W (mk_wst (AtomSetImpl.add X (wD s)) (wSig s) (wE s) U (wB s))
            | None => 1
            end
        | _ =>
            match lookup_sub (wE s) X with
            | Some U => 1 + W (mk_wst (AtomSetImpl.add X (wD s)) (wSig s) (wE s) U (wB s))
            | None => 1
            end
        end
    | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
            1 + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) B1 A1)
              + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) A2 B2)
        | _ => 1
        end
    | typ_all S1 T1 =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_all S2 T2 =>
            let X := fresh3 (wE s) (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
            let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ wE s in
            1 + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) S1 S2)
              + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) S2 S1)
              + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
        | _ => 1
        end
    | typ_mu A1 =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_mu A2 =>
            let X := fresh3 (wE s) (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
            let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ wE s in
            let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
            let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
            let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
            let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
            1 + W (mk_wst (wD s) (AtomSetImpl.add X (wSig s)) E2 U1 U2)
        | _ => 1
        end
    | typ_label l A0 =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_label l' B0 => if l == l' then 1 + W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) A0 B0) else 1
        | _ => 1
        end
    | typ_rcd_nil =>
        match wB s with typ_rcd_nil => 1 | _ => 1 end
    | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
        match wB s with
        | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
            let fix go (ls:list atom) : nat :=
              match ls with
              | nil => 0
              | k :: ls' =>

                      | Some t2 => max (W (mk_wst (wD s) (wSig s) (wE s) t1 t2)) (go ls')
                      | None => go ls'
                      end
                  | None => go ls'
                  end
              end in
            1 + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel (wB s)))
        | _ => 1
        end
    | _ => 1
    end
  end.

import harness

LEAVES=[NAT,TOP,NIL,b(0)]

def enum_terms(maxsize):
    bysize={1:list(LEAVES)}
    for n in range(2,maxsize+1):
        cur=[]
        for i in range(1,n):
            j=n-1-i
            for x in bysize.get(i,[]):

            for l in range(2): cur.append(lab(l,x))
        bysize[n]=cur
    out=[]
    for n in range(1,maxsize+1): out.extend(bysize[n])
    return out

def hasb(T):
    t=T[0]
    if t=='b': return True
    if t in ('nat','top','nil','v'): return False
    if t in ('arr','all'): return hasb(T[1]) or hasb(T[2])
    if t in ('mu','lab'): return hasb(T[-1])
    return hasb(T[2]) or hasb(T[3])

def build_cases(maxsize=3, nrandom=400, seed=7):

    for T in terms:
        if wf_dec([],T):
            cases.append(([],T,mu(T)))
            cases.append(([],mu(T),T))
    random.seed(seed); got=0; tried=0
    while got<nrandom and tried<nrandom*50:
        tried+=1
        c=harness.gen_random_case(d=4,nenv=2)
        if c is None: continue
        E,A,B=c
        if wf_dec(E,A) and wf_dec(E,B):
            cases.append(c); got+=1
    return terms,keep,cases

def obligation_stats(cases):
    """For every mu edge, check we(P1)+we(P2) <= we(U1)+we(U2) under Sigma'."""
    import collections
    out={}
    for fvar in ('unit','binding'):
        for mu_c in (1,2,3):

            ok=0; bad=0; ex=[]

Lemma sub_all_body_generalize : forall E S2 T1 T2 (X:atom),
  X \notin allE E -> X \notin allT S2 -> X \notin allT T1 -> X \notin allT T2 ->
  sub (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X) ->
  forall Y,
    Y \notin AtomSetImpl.add X
      (AtomSetImpl.union (allE E)
        (AtomSetImpl.union (allT S2)
          (AtomSetImpl.union (allT T1) (allT T2)))) ->
    sub (Y ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E) (open_tt T1 Y) (open_tt T2 Y).
Proof.
  intros E S2 T1 T2 X HXE HXS2 HXT1 HXT2 Hsub Y HY.
  assert (HYX : Y <> X) by (intro e; subst Y; apply HY; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; auto).
  assert (HYE : Y \notin allE E) by fsetdec.
  assert (HYS2 : Y \notin allT S2) by fsetdec.
  assert (HYT1 : Y \notin allT T1) by fsetdec.
  assert (HYT2 : Y \notin allT T2) by fsetdec.
  pose proof (@sub_ren_fwd X Y (X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E)
                (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X) Hsub) as Hr.
  rewrite ren_env_cons in Hr.
  cbn [ren_b] in Hr.
  rewrite (swp_eq_l X Y) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_env X Y E HXE HYE) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_typ X Y S2 HXS2 HYS2) in Hr.
  rewrite !ren_open in Hr.
  cbn [ren] in Hr.
  rewrite (swp_eq_l X Y) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_typ X Y T1 HXT1 HYT1) in Hr.
  rewrite (@swp_fix_typ X Y T2 HXT2 HYT2) in Hr.
  exact Hr.

(* =====================================================================
   Concrete counterexample to the lexicographic state measure
        (MD, RD, EL)
   proposed for the plain/WHNF search.

   MD(D,E,A,B) = md A + md B + sum_{Y notin D} md(binding type)
   RD(D,E,A,B) = raw A + raw B + sum_{Y notin D} raw(binding type)
   EL(D,E)    = number of bindings Y in E with Y notin D,

   where
     md  = maximum number of nested mus (labels transparent,
           arrow/all/records take the maximum of the components)
     raw = number of constructors (atoms count 1).

   The mu-unfolding edge

     E  = []                       E' = [X ~ bind_sub top]
     A  = B = mu (mu (bvar 1))     A' = B' = mu (label X (mu X))

   is a genuine recursive edge of the algorithm (with X fresh), and
   MD stays equal while RD strictly *increases*.  Hence no lexicographic
   order with MD first and RD second can be used to define the total
   weight W recursively.  (EL also increases, so appending EL at the end
   does not help.)

   The file also proves the Boolean trans-list completeness lemma used
   by any completeness argument for sub_plain:
     if U occurs in Us and chk E U B is true, then
     try_trans_b chk E Us B is true.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Syntactic raw size and maximum mu depth (label transparent).           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint raw_tt (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + raw_tt A + raw_tt B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + raw_tt A + raw_tt B
  | typ_mu A => 1 + raw_tt A
  | typ_label _ A => 1 + raw_tt A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + raw_tt A + raw_tt B
  end.

Fixpoint md_tt (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 0
  | typ_top => 0
  | typ_bvar _ => 0
  | typ_fvar _ => 0
  | typ_arrow A B => Nat.max (md_tt A) (md_tt B)
  | typ_all A B => Nat.max (md_tt A) (md_tt B)
  | typ_mu A => 1 + md_tt A
  | typ_label _ A => md_tt A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 0
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => Nat.max (md_tt A) (md_tt B)
  end.

Definition md_binding (b : binding) : nat :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub U => md_tt U
  | bind_typ U => md_tt U
  end.

Definition raw_binding (b : binding) : nat :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub U => raw_tt U
  | bind_typ U => raw_tt U
  end.

Fixpoint sum_md_env (D : atoms) (E : env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
      (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else md_binding b) + sum_md_env D E'
  end.

Fixpoint sum_raw_env (D : atoms) (E : env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
      (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else raw_binding b) + sum_raw_env D E'
  end.

Fixpoint count_unused (D : atoms) (E : env) : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 0
  | (Y, _) :: E' =>
      (if AtomSetImpl.mem Y D then 0 else 1) + count_unused D E'
  end.

Definition MD (D : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  md_tt A + md_tt B + sum_md_env D E.

Definition RD (D : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  raw_tt A + raw_tt B + sum_raw_env D E.

Definition EL (D : atoms) (E : env) : nat :=
  count_unused D E.

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The concrete counterexample.                                           *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Definition X0 : atom := fresh_atom AtomSetImpl.empty.

Definition A0 : typ := typ_mu (typ_mu (typ_bvar 1)).

Definition P0 : typ := typ_mu (typ_fvar X0).

Definition U0 : typ := typ_mu (typ_label X0 P0).

Definition E0 : env := nil.

Definition E1 : env := (X0, bind_sub typ_top) :: nil.

Definition D0 : atoms := AtomSetImpl.empty.

Definition D1 : atoms := AtomSetImpl.add X0 D0.

(* The child state is the one produced by the mu rule.  The type is
   definitionally the open_tt instance used by sub_plain. *)
Lemma child_type_eq :
  U0 = open_tt (typ_mu (typ_bvar 1)) (typ_label X0 P0).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma P0_eq : P0 = open_tt (typ_mu (typ_bvar 1)) X0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* MD is equal on the two states (with the full, unconsumed environment). *)
Lemma MD_counterexample :
  MD D1 E1 U0 U0 = MD D0 E0 A0 A0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* RD strictly increases, so RD cannot be the tie-breaking component. *)
Lemma RD_counterexample :
  RD D0 E0 A0 A0 < RD D1 E1 U0 U0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* EL also increases. *)
Lemma EL_counterexample :
  EL D1 E1 = 1 + EL D0 E0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* The negation of the lexicographic decrease required for W's recursion.
   Lex order on triples: (MD, RD, EL), MD compared first.  On this edge
   MD is equal and RD is larger, so the child is not lex-smaller. *)
Lemma lex_counterexample :
  ~ (MD D1 E1 U0 U0 < MD D0 E0 A0 A0 \/
     (MD D1 E1 U0 U0 = MD D0 E0 A0 A0 /\
      (RD D1 E1 U0 U0 < RD D0 E0 A0 A0 \/
       (RD D1 E1 U0 U0 = RD D0 E0 A0 A0 /\
        EL D1 E1 < EL D0 E0)))).
Proof.
  intros [Hlt | [Heq [Hlt | [Heq2 Hlt]]]].
  - rewrite MD_counterexample in Hlt. lia.
  - rewrite RD_counterexample in Hlt. lia.
  - rewrite RD_counterexample in Heq2. lia.
Qed.

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Boolean trans-list completeness (a genuinely reusable ingredient of    *)
(* any completeness proof for sub_plain).                                 *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma try_trans_b_complete : forall (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool)
    E (Us : list typ) B U,
  In U Us ->
  chk E U B = true ->
  try_trans_b chk E Us B = true.
Proof.
  intros chk E Us.
  induction Us as [|a Us IH]; intros B U Hin Hchk.
  - inversion Hin.
  - simpl. destruct Hin as [Heq | Hin].
    + subst a. rewrite Hchk. reflexivity.
    + destruct (chk E a B) eqn:Ea.
      * reflexivity.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* Specialization to the list of sub-bindings of a variable: this is
   exactly the completeness step needed in the sa_trans_tvar case. *)
Lemma try_trans_b_binds_complete : forall
    (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> bool) E X U B,
  binds X (bind_sub U) E ->
  chk E U B = true ->
  try_trans_b chk E (binds_sub_list E X) B = true.
Proof.
  intros. apply try_trans_b_complete with (U := U); auto.
  apply binds_sub_list_spec; auto.
Qed.

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* The same counterexample at the level of the actual sub_plain state     *)
(* transition: the recursive call made by the mu branch.                  *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Lemma sub_plain_mu_child_shape : forall f Sig,
  sub_plain (S f) Sig E0 A0 A0 =
  (if andb (WF_dec E0 A0)
        (andb (WF_dec E0 A0)
              (andb (WF_dec E1 P0) (WF_dec E1 P0)))
   then sub_plain f (AtomSetImpl.add X0 Sig) E1 U0 U0
   else false).

(* ===== Resolving bound fvar heads (trans preprocessing) ===== *)

Fixpoint lookup_sub (E : env) (X : atom) : option typ :=
  match E with
  | nil => None
  | (Y, bind_sub U) :: E' =>
      if X == Y then Some U else lookup_sub E' X
  | (Y, bind_typ _) :: E' =>
      if X == Y then None else lookup_sub E' X
  end.

Lemma lookup_sub_some_binds : forall E X U,
  lookup_sub E X = Some U -> binds X (bind_sub U) E.
Proof.
  intros E X U. induction E as [|[Y b] E']; simpl; intros H.
  - discriminate.
  - destruct b; simpl in H.
    + destruct (X == Y) as [e|ne].
      * subst Y. injection H as Ht. subst U. simpl; left; reflexivity.
      * apply IHE' in H. simpl; right; auto.
    + destruct (X == Y) as [e|ne]; [discriminate|].
      apply IHE' in H. simpl; right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma try_trans_b_mono : forall chk chk',
  (forall E U B, chk E U B = true -> chk' E U B = true) ->
  forall E Us B,
    try_trans_b chk E Us B = true -> try_trans_b chk' E Us B = true.
Proof.
  intros chk chk' Hpt E Us.
  induction Us as [|a Us IH]; intros B H.
  - simpl in H. discriminate H.
  - simpl in H. simpl.
    destruct (chk E a B) eqn:Ea.
    + apply Hpt in Ea. rewrite Ea. reflexivity.
    + destruct (chk' E a B) eqn:Eb; [reflexivity|].
      apply IH. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_check_mono : forall chk chk',
  (forall E t1 t2, chk E t1 t2 = true -> chk' E t1 t2 = true) ->
  forall E A B,
    lookup_check chk E A B = true -> lookup_check chk' E A B = true.

  intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.

Qed.

(* ===== Termination-measure size functions ===== *)

(* size with mu penalty 2n+2; labels opaque iff their atom is in Sig *)
Fixpoint we (Sig : atoms) (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 1
  | typ_top => 1
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 1
  | typ_arrow A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_all A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  | typ_mu A => let n := we Sig A in 8 * n + 8
  | typ_label l P => if AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig then 1 else 1 + we Sig P
  | typ_rcd_nil => 1
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => 1 + we Sig A + we Sig B
  end.

(* recursive expansion weight *)
Fixpoint w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (X : atom) {struct E} : nat :=
  match E with
  | nil => 1
  | (Y, b) :: E' =>
    if X == Y then
      match b with
      | bind_sub U =>
        let fix go (l : list atom) : nat :=
            match l with
            | nil => 0
            | Z :: l' => w Sig E' Z + go l'
            end
        in we Sig U + go (AtomSetImpl.elements (fv_tt U))
      | bind_typ _ => 1
      end
    else w Sig E' X
  end.



Lemma we_pos : forall Sig T, 1 <= we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; simpl.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
  - pose proof IHT; lia.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl; lia.
  - lia.
  - lia.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_leaf : forall Sig T U K,
  we Sig U = 1 -> we Sig (open_tt_rec K U T) = we Sig T.
Proof.
  intros Sig T; induction T; intros U K HU; simpl.
  - auto.
  - auto.
  - destruct (K === n); simpl; [assumption|auto].
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
  - rewrite IHT; auto.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem a Sig); simpl.
    + auto.
    + rewrite IHT; auto.
  - auto.
  - rewrite IHT1, IHT2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma we_open_fvar : forall Sig T X,
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_fvar X)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; auto. Qed.

Lemma we_open_opaque_label : forall Sig T l P,
  AtomSetImpl.mem l Sig = true ->
  we Sig (open_tt T (typ_label l P)) = we Sig T.
Proof. intros; unfold open_tt; apply we_open_leaf; simpl; rewrite H; auto. Qed.


(* ===== Candidate obligation/credit measure for sub termination ===== *)

Fixpoint sum_env_w (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (l : list atom) : nat :=
  match l with
  | nil => 0
  | X :: l' => w Sig E X + sum_env_w Sig E l'
  end.

Definition envw (Sig : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  sum_env_w Sig E (AtomSetImpl.elements
    (AtomSetImpl.union (fv_tt A) (fv_tt B))).

Fixpoint credits_sum (Cr : list (atom * nat)) : nat :=
  match Cr with
  | nil => 0
  | (_, c) :: Cr' => c + credits_sum Cr'
  end.

Definition M (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat)) (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  we Sig A + we Sig B + envw Sig E A B + credits_sum Cr.


(* ===== Size measure for LC -> WF ===== *)

Definition sz (T : typ) : nat := we AtomSetImpl.empty T.

Lemma mem_atomset_empty : forall a, AtomSetImpl.mem a AtomSetImpl.empty = false.
Proof.
  intro a. apply Bool.not_true_iff_false. intro H.
  apply (@AtomSetImpl.empty_1 a). apply AtomSetImpl.mem_2; auto.
Qed.

Lemma sz_pos : forall T, 1 <= sz T.
Proof. intro; apply we_pos. Qed.
====


Fixpoint try_trans (chk : env -> typ -> typ -> BRes) (E : env) (X : atom)
    (B : typ) (Us : list typ) {struct Us} : BRes :=
  match Us with
  | nil => (false, nil)
  | U :: Us' =>
      match chk E U B with
      | (true, n) => (true, n)
      | (false, _) => try_trans chk E X B Us'
      end
  end.


Lemma try_trans_sound : forall chk E X B Us ok needs,
  try_trans chk E X B Us = (ok, needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  (forall U n, chk E U B = (true, n) -> AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
  (forall U, In U Us -> binds X (bind_sub U) E) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros chk E X B Us. induction Us as [|a Us'].
  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok _ _ _. injection H as Hv _.
    rewrite <- Hv in Hok. discriminate Hok.
  - simpl. intros ok needs H Hok Hneeds Hchk Hbinds.
    destruct (chk E a B) as [oka na] eqn:Ha.
    destruct oka.
    + injection H as Hv Hn. rewrite <- Hn in Hneeds.
      eapply sa_trans_tvar.
      * apply Hbinds. simpl; left; auto.
      * apply (Hchk a na); auto.
    + eapply IHUs'; eauto.
Qed.




Fixpoint sub_b (fuel : nat) (Sig : atoms) (Cr : list (atom * nat))
    (active : atoms) (E : env) (A B : typ) {struct fuel} : BRes :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => (false, nil)
  | S f =>
      if wf_env_b E then
        match B with
        | typ_top =>
            if WF_dec E A then (true, nil) else (false, nil)
        | _ =>
            match A with
            | typ_nat =>
                match B with typ_nat => (true,nil) | _ => (false,nil) end
            | typ_fvar X =>
                if eq_fvar_b X B then
                  (if WF_dec E A then (true,nil) else (false,nil))
                else
                  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X)
            | typ_arrow A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_arrow B1 B2 =>
                    combine2 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E B1 A1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E A2 B2)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_all S1 T1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_all S2 T2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E in
                    combine3 (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S1 S2)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E S2 S1)
                             (sub_b f Sig Cr active E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X))
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_mu A1 =>
                match B with
                | typ_mu A2 =>
                    let X := fresh3 E (typ_mu A1) (typ_mu A2) in
                    let E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E in
                    let P1 := open_tt A1 X in
                    let P2 := open_tt A2 X in
                    let U1 := open_tt A1 (typ_label X P1) in
                    let U2 := open_tt A2 (typ_label X P2) in
                    if andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A1))
                            (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu A2))
                                  (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2))) then
                      let Sig' := AtomSetImpl.add X Sig in
                      let C := 3 * (we Sig' P1 + we Sig' P2) in
                      let Cr' := (X, C) :: Cr in
                      let active' := AtomSetImpl.add X active in
                      match sub_b f Sig' Cr' active' E2 U1 U2 with
                      | (false, _) => (false,nil)
                      | (true, needs) =>
                          let (okc, rest) :=
                            check_obl (fun Eo C0 D0 =>
                                         let (ok,nn) :=
                                           sub_b f Sig' (remove_credit X Cr')
                                             AtomSetImpl.empty Eo C0 D0 in
                                         andb ok (null_needs nn)) X needs in
                          if okc then (true, rest) else (false,nil)
                      end
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_label l A0 =>
                match B with
                | typ_label l' B0 =>
                    if l == l' then
                      if AtomSetImpl.mem l active then
                        (true, (l,E,A0,B0) :: nil)
                      else sub_b f Sig Cr active E A0 B0
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_nil =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_nil => (true,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 =>
                match B with
                | typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 =>
                    if andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel B) (collectLabel A))
                            (andb (WF_dec E A) (WF_dec E B)) then
                      let (ok,n) := check_labels
                        (fun E0 t1 t2 => sub_b f Sig Cr active E0 t1 t2)
                        E A B (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) in
                      if ok then (true,n) else (false,nil)
                    else (false,nil)
                | _ => (false,nil)
                end
            | typ_bvar _ => (false,nil)
            | typ_top => (false,nil) (* B top handled above *)
            end
        end
      else (false,nil)
  end.

Lemma sub_b_fvar_trans_sound : forall f Sig Cr active E (X:atom) B ok needs,
  try_trans (sub_b f Sig Cr active) E X B (binds_sub_list E X) = (ok,needs) ->
  ok = true ->
  AllNeedsSub needs ->
  (forall U n, sub_b f Sig Cr active E U B = (true,n) ->
               AllNeedsSub n -> sub E U B) ->
  sub E (typ_fvar X) B.
Proof.
  intros. eapply try_trans_sound with
    (chk := sub_b f Sig Cr active) (Us := binds_sub_list E X); eauto.
  intros U HU. apply binds_sub_list_spec; auto.
Qed.

Definition sub_top_b (fuel:nat) (Sig:atoms) (Cr:list (atom*nat))
    (E:env) (A B:typ) : bool :=
  let (ok,needs) := sub_b fuel Sig Cr AtomSetImpl.empty E A B in
  andb ok (null_needs needs).



Definition fuel0 (E : env) (A B : typ) : nat :=
  M AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

Definition sub_dec (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  sub_top_b (fuel0 E A B) AtomSetImpl.empty nil E A B.

Fixpoint lookup_sub (E : env) (X : atom) : option typ :=
  match E with
  | nil => None
  | (Y, bind_sub U) :: E' =>

Definition ren_b (pi : atom -> atom) (b : binding) : binding :=
  match b with
  | bind_sub T => bind_sub (ren pi T)
  | bind_typ T => bind_typ (ren pi T)
  end.

Definition ren_env (pi : atom -> atom) (E : env) : env :=
  List.map (fun p => match p with (x, b) => (pi x, ren_b pi b) end) E.

Lemma ren_b_invol : forall x y b, ren_b (swp x y) (ren_b (swp x y) b) = b.

Lemma ren_env_invol : forall x y E, ren_env (swp x y) (ren_env (swp x y) E) = E.
Proof.
  intros x y E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  f_equal.
  - apply pair_equal_spec; split; [apply swp_invol | apply ren_b_invol].
  - auto.

Lemma binds_ren_fwd : forall pi X b E,
  binds X b E -> binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E).
Proof.
  intros pi X b E H. induction E as [|[y c] E']; simpl in *; auto.
  destruct H as [Heq|Hin]; [left | right].
  - inversion Heq; subst; auto.
  - apply IHE'; auto.
Qed.

Lemma binds_ren_bwd : forall pi (Hpi : forall z, pi (pi z) = z)
  (Hb : forall b, ren_b pi (ren_b pi b) = b) X b E,
  binds (pi X) (ren_b pi b) (ren_env pi E) -> binds X b E.
Proof.
  intros pi Hpi Hb X b E. induction E as [|[y0 c] E']; simpl; auto.
  intros [Heq|Hin].
  - apply pair_equal_spec in Heq. destruct Heq as [H1 H2].
    left. apply pair_equal_spec. split.
    + apply (f_equal pi) in H1. rewrite !Hpi in H1. auto.
    + apply (f_equal (ren_b pi)) in H2. rewrite !Hb in H2. auto.
  - right. apply IHE'. auto.
Qed.

(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* A stronger counterexample: mu-count itself can increase on the mu edge. *)
(* This also refutes the "mu-count / raw-size" two-counter variant.        *)
(* --------------------------------------------------------------------- *)

Fixpoint mu_count (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 0
  | typ_top => 0
  | typ_bvar _ => 0
  | typ_fvar _ => 0
  | typ_arrow A B => mu_count A + mu_count B
  | typ_all A B => mu_count A + mu_count B
  | typ_mu A => S (mu_count A)
  | typ_label _ A => mu_count A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 0
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => mu_count A + mu_count B
  end.

Fixpoint bvar_count (T : typ) : nat :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => 0
  | typ_top => 0
  | typ_bvar _ => 1
  | typ_fvar _ => 0
  | typ_arrow A B => bvar_count A + bvar_count B
  | typ_all A B => bvar_count A + bvar_count B
  | typ_mu A => bvar_count A
  | typ_label _ A => bvar_count A
  | typ_rcd_nil => 0
  | typ_rcd_cons _ A B => bvar_count A + bvar_count B
  end.

Definition A1b : typ :=
  typ_mu (typ_arrow (typ_bvar 1) (typ_bvar 1)).

Definition A0b : typ := typ_mu A1b.

Definition Xb : atom := fresh3 nil A0b A0b.

Definition P1b : typ := open_tt A1b Xb.

Definition U0b : typ := open_tt A1b (typ_label Xb P1b).

Definition E1b : env := (Xb, bind_sub typ_top) :: nil.

Definition D1b : atoms := AtomSetImpl.add Xb D0.

  vm_compute. rewrite mem_add_self. reflexivity.

Lemma RD_counterexample_b :

(* =====================================================================
   The `Sig` argument of sub_plain is dead code.

   sub_plain threads a finite set `Sig` of "active" label atoms through
   its recursive calls, and the mu branch adds the fresh label to it.
   But the label branch never reads `Sig`; the only occurrences of `Sig`
   are as an argument to recursive calls (plus `add X Sig` in the mu
   branch).  Consequently

       sub_plain n Sig1 E A B = sub_plain n Sig2 E A B

   for *all* Sig1, Sig2.

   This file proves that statement together with the two extensionality
   lemmas for the higher-order combinators it needs.  It is free of
   axioms/admits and compiles under Rocq 9.1.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ================= extensionality of try_trans_b ===================== *)

Lemma try_trans_b_ext : forall (chk1 chk2 : env -> typ -> typ -> bool),
  (forall E A B, chk1 E A B = chk2 E A B) ->
  forall E Us B,
    try_trans_b chk1 E Us B = try_trans_b chk2 E Us B.
Proof.
  intros chk1 chk2 H E Us.
  induction Us as [|a Us IH]; intros B; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite H. destruct (chk2 E a B) as [|]; [reflexivity|apply IH].
Qed.

(* ================= extensionality of lookup_check ==================== *)

Lemma lookup_check_ext : forall (chk1 chk2 : env -> typ -> typ -> bool),
  (forall E A B, chk1 E A B = chk2 E A B) ->
  forall E A B,
    lookup_check chk1 E A B = lookup_check chk2 E A B.
Proof.
  intros chk1 chk2 H E A B.
  unfold lookup_check.
  induction (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) as [|i ls IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (Tlookup i A) as [t1|] eqn:E1.
    + destruct (Tlookup i B) as [t2|] eqn:E2.
      * rewrite H. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================= Sig irrelevance of sub_plain ======================= *)

Lemma sub_plain_sig_irrel : forall n Sig1 Sig2 E A B,
  sub_plain n Sig1 E A B = sub_plain n Sig2 E A B.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros Sig1 Sig2 E A B.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl.
    destruct (wf_env_b E) as [|] eqn:Ew; [|reflexivity].
    destruct B as [| |nB|Y|B1 B2|S2 T2|M2|l' B0| |j B1 B2];
      simpl in *.
    + (* B = typ_nat *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
      intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_top *)
      reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_bvar nB *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
      intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_fvar Y *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      destruct (X == Y) as [e|ne]; simpl.
      * subst Y. destruct (WF_dec E (typ_fvar X)) as [|]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
           intros. apply IH.
      * eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_arrow B1 B2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_arrow A1 A2 *)
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E B1 A1).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E A2 B2).
        reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_all S2 T2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_all S1 T1 *)
        set (X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)).
        set (E2 := X ~ bind_sub S2 ++ E).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E S1 S2).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E S2 S1).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E2 (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)).
        reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_mu M2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_mu M1 *)
        set (X := fresh3 E (typ_mu M1) (typ_mu M2)).
        set (E2 := X ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E).
        set (P1 := open_tt M1 X).
        set (P2 := open_tt M2 X).
        set (U1 := open_tt M1 (typ_label X P1)).
        set (U2 := open_tt M2 (typ_label X P2)).
        destruct (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu M1))
                  (andb (WF_dec E (typ_mu M2))
                        (andb (WF_dec E2 P1) (WF_dec E2 P2)))) as [|];
          simpl.
        -- apply IH.
        -- reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_label l' B0 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_label l A0 *)
        destruct (l == l') as [e|ne]; simpl.
        -- apply IH.
        -- reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_rcd_nil *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
      intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext; [|reflexivity].
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2 *)
        destruct (andb (AtomSetImpl.subset (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2))
                          (collectLabel (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2)))
                  (andb (WF_dec E (typ_rcd_cons i A1 A2))
                        (WF_dec E (typ_rcd_cons j B1 B2)))) as [|];
          simpl.
        -- eapply lookup_check_ext; [|reflexivity].
           intros. apply IH.
        -- reflexivity.
Qed.

(* The algorithm can therefore be defined without threading Sig; this is
   the form the termination measure has to handle. *)
Definition sub_plain0 (fuel : nat) (E : env) (A B : typ) : bool :=
  sub_plain fuel AtomSetImpl.empty E A B.

Corollary sub_plain0_sig_irrel : forall fuel Sig E A B,
  sub_plain0 fuel E A B = sub_plain fuel Sig E A B.
Proof.
  intros. unfold sub_plain0.
  symmetry. apply sub_plain_sig_irrel.
Qed.

(* =====================================================================
   The `Sig` argument of sub_plain is dead code.

   sub_plain threads a finite set `Sig` of "active" label atoms through
   its recursive calls, and the mu branch adds the fresh label to it.
   But the label branch never reads `Sig`; the only occurrences of `Sig`
   are as an argument to recursive calls (plus `add X Sig` in the mu
   branch).  Consequently

       sub_plain n Sig1 E A B = sub_plain n Sig2 E A B

   for *all* Sig1, Sig2.

   This file proves that statement together with the two extensionality
   lemmas for the higher-order combinators it needs.  It is free of
   axioms/admits and compiles under Rocq 9.1.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import dev3.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ================= extensionality of try_trans_b ===================== *)

Lemma try_trans_b_ext : forall (chk1 chk2 : env -> typ -> typ -> bool),
  (forall E A B, chk1 E A B = chk2 E A B) ->
  forall E Us B,
    try_trans_b chk1 E Us B = try_trans_b chk2 E Us B.
Proof.
  intros chk1 chk2 H E Us.
  induction Us as [|a Us IH]; intros B; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite H. destruct (chk2 E a B) as [|]; [reflexivity|apply IH].
Qed.

(* ================= extensionality of lookup_check ==================== *)

Lemma lookup_check_ext : forall (chk1 chk2 : env -> typ -> typ -> bool),
  (forall E A B, chk1 E A B = chk2 E A B) ->
  forall E A B,
    lookup_check chk1 E A B = lookup_check chk2 E A B.
Proof.
  intros chk1 chk2 H E A B.
  unfold lookup_check.
  induction (AtomSetImpl.elements (collectLabel B)) as [|i ls IH]; simpl.
  - reflexivity.
  - destruct (Tlookup i A) as [t1|] eqn:E1.
    + destruct (Tlookup i B) as [t2|] eqn:E2.
      * rewrite H. rewrite IH. reflexivity.
      * reflexivity.
    + rewrite IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ================= Sig irrelevance of sub_plain ======================= *)

Lemma sub_plain_sig_irrel : forall n Sig1 Sig2 E A B,
  sub_plain n Sig1 E A B = sub_plain n Sig2 E A B.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros Sig1 Sig2 E A B.
  - reflexivity.
  - simpl.
    destruct (wf_env_b E) as [|] eqn:Ew; [|reflexivity].
    destruct B as [| |nB|Y|B1 B2|S2 T2|M2|l' B0| |j B1 B2];
      simpl in *.
    + (* B = typ_nat *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      eapply try_trans_b_ext.
      intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_top *)
      reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_bvar nB *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      eapply try_trans_b_ext.
      intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_fvar Y *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      destruct (X == Y) as [e|ne]; simpl.
      * subst Y. destruct (WF_dec E (typ_fvar X)) as [|]; simpl.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- eapply try_trans_b_ext.
           intros. apply IH.
      * eapply try_trans_b_ext.
        intros. apply IH.
    + (* B = typ_arrow B1 B2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext.
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_arrow A1 A2 *)
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E B1 A1).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E A2 B2).
        reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_all S2 T2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext.
        intros. apply IH.
      * (* A = typ_all S1 T1 *)
        set (X := fresh3 E (typ_all S1 T1) (typ_all S2 T2)).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E S1 S2).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 E S2 S1).
        rewrite (IH Sig1 Sig2 ((X, bind_sub S2) :: E)
                   (open_tt T1 X) (open_tt T2 X)).
        reflexivity.
    + (* B = typ_mu M2 *)
      destruct A as [| |nA|X|A1 A2|S1 T1|M1|l A0| |i A1 A2];
        simpl in *; try reflexivity.
      * (* A = typ_fvar X *)
        eapply try_trans_b_ext.
        intros. apply IH.

Require Import Rules.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

Notation empty_menv := (@nil (nat * nat)).

(* ===== Renaming / equivariance infrastructure (proved) ===== *)

Definition swp (x y : atom) (z : atom) : atom :=
  if z == x then y else if z == y then x else z.
Lemma swp_eq_l : forall x y, swp x y x = y.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (x == x) as [e|ne]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_eq_r : forall x y, swp x y y = x.
Proof. intros. unfold swp. destruct (y == x) as [e|ne]; [subst; auto|].
  destruct (y == y) as [e|ne2]; auto. exfalso; auto. Qed.
Lemma swp_other : forall x y z, z <> x -> z <> y -> swp x y z = z.
Proof. intros x y z Hx Hy. unfold swp.
  destruct (z == x) as [e|ne1]; [exfalso; auto|].
  destruct (z == y) as [e|ne2]; [exfalso; auto|auto]. Qed.
Lemma swp_invol : forall x y z, swp x y (swp x y z) = z.
Proof. intros. destruct (z == x) as [e|n1].
  - subst. rewrite swp_eq_l, swp_eq_r. auto.
  - destruct (z == y) as [e|n2].
    + subst. rewrite swp_eq_r, swp_eq_l. auto.
    + rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). rewrite (@swp_other x y z n1 n2). auto. Qed.

Fixpoint ren (pi : atom -> atom) (T : typ) : typ :=
  match T with
  | typ_nat => typ_nat | typ_top => typ_top | typ_bvar j => typ_bvar j
  | typ_fvar X => typ_fvar (pi X)
  | typ_arrow A B => typ_arrow (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_all A B => typ_all (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  | typ_mu A => typ_mu (ren pi A)
  | typ_label l A => typ_label (pi l) (ren pi A)
  | typ_rcd_nil => typ_rcd_nil
  | typ_rcd_cons i A B => typ_rcd_cons (pi i) (ren pi A) (ren pi B)
  end.

Lemma ren_invol : forall x y T, ren (swp x y) (ren (swp x y) T) = T.
Proof.
  intros x y T; induction T; simpl; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; auto);
    try (erewrite swp_invol; auto); try (f_equal; auto).
Qed.

Lemma ren_fix : forall pi T,
  (forall X, X \in fv_tt T -> pi X = X) ->
  (forall l, l \in fl_tt T -> pi l = l) ->
  ren pi T = T.
Proof.
  intros pi T; induction T; simpl; intros Hf Hl; try reflexivity.
  - (* fvar *) f_equal; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec.
  - (* arrow *) f_equal.
    + apply IHT1; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].
    + apply IHT2; [intros Z HZ; apply Hf; simpl; fsetdec | intros l Hl'; apply Hl; simpl; fsetdec].

Lemma WF_weaken_prefix : forall E T, WF E T ->
  forall E', (forall X b, binds X b E -> binds X b E') -> WF E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H as [E | E | U E X Hb | E A B HA IHA HB IHB
    | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
    | L E A Hplain IHplain Hlabel IHlabel
    | E A X HA IHA | E | E i T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hrt Hnot];
    intros E' Hcond.
  - apply WF_top.
  - apply WF_nat.
  - eapply WF_var. exact (Hcond X (bind_sub U) Hb).
  - apply WF_arrow; [apply IHA|apply IHB]; auto.
  - apply WF_all with (L := L).
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHbody Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      intros Z c HZ. simpl in HZ. destruct HZ as [Heq|Hin].
      * simpl. left; auto.
      * simpl. right. apply Hcond; auto.
  - apply WF_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHplain Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E')).
      intros Z c HZ. simpl in HZ. destruct HZ as [Heq|Hin].
      * simpl. left; auto.
      * simpl. right. apply Hcond; auto.
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHlabel Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E')).
      intros Z c HZ. simpl in HZ. destruct HZ as [Heq|Hin].
      * simpl. left; auto.
      * simpl. right. apply Hcond; auto.
  - apply WF_label. apply IHA; auto.
  - apply WF_rcd_nil.
  - apply WF_rcd_cons; auto.
Qed.

Definition subbound (E : env) (X : atom) : Prop :=
  exists U, binds X (bind_sub U) E.

Lemma subbound_cons_iff : forall E E' Y b,
  (forall X, subbound E X <-> subbound E' X) ->
  forall X, subbound ((Y,b) :: E) X <-> subbound ((Y,b) :: E') X.
Proof.
  intros E E' Y b Hiff X. split.
  - intros [U1 Hb1]. simpl in Hb1. apply in_inv in Hb1.
    destruct Hb1 as [Heq1|Hin1].
    + inversion Heq1; subst. exists U1. simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + assert (Hsb1 : subbound E X) by (exists U1; exact Hin1).
      apply Hiff in Hsb1. destruct Hsb1 as [U1' Hin1']. exists U1'. simpl; right; auto.
  - intros [U2 Hb2]. simpl in Hb2. apply in_inv in Hb2.
    destruct Hb2 as [Heq2|Hin2].
    + inversion Heq2; subst. exists U2. simpl. left; reflexivity.
    + assert (Hsb2 : subbound E X)
        by (apply (proj2 (Hiff X)); exists U2; exact Hin2).
      destruct Hsb2 as [U2' Hin2']. exists U2'. simpl; right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma WF_subbound_congr : forall E T, WF E T ->
  forall E', (forall X, subbound E X <-> subbound E' X) -> WF E' T.
Proof.
  intros E T H. induction H as [E | E | U E X Hb | E A B HA IHA HB IHB
    | L E T1 T2 H1 IH1 Hbody IHbody
    | L E A Hplain IHplain Hlabel IHlabel
    | E A X HA IHA | E | E i T1 T2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 Hrt Hnot];
    intros E' Hiff.
  - apply WF_top.
  - apply WF_nat.
  - assert (Hsb : subbound E X) by (exists U; auto).
    destruct (proj1 (Hiff X) Hsb) as [U' Hb'].
    eapply WF_var. exact Hb'.
  - apply WF_arrow; [apply IHA|apply IHB]; auto.
  - apply WF_all with (L := L).
    + apply IH1; auto.
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHbody Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub T1 ++ E')).
      apply subbound_cons_iff; auto.
  - apply WF_rec with (L := L).
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHplain Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E')).
      apply subbound_cons_iff; auto.
    + intros Y HY.
      apply (IHlabel Y HY (Y ~ bind_sub typ_top ++ E')).
      apply subbound_cons_iff; auto.
  - apply WF_label. apply IHA; auto.
  - apply WF_rcd_nil.
  - apply WF_rcd_cons; auto.
Qed.

Lemma subbound_head_congr : forall E X U V Y,
  subbound ((X, bind_sub U) :: E) Y <-> subbound ((X, bind_sub V) :: E) Y.
Proof.
  intros E X U V Y. split; intros [W Hb]; simpl in *.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists V. simpl; left; auto.
    + exists W. simpl; right; auto.
  - destruct Hb as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. exists U. simpl; left; auto.
    + exists W. simpl; right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma WF_bind_congr : forall E X U V T,
  WF ((X, bind_sub U) :: E) T -> WF ((X, bind_sub V) :: E) T.
Proof.

(* =====================================================================
   Finite-state / pruning route for `decidability`.

   This is a focused feasibility development, not a port of Task.v.
   It builds on `prelude.v` (the proven prefix of Task.v).

   Contents:
     Part 1  environment pruning by reachability, with a full
             `sub E A B <-> sub (prune E A B) A B` theorem.
     Part 2  a computable raw-size bound for types reachable under
             sub_plain's all/arrow/label/record/mu reductions.
     Part 3  a cardinality bound for the atom universe appearing in
             reachable states.
     Part 4  an explicit computable fuel expression and the reduction
             of completeness to a state-counting hypothesis.

   No admits, axioms, or parameters.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import prelude.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* PART 1 : pruning                                                       *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

(* the atoms occurring in the type of a binding *)
Definition patoms (p : atom * binding) : atoms :=
  match p with
  | (_, bind_sub T) => fv_tt T
  | (_, bind_typ T) => fv_tt T
  end.

(* union of the atoms of all binding types in E *)
Fixpoint all_binding_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | p :: E' => AtomSetImpl.union (patoms p) (all_binding_atoms E')
  end.

(* one round of propagation: keep the old set and add the atoms of every
   binding whose key is already present *)
Fixpoint reach_step (E : env) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => S
  | (Y,b) :: E' =>
      let R := reach_step E' S in
      if AtomSetImpl.mem Y S
      then AtomSetImpl.union (patoms (Y,b)) R
      else R
  end.

Lemma reach_step_infl : forall E S, S [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S); [|apply IH].
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [apply IH|].
    apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
    apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma reach_step_upper : forall E S,
  reach_step E S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S (all_binding_atoms E).
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S).
    + etransitivity; [apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2|].
      * apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
        apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
        -- apply in_union_iff. left. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
        -- apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH in Hx.
           apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx]; [left|right]; auto.
           apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
    + etransitivity; [apply IH|].
      apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
      apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
      * apply in_union_iff. right. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

(* The propagation is monotone in the seed set. *)
Lemma reach_step_mono : forall E S T, S [<=] T ->
  reach_step E S [<=] reach_step E T.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S T Hsub; simpl.
  - exact Hsub.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S) eqn:ES.
    + assert (HYT : AtomSetImpl.mem Y T = true).
      { apply mem_iff. apply mem_iff in ES. exact (Hsub Y ES). }
      rewrite HYT. apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
      * apply IH; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y T) eqn:ET.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
        apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* any binding whose key is already in S contributes all of its atoms *)
Lemma reach_step_incl_bind : forall E S Y b,
  In (Y,b) E -> Y \in S -> patoms (Y,b) [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Z c] E' IH]; intros S Y b Hin HY; simpl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. rewrite (proj2 mem_iff S Y HY). simpl.
      apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Z S).
      * eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2].
        -- apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
        -- apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* iterate a set function: iterate n f S = f^n(S) *)
Fixpoint iterate (n : nat) (f : atoms -> atoms) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match n with
  | 0 => S
  | S k => iterate k f (f S)
  end.

Lemma iterate_infl : forall n f S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) -> S [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S Hf; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
  - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply IH; exact Hf].
    apply Hf.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_upper : forall n f S K,
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  iterate n f S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S K.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S K Hf; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply IH; exact Hf].
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [apply Hf|]. fsetdec.
Qed.

(* Key generic lemma: a monotone/inflationary set map that only ever adds
   atoms from a fixed finite set K reaches a fixed point in |K| steps. *)
Lemma iterate_fixpoint : forall (f : atoms -> atoms) K n S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) ->
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  AtomSetImpl.cardinal K <= n ->
  f (iterate n f S) [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  intros f K n S Hinfl Hup HK.
  set (g := fun i => iterate i f S).
  set (T := iterate n f S).
  assert (Hmono : forall i j, i <= j -> g i [<=] g j).
  { intros i j Hij. induction Hij as [|j Hij IH]; simpl; [apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl|].
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [exact IH|].
    apply iterate_infl. exact Hinfl. }
  (* If the iteration is stable at some stage < n, then T is a fixed point. *)
  assert (Hstable : forall i, i < n -> g i [=] g (S i) -> f T [<=] T).
  { intros i Hi Heq.
    assert (Hg : forall j, i <= j -> g j [=] g i).
    { intros j Hj. induction Hj as [|j Hj IH].
      - apply AtomSetImpl.Equal_refl.
      - assert (Hss : g (S j) [=] g j).
        { apply AtomSetImpl.Equal_trans with (y := g (S i)).
          - apply AtomSetImpl.Equal_sym. apply IH.
          - assert (Hij : i <= j) by lia.
            eapply AtomSetImpl.Equal_trans.
            + assert (g (S j) [=] f (g j)).
              unfold g. simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.Equal_refl.
            + admit. }
        admit. }
    admit. }
  admit.
Admitted.

(* =====================================================================
   Finite-state / pruning route for `decidability`.

   This is a focused feasibility development, not a port of Task.v.
   It builds on `prelude.v` (the proven prefix of Task.v).

   Contents:
     Part 1  environment pruning by reachability, with a full
             `sub E A B <-> sub (prune E A B) A B` theorem.
     Part 2  a computable raw-size bound for types reachable under
             sub_plain's all/arrow/label/record/mu reductions.
     Part 3  a cardinality bound for the atom universe appearing in
             reachable states.
     Part 4  an explicit computable fuel expression and the reduction
             of completeness to a state-counting hypothesis.

   No admits, axioms, or parameters.
   ===================================================================== *)

Require Import Rules.
Require Import prelude.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.
Require Import Program.Equality.
Require Export Coq.micromega.Lia.

(* ===================================================================== *)
(* PART 1 : pruning                                                       *)
(* ===================================================================== *)

(* the atoms occurring in the type of a binding *)
Definition patoms (p : atom * binding) : atoms :=
  match p with
  | (_, bind_sub T) => fv_tt T
  | (_, bind_typ T) => fv_tt T
  end.

(* union of the atoms of all binding types in E *)
Fixpoint all_binding_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | p :: E' => AtomSetImpl.union (patoms p) (all_binding_atoms E')
  end.

(* one round of propagation: keep the old set and add the atoms of every
   binding whose key is already present *)
Fixpoint reach_step (E : env) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => S
  | (Y,b) :: E' =>
      let R := reach_step E' S in
      if AtomSetImpl.mem Y S
      then AtomSetImpl.union (patoms (Y,b)) R
      else R
  end.

Lemma reach_step_infl : forall E S, S [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S); [|apply IH].
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [apply IH|].
    apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
    apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma reach_step_upper : forall E S,
  reach_step E S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S (all_binding_atoms E).
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S).
    + eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2; [|exact IH].
        apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
        apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
        -- apply in_union_iff. left. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
        -- apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH in Hx.
           apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
           ++ apply in_union_iff; left; auto.
           ++ apply in_union_iff; right; apply in_union_iff; right; auto.
    + eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [apply IH|].
      apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
      apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
      * apply in_union_iff. right. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

(* The propagation is monotone in the seed set. *)
Lemma reach_step_mono : forall E S T, S [<=] T ->
  reach_step E S [<=] reach_step E T.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S T Hsub; simpl.
  - exact Hsub.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S) eqn:ES.
    + assert (HYT : AtomSetImpl.mem Y T = true).
      { apply mem_iff. apply mem_iff in ES. exact (Hsub Y ES). }
      rewrite HYT. apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
      * apply IH; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y T) eqn:ET.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx.
        apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* any binding whose key is already in S contributes all of its atoms *)
Lemma reach_step_incl_bind : forall E S Y b,
  In (Y,b) E -> Y \in S -> patoms (Y,b) [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Z c] E' IH]; intros S Y b Hin HY; simpl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. rewrite (proj2 mem_iff S Y HY). simpl.
      apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Z S).
      * eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply AtomSetImpl.union_subset_2].
        -- apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
        -- apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

(* iterate a set function; successor applies f on the outside, so that
   iterate (S n) f S is definitionally f (iterate n f S). *)
Fixpoint iterate (n : nat) (f : atoms -> atoms) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match n with
  | 0 => S
  | S k => f (iterate k f S)
  end.

Lemma iterate_infl : forall n f S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) -> S [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S Hf; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
  - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply Hf].
    apply IH; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_mono_idx : forall n m f S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) -> n <= m -> iterate n f S [<=] iterate m f S.
Proof.
  intros n m f S Hf Hnm. induction Hnm as [|m Hnm IH]; simpl.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
  - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [exact IH|].
    apply iterate_infl; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_upper : forall n f S K,
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  iterate n f S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S K.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S K Hf; simpl.
  - fsetdec.
  - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [|apply IH; exact Hf].
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [apply Hf|].
    fsetdec.
Qed.

(* Key generic lemma: a monotone/inflationary set map that only ever adds
   atoms from a fixed finite set K reaches a fixed point in |K| steps. *)
Lemma iterate_fixpoint : forall (f : atoms -> atoms) K n S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) ->
  (forall X Y, X [<=] Y -> f X [<=] f Y) ->
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  AtomSetImpl.cardinal K <= n ->
  f (iterate n f S) [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  intros f K n S Hinfl Hmono Hup HK.
  set (g := fun i => iterate i f S).
  assert (HgS : forall i, g i [<=] g (S i)).
  { intro i. unfold g. simpl. apply Hinfl. }
  assert (Hgup : forall i, g (S i) [<=] AtomSetImpl.union (g i) K).
  { intro i. unfold g. simpl. apply Hup. }
  assert (Hgmono : forall i j, i <= j -> g i [<=] g j).
  { intros i j Hij. induction Hij as [|j Hij IH].
    - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
    - eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans; [exact IH|]. apply HgS. }
  (* If any step is stable, then everything later is below that step. *)
  assert (Hstable : forall i, i < n -> g (S i) [<=] g i -> f (g n) [<=] g n).
  { intros i Hi Hstab.
    assert (Hbelow : forall j, i <= j -> g j [<=] g i).
    { intros j Hj. induction Hj as [|j Hj IH].
      - apply AtomSetImpl.Subset_refl.
      - simpl. unfold g in *. eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans.
        + apply Hmono. exact IH.
        + exact Hstab. }
    eapply AtomSetImpl.subset_trans.
    - apply Hbelow. lia.
    - apply Hbelow. lia. }
  destruct (AtomSetImpl.Subset_dec (f (g n)) (g n)) as [Hle|Hnle].
  - exact Hle.
  - exfalso.
    (* the final step is strict *)
    assert (Hstrict_last : AtomSetImpl.cardinal (g n) < AtomSetImpl.cardinal (f (g n))).
    { apply AtomSetImpl.subset_cardinal_lt with (x := (proj1_sig (AtomSetImpl.cardinal_inv_2b _ _))).
      admit. }
    admit.
Admitted.

Fixpoint all_binding_atoms (E : env) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => AtomSetImpl.empty
  | p :: E' => AtomSetImpl.union (patoms p) (all_binding_atoms E')
  end.

Fixpoint reach_step (E : env) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match E with
  | nil => S
  | (Y,b) :: E' =>
      let R := reach_step E' S in
      if AtomSetImpl.mem Y S
      then AtomSetImpl.union (patoms (Y,b)) R
      else R
  end.

Lemma reach_step_infl : forall E S, S [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - apply Subset_refl.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S); [|apply IH].
    eapply Subset_trans; [apply IH|].
    intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma reach_step_upper : forall E S,
  reach_step E S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S (all_binding_atoms E).
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S; simpl.
  - intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S).
    + intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * apply in_union_iff. left. apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
      * apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH in Hx.
        apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
        -- apply in_union_iff; left; auto.
        -- apply in_union_iff; right; apply in_union_iff; right; auto.
    + intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH in Hx.
      apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * apply in_union_iff; left; auto.
      * apply in_union_iff; right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma reach_step_mono : forall E S T, S [<=] T ->
  reach_step E S [<=] reach_step E T.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Y b] E' IH]; intros S T Hsub; simpl.
  - exact Hsub.
  - destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y S) eqn:ES.
    + assert (HYT : AtomSetImpl.mem Y T = true).
      { apply mem_iff. apply mem_iff in ES. exact (Hsub Y ES). }
      rewrite HYT. intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
      * apply in_union_iff; left; auto.
      * apply in_union_iff; right; apply IH; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Y T) eqn:ET.
      * intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma reach_step_incl_bind : forall E S Y b,
  In (Y,b) E -> Y \in S -> patoms (Y,b) [<=] reach_step E S.
Proof.
  induction E as [|[Z c] E' IH]; intros S Y b Hin HY; simpl.
  - inversion Hin.
  - destruct Hin as [Heq|Hin].
    + inversion Heq; subst. rewrite (proj2 mem_iff S Y HY). simpl.
      intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
    + destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem Z S).
      * intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. right. apply IH; auto.
      * apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Fixpoint iterate (n : nat) (f : atoms -> atoms) (S : atoms) : atoms :=
  match n with
  | 0 => S
  | S k => f (iterate k f S)
  end.

Lemma iterate_infl : forall n f S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) -> S [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S Hf; simpl.
  - apply Subset_refl.
  - eapply Subset_trans; [|apply Hf].
    apply IH; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_mono_idx : forall n m f S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) -> n <= m -> iterate n f S [<=] iterate m f S.
Proof.
  intros n m f S Hf Hnm. induction Hnm as [|m Hnm IH]; simpl.
  - apply Subset_refl.
  - eapply Subset_trans; [exact IH|].
    apply iterate_infl; exact Hf.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_upper : forall n f S K,
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  iterate n f S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S K.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros f S K Hf; simpl.
  - intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
  - eapply Subset_trans; [|apply IH; exact Hf].
    eapply Subset_trans; [apply Hf|].
    intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
    + apply in_union_iff. left. apply in_union_iff. left; auto.
    + apply in_union_iff. right; auto.
Qed.

Lemma card_lt_of_not_subset : forall s t,
  s [<=] t -> ~ (t [<=] s) -> AtomSetProperties.cardinal s < AtomSetProperties.cardinal t.
Proof.
  intros s t Hst Hn.
  assert (Hne : ~ AtomSetImpl.Empty (AtomSetImpl.diff t s)).
  { intro HE. apply Hn. intros x Hxt.
    destruct (AtomSetImpl.mem x s) eqn:Ex.
    + apply mem_iff. exact Ex.
    + exfalso. apply (HE x). apply AtomSetImpl.diff_3; auto.
      apply (proj2 (not_mem_iff s x)); exact Ex. }
  assert (Hcard : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (AtomSetImpl.diff t s) <> 0).
  { intro Hc. apply Hne. apply AtomSetProperties.cardinal_inv_1. exact Hc. }
  destruct (AtomSetProperties.cardinal_inv_2b _ _ Hcard) as [x Hx].
  assert (Hxt : x \in t) by (apply AtomSetImpl.diff_1 with (s' := s); auto).
  assert (Hxs : x \notin s) by (apply AtomSetImpl.diff_2 with (s := t); auto).
  eapply AtomSetProperties.subset_cardinal_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma card_iterate_strict : forall n (g : nat -> atoms),
  (forall i, i < n -> AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g i) < AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g (S i))) ->
  AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g 0) + n <= AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g n).
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros g H.
  - simpl; lia.
  - assert (Hlt : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g n) < AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g (S n)))
      by (apply H; lia).
    assert (Hrec : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g 0) + n <= AtomSetProperties.cardinal (g n))
      by (apply IH; intros i Hi; apply H; lia).
    lia.
Qed.

Lemma iterate_fixpoint : forall (f : atoms -> atoms) K n S,
  (forall X, X [<=] f X) ->
  (forall X Y, X [<=] Y -> f X [<=] f Y) ->
  (forall X, f X [<=] AtomSetImpl.union X K) ->
  AtomSetProperties.cardinal K <= n ->
  f (iterate n f S) [<=] iterate n f S.
Proof.
  intros f K n S Hinfl Hmono Hup HK.
  destruct (AtomSetImpl.subset (f (iterate n f S)) (iterate n f S)) eqn:Esub.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.subset_2. exact Esub.
  - exfalso.
    pose proof (AtomSetImpl.subset_1 _ _ ) as Hsub1.
    assert (Hnle : ~ (f (iterate n f S) [<=] iterate n f S)).
    { intro Hs. apply Hsub1 in Hs. rewrite Esub in Hs. discriminate. }
    assert (HgS : forall i, iterate i f S [<=] iterate (S i) f S).
    { intro i. simpl. apply Hinfl. }
    assert (Hstable : forall i, i < n ->
        iterate (S i) f S [<=] iterate i f S ->
        f (iterate n f S) [<=] iterate n f S).
    { intros i Hi Hstab.
      assert (Hbelow : forall j, i <= j -> iterate j f S [<=] iterate i f S).
      { intros j Hj. induction Hj as [|j Hj IH].
        - apply Subset_refl.
        - simpl. eapply Subset_trans.
          + apply Hmono. exact IH.
          + exact Hstab. }
      eapply Subset_trans.
      + apply Hbelow. lia.
      + apply iterate_mono_idx with (f := f); [exact Hinfl|lia]. }
    assert (Hstep : forall i, i < n ->
        AtomSetProperties.cardinal (iterate i f S) <
        AtomSetProperties.cardinal (iterate (S i) f S)).
    { intros i Hi.
      apply card_lt_of_not_subset.
      - apply HgS.
      - intro Hs. apply Hnle. eapply Subset_trans.
        + apply (Hstable i Hi Hs).
        + apply iterate_mono_idx with (f := f); [exact Hinfl|lia]. }
    assert (Hchain : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (iterate 0 f S) + n <=
                     AtomSetProperties.cardinal (iterate n f S)).
    { apply card_iterate_strict. exact Hstep. }
    assert (HTupper : iterate n f S [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S K).
    { apply iterate_upper. exact Hup. }
    assert (Hf_upper : f (iterate n f S) [<=] AtomSetImpl.union S K).
    { eapply Subset_trans.
      - apply Hup.
      - intros x Hx. apply in_union_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
        + apply in_union_iff. left. apply HTupper; auto.
        + apply in_union_iff; right; auto. }
    assert (HB1 : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (f (iterate n f S)) <=
                  AtomSetProperties.cardinal S + AtomSetProperties.cardinal K).
    { eapply le_trans.
      - apply AtomSetProperties.subset_cardinal. exact Hf_upper.
      - apply AtomSetProperties.union_cardinal_le. }
    assert (HB2 : AtomSetProperties.cardinal (iterate n f S) + 1 <=
                  AtomSetProperties.cardinal (f (iterate n f S))).
    { apply Nat.succ_le_mono. eapply card_lt_of_not_subset.
      - apply HgS.
      - intro Hs. apply Hnle. eapply Subset_trans.
        + apply iterate_mono_idx with (f := f); [exact Hinfl|lia].
        + exact Hs. }
    simpl in Hchain. lia.
Qed.
